D1_labo_1F/D1_labo_1F.30053:
{speaker}: Hey!
You're not supposed to be in here!

D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30055:
{speaker}: Where do you think you're 
going?
Stop that scurrying around!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30056:
{speaker}: Whew, I never thought that CIPHER's big man
would deign to show up here in person. {speaker}: I saw him in real flesh and blood, and he's
menacing!
The sight of him gave me shivers!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30057:
{speaker}: MASTER GREEVIL's supposedly making
a personal tour of all of CIPHER's facilities. {speaker}: I think he wants to confirm that everything
is fine so he can proceed with his plans without
ending up with a fiasco like last time.
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30058:
{speaker}: What?! Who are you?!
You suspicious intruder!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30059:
{speaker}: How long were you there?!
You might be just a kid, but we can't let you 
walk out!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30060:
{speaker}: Did you maybe come to 
rescue KRANE? {speaker}: Don't bother trying.
You don't know how scary LOVRINA--she's in
charge here--can be. {speaker}: She looks cute and all, but 
she's nothing short of terrifying.
Get out of here while you still can.
It's for your own good!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30061:
{speaker}: Hmm!
You again?!
Haven't you had enough?!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30062:
{speaker}: Aiyiyi...
I'm only a researcher here.
I don't battle!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30063: The door is locked. It appears to need an ID CARD.
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30064:
{speaker}: Grumble...
XD001's failure is going to send our plans right 
off the rails... {speaker}: Sigh...
I wish we'd finish up with this research and get 
out from this dank underground warren.
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30065:
{speaker}: Wah! Who are you?!
Where'd you get in from?!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30066:
{speaker}: This is bad news!
I've got to alert LOVRINA about this security 
breach!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30067:
{speaker}: Little boy, what are you 
up to?
You shouldn't get into mischief when you're 
visiting someone else's place.
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30068:
{speaker}: Hold it!
If you want to pop open that chest, you'll have 
to beat me first!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30115:
{speaker}: Oh! Hey, you!
You sneaked KRANE out?!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30116:
{speaker}: Oh, wait! Wait!
I so have not heard about anyone leaving 
anywhere!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30117:
{speaker}: We're going back to the HQ 
LAB.
Stand aside, please.
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30118:
{speaker}: Going back?
Seriously! You are so joking!
This so happens to be where you work from 
now on. {speaker}: After all, we so need you to 
keep working on your studies.
You so are the key to our plan. {speaker}: XD001...
The ultimate SHADOW POKéMON that can never 
be purified!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30119:
{speaker}: Stop that nonsense!
Do you seriously think that I would help you do 
something that horrible?
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30120:
{speaker}: Little boy, maybe you can 
convince PROF. KRANE.
You should so tell him to study our XD001. {speaker}: You see, our plan is to make 
SHADOW POKéMON that can never ever 
be purified. {speaker}: XD001 is only our first 
prototype. {speaker}: So, when we work out the 
problems, we can make combat units with XD-
series POKéMON.
Wouldn't that be just peachy? {speaker}: But we so need the 
PROFESSOR's cooperation for our plan.
So please, sweetie, can you please ask him 
nicely to help?
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30122:
{speaker}: Giggle...
Thank you.
So you will hand over the PROFESSOR to us 
nicely?
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30123:
{speaker}: Oh, how nasty!
You silly boy!
You so won't help me with XD001 either? {speaker}: Oh, you'll be sorry now!
But you will so understand!
A little hurt is so persuasive!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30125:
{speaker}: Hey!
You two!
Trying to escape again?!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30126:
{speaker}: Oh, how annoying!
I so thought you were being good and studying 
obediently! {speaker}: If you so don't smarten up 
right now, I will be angry, like really!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30127:
{speaker}: Ooh, I so hate to say this!
Little boy, I can't beat you right now. {speaker}: MASTER GREEVIL will so be cross
with me, but... {speaker}: But that's okay.
I'll let you owe me this one time.
But you have to promise you will think about my
plan next time. {speaker}: If you see XD001, I'm sure 
you will so want to help me.
I'll so be waiting for you!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30129:
{speaker}: {player}, you have grown
tough, haven't you? {speaker}: In fact, I'm amazed at how 
much stronger you've grown in this short a time. {speaker}: I guess we'll be relying on 
you even more from now on, {player}. {speaker}: Now that we know CIPHER is 
back, we need to move quickly.
We have to come up with ways of stopping them. {speaker}: This time, let's really head 
back to the HQ LAB!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30130:
{speaker}: Oh, look.
They dropped something.
What could it be?
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30132: {player} handed the DATA ROM to KRANE.
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30133:
{speaker}: Hmm...
This may be something important.
We'll take it back and analyze it.
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30137:
{speaker}: Are you tenacious or what?
I told you, if you want to get at that chest, you 
have to beat me first!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30138:
{speaker}: LOVRINA!
This child here, he's the intruder!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30139:
{speaker}: PROF. KRANE is so going to
be very busy, oh so very busy!
So, please be a nice boy and don't disturb us.
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30169:
{speaker}: Oh... That NAPS!
He so must have made a boo-boo again!
I so have to punish him lots!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30170:
{speaker}: You, come with me.
Go back to your room without any fuss.
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.30171:
{speaker}: What are you doing?!
Let me go!
I'll never help the likes of you! {speaker}: {player}!
{player}!
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.54113: It doesn't appear to open from this side.
D1_labo_B1/D1_labo_B1.54199:
What appears to be a code of some sort is
written down.

D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30069:
{speaker}: Please, PROF. KRANE.
When will you tell me about your purification 
study?
I do so want to know! {speaker}: That will let me power up my XD001.
I so made it myself!
Don't you think that would be fabulous?
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30070:
{speaker}: You've got to be joking!
I would never cooperate with people like you!
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30071:
{speaker}: Oh, but why?
I so don't get it!
Why would you refuse an offer so wonderful as
this?
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30072:
{speaker}: I don't care how often you repeat
yourself.
I have no intention of helping your SHADOW 
POKéMON plan. {speaker}: Artificially slamming shut the hearts
of POKéMON...
It's inexcusable.
Put a stop to it immediately.
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30073:
{speaker}: Oh, you!
You are so mean and closed-minded!
You won't even try to understand how marvelous
it is to help my XD001!
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30076:
{6a}{speaker}: This is all so your fault!
PROF. KRANE is oh so cross because you were 
so rude when you invited him here!
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30077:
{speaker}: You can't be serious.
Listen to the man already!
He's been saying all along that he won't help our
SHADOW POKéMON plan...
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30078:
{speaker}: I can't hear you!
The plan is perfect!
...XD001's condition was off by just a little
tiny bit.
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30079:
{speaker}: Being off by just a little tiny 
bit is enough to make it drop a ship?
And would you look at the uproar...
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30081:
{speaker}: It's so all your fault what 
happened, every tiny little bit!
So...
You so do something about it!
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30082:
{speaker}: ...NAPS, was it?
You have my sympathy.
What a nightmare it must be to have someone 
like her as your boss.
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30083:
{speaker}: You put a lid on it!
When it comes right down to it, it's so all your 
fault.
Come on, help us with XD001!
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30084:
{speaker}: First, we need to talk.
I'll teach you why it's such a bad mistake to 
create SHADOW POKéMON.
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30085:
{speaker}: Did you come here knowing 
that this is CIPHER's lab? {speaker}: It doesn't matter now.
Since you know that we're here, we're not about
to let you go free!
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30102:
{speaker}: You understand, don't you?
It's wrong to turn ordinary POKéMON into 
SHADOW POKéMON against their will.
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30104:
{speaker}: Please, won't you help us 
stop this SHADOW POKéMON plan?
Join us, and help us save POKéMON!
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30105:
{speaker}: ...PROF. KRANE.
I understand what you're trying to say, but 
I can't help you.
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30106:
{speaker}: Whoa?!
You...
Aren't you that kid I saw at the POKéMON HQ 
LAB that time?
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30108:
{speaker}: Are you trying to tell me that
you came here by your lonesome to
rescue PROF. KRANE?
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30109:
{speaker}: It's too bad, I'm still 
a member of CIPHER.
I can't very well let you folks go now, can I?
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30110:
{speaker}: As for you...
You snagged my TEDDIURSA from me that time! {speaker}: I'll give you this.
You've got guts to come here alone.
But I'll fix you good so you'll never get out 
again!
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30111:
{speaker}: What's that?!
Persistent brat!
You're back again?!
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30112:
{speaker}: PROF. KRANE, you folks
don't have the foggiest notion about how big
and scary CIPHER is.
It's not smart to resist. {speaker}: You can go on about the
poor abused POKéMON and all, but you should
think about your own selves.
That's my advice.
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30113:
{speaker}: {player}!
Did you really come here by yourself?
That's amazing. {speaker}: But it's dangerous here.
We'd better get out right away. {speaker}: My worst fears turned out to 
be true about CIPHER.
They weren't wiped out.
This is just one of their bases. {speaker}: But the details can wait.
Things could get complicated if they return.
Let's get out of here quick!
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30114:
{speaker}: I'll fill you in later.
Things could get complicated if they return.
Let's get out of here quick!
D1_labo_B2/D1_labo_B2.30167:
{speaker}: This time, let's get out of 
here for real!

D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30086:
{speaker}: When are they finally going to get that guy to
spill the beans about that purification research? {speaker}: He might be the authority on purification, but
if he won't talk, our work's not going anywhere.
D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30087:
{speaker}: Wah!
What are you doing there?
D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30088:
{speaker}: All I want to do is work on 
my research.
Don't disturb me, please!
D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30090:
{speaker}: Huh?
Well, if it isn't a tiny little intruder!
D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30091:
{speaker}: Hello, little boy.
Have you lost your way?
D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30092:
{speaker}: Hmm?!
This is no place for a child to be sightseeing!
D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30093:
{speaker}: Letting in a child like this 
unchallenged...
What is wrong with CIPHER's security?
D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30094:
{speaker}: Have you heard?
Prototype XD001's final adjustments are behind 
schedule at headquarters. {speaker}: If they can get KRANE to 
give up details about his purification study, all 
XD001's problems should be solved in one fell 
swoop.
D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30095:
{speaker}: I think so, too.
But he sounds quite obstinate and
tight-lipped about the whole thing. {speaker}: I've heard LOVRINA's getting
incensed over this.
D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30096:
{speaker}: What?! A kid in the lab?!
Hold still so we can catch you, kid!
D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30097:
{speaker}: I'm busy.
I'll let you go today, so go home without 
any fuss, okay?
D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30098:
{speaker}: Hey, what's wrong with our 
security?
Is everyone asleep at the wheel?
D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30099:
{speaker}: I'm not good at battling, but 
now's not the time to be telling you that!
D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30100:
{speaker}: I'll pretend that I never saw 
you.
Scram already!
D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30101: {speaker}: Why are you still in this lab?
D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30168:
{speaker}: Waah!
Not you again!
What do you want with this place?
D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30174:
{speaker}: And, hey!
If it's not PROF. KRANE himself!
How do you like that for timing? {speaker}: I'll seize this chance!
I'll make the good PROFESSOR tell me about the
purification study himself!
D1_labo_B3/D1_labo_B3.30175:
{speaker}: Um... Please?
Please tell me about the purification study.
LOVRINA will be upset with us...

D1_out/D1_out.30001:
{speaker}: We are sextuplets!
We are! We are!
We strike terror throughout the land!
For we are the HEXAGON BROTHERS!
D1_out/D1_out.30008:
{speaker}: ...Wait. Five?
That's it? Five?
Aren't we missing someone?
D1_out/D1_out.30009:
{speaker}: That's ridiculously impossible!
Let me try this time.
D1_out/D1_out.30016:
{speaker}: ...
See! What did I say again?
There is someone missing! {speaker}: But anyway, enough.
He'll return soon enough, I'm sure.
D1_out/D1_out.30017:
{speaker}: Hey, you brat! {speaker}: This is no kiddy playground! {speaker}: We've been away a while, but this here real
estate's belonged to CIPHER for many a year! {speaker}: If you don't quit scurrying about, we'll have
to tell your mommy.
If you don't want that to happen, then run along 
home!
D1_out/D1_out.30018:
{speaker}: That look on your face...
It says you're not about to listen and go home 
obediently. {speaker}: All right, then.
I'll play with you to while away the time if you 
want.
D1_out/D1_out.30021:
{speaker}: I guess it helped to while
away some time.
D1_out/D1_out.30022:
{speaker}: I'll take you on as often as 
you want!
D1_out/D1_out.30023:
{speaker}: Go on home already!
Or are you maybe looking to have a battle with 
me?
D1_out/D1_out.30025:
{speaker}: Go on home before you get 
hurt!
D1_out/D1_out.30026:
{speaker}: When I get serious, the
consequences can be really bad.
That's why I took it easy on you!
D1_out/D1_out.30027: {speaker}: I'll play with you all you want!
D1_out/D1_out.30028: {speaker}: Didn't I tell you to go home?!
D1_out/D1_out.30029:
{speaker}: Isn't that enough already?
Go play somewhere else.
D1_out/D1_out.30030:
{speaker}: We might not look it, but we are busy!
But, do you want to play anyway?
D1_out/D1_out.30031: {speaker}: Well, then, this is what I'll do!
D1_out/D1_out.30032:
{speaker}: Oh.
So you don't want me to play with you.
D1_out/D1_out.30033:
{speaker}: We try to look busy, but 
actually, we have nothing to do.
It's not like we need to worry about any enemies
in this desert.
D1_out/D1_out.30034:
{speaker}: Yeah, I have lots of time on 
my hands, but I have no time to play with you.
Do you want me to play again?
D1_out/D1_out.30035:
{speaker}: A little kid like you should run on home
to Mommy.
That's the best!
D1_out/D1_out.30036:
{speaker}: You're just a brat!
Why are you so strong?
D1_out/D1_out.30037:
{speaker}: Now what?
Why haven't you gone home to your mommy yet?
D1_out/D1_out.30038:
{speaker}: We six brothers are bound
by brotherly love sixfold!
Our solidarity is sixfold!
And our food bill is sixfold, too! {speaker}: Come on, kid.
I'll take you with my sixfold power!
D1_out/D1_out.30039:
{speaker}: This is nothing!
Our brotherly love is nothing like this!
D1_out/D1_out.30042:
{speaker}: Eight!
...Wait. Eight?
Now there're too many of us!
D1_out/D1_out.30043:
{speaker}: Hmm!
Brothers, beware!
There may be spies among us!
D1_out/D1_out.30044:
{speaker}: Hey, look.
It's that kid again!
D1_out/D1_out.30046:
{speaker}: Nineteen!
...Wait. Wait!
Why aren't the numbers working? {speaker}: Maybe...
Maybe there aren't just six of us?
D1_out/D1_out.30047:
{speaker}: Hey, look there.
It's that kid again.
D1_out/D1_out.30048:
{speaker}: Listen, kid, we're not your 
playmates!
D1_out/D1_out.30050:
{speaker}: Hoho!
So, you really want to battle with me that much, 
do you?
D1_out/D1_out.30051:
{speaker}: You're pretty tough.
You're tough enough that I'm willing to let you 
become my little brother.
D1_out/D1_out.30052:
{speaker}: We six brothers have guts
sixfold!
Our energy is sixfold!
And our mistakes are sixfold, too! {speaker}: Come on, kid.
I'll take you with my sixfold power!
D1_out/D1_out.30134:
{speaker}: What we need to do, Brothers, is this: lock
and load on this suspicious kid!
D1_out/D1_out.30135:
{speaker}: Hey, you brat!
Don't think you can ignore us!
D1_out/D1_out.30140:
{speaker}: Not you again!
Always meddling in our affairs.
It's your fault I haven't been promoted to 
an ADMIN!
D1_out/D1_out.30141:
{speaker}: You watch me!
I'm going to be a big shot one of these
days!
D1_out/D1_out.30142:
{speaker}: There must be something that
brings us together.
Didn't I see you in PHENAC not long ago?
D1_out/D1_out.30143:
{speaker}: What? You forgot?
Let me refresh your memory!
D1_out/D1_out.30145:
{speaker}: Haven't I told you already?
I don't like to battle.
But do you want to battle anyway?
D1_out/D1_out.30147:
{speaker}: I guess you don't like to
battle, either.
D1_out/D1_out.30148:
{speaker}: Can't you see that we're 
busy?
Why, we had to make a trip all the way to 
PHENAC not long ago. {speaker}: But if you want to play that 
much, this is what I'll do!
D1_out/D1_out.30149:
{speaker}: Like I said before, you're 
tough enough that I'm willing to let you become 
my little brother.
Think about it, okay?
D1_out/D1_out.30150:
{speaker}: Being out here, no one's ever
going to notice how cool I am.
Our only visitor is you, kid!
D1_out/D1_out.30151:
{speaker}: You know, you're lucky to be 
getting all that attention.
I'm just one in a set of six.
Nobody's paying attention to me... {speaker}: ...It's your fault!
You made me feel small and insignificant!
D1_out/D1_out.30152:
{speaker}: But even in this desert, my
brothers make the loneliness one-sixth.
That's the bond of brotherly love we
share.
D1_out/D1_out.30153:
{speaker}: You must think that we're 
handy playmates, don't you?!
D1_out/D1_out.30154:
{speaker}: Bleeaah!
Don't think we're willing to deal with you 
forever!
D1_out/D1_out.30155:
{speaker}: Well, you've gotten pretty 
famous, haven't you?
D1_out/D1_out.30160:
{speaker}: Do we really look that 
desperate for something to do?
D1_out/D1_out.30161:
{speaker}: Darn it!
Don't you dare mock us!
D1_out/D1_out.30163:
{speaker}: So, will you become one of 
our brothers?
Try to pick a good color.
D1_out/D1_out.30164:
{speaker}: If you're out playing so much,
your mom will worry about you.
A little kid like you should go on home!
D1_out/D1_out.30165:
{speaker}: We six brothers are bound
by brotherly love sixfold!
Our unity is sixfold!
And our fights are sixfold, too! {speaker}: Come on, kid.
I'll take you with my sixfold power!
D1_out/D1_out.30166:
{speaker}: You haven't seen anything of 
our brotherly love yet!
I bet you're feeling envious!
D1_out/D1_out.54109:
It's the truck used by the gang that abducted
PROF. KRANE!

D2_cloud_1/D2_cloud_1.31078:
{speaker}: You've cleared AREA 7!
Here you go!
Accept your POKé COUPONS!
D2_cloud_1/D2_cloud_1.31204:
{speaker}: Let AREA 7 begin with 
a flourish!
Let our battle take wing!
D2_cloud_1/D2_cloud_1.31205:
{speaker}: I wouldn't go around acting 
as if you're walking on clouds just because
you've beaten me!
D2_cloud_1/D2_cloud_1.31206:
{speaker}: Yo!
You're working hard, I see!
D2_cloud_1/D2_cloud_1.31207:
{speaker}: Keep slugging away right 
through to ZONE 100!
D2_cloud_1/D2_cloud_1.31208:
{speaker}: This is IDLON of ZONE 63!
Entering battle now!
D2_cloud_1/D2_cloud_1.31209:
{speaker}: How far will this challenger
manage to go?
D2_cloud_1/D2_cloud_1.31210:
{speaker}: Looking good!

D2_out/D2_out.31001:
{speaker}: Well, well.
Didn't we meet at GATEON PORT?
Have you come to train?
D2_out/D2_out.31002:
{speaker}: This is an excellent place for people to train.
I've trained here myself.

powerful.
I didn't need any other reason. {speaker}: As a result, I attained this status.
But now, I've taken to questioning my motive for
gaining power. {speaker}: I wonder what I am fighting for.
I ponder if I am putting my POKéMON under cruel
stress... {speaker}: That's why I urge you to look into yourself.
Ask yourself why you want to become stronger 
before you take that path.

If you train at your young age,
you will certainly become a fine
POKéMON TRAINER one day!

I do believe VANDER is an AREA LEADER on 
MT. BATTLE. {speaker}: If that's who you want, you should ask

Those are the POKé COUPONS for winning your 
way through AREA 2. {speaker}: Things will get a little more 
challenging once you reach AREA 3 and beyond.
Keep working hard!
D2_valley_2/D2_valley_2.31285:
{speaker}: Things will get a little more

D2_valley_3/D2_valley_3.31074:

Accept your POKé COUPONS!
D2_valley_3/D2_valley_3.31124:
{speaker}: It's AREA 3 now!
It's a different experience than AREA 2!
D2_valley_3/D2_valley_3.31125:
{speaker}: The way you're going, it 
might be easy as pie for you to reach AREA 4!
D2_valley_3/D2_valley_3.31126:
{speaker}: Training together with your 
favorite POKéMON...
I'd consider that a state of happiness!
D2_valley_3/D2_valley_3.31127:
{speaker}: I lost the battle, but I'm 
happy that I got to help in your training!
D2_valley_3/D2_valley_3.31129:
{speaker}: I admire you.
I love to battle, but I really don't like training

D2_valley_3/D2_valley_3.31130:
{speaker}: Don't you think DARK 
POKéMON are cool?
And ROCK POKéMON, why, they're sturdy and

I sure do like them!
D2_valley_3/D2_valley_3.31131:
{speaker}: When I battle, I like to use 
specific types of POKéMON.
That's my style. {speaker}: Do you have any preferred 
types?
D2_valley_3/D2_valley_3.31132:
{speaker}: I am totally devoted to 
GRASS POKéMON!
I shall be your training partner!
D2_valley_3/D2_valley_3.31133:
{speaker}: Way to go!

D2_valley_3/D2_valley_3.31134:

POKéMON!
D2_valley_3/D2_valley_3.31136:

D2_valley_3/D2_valley_3.31143:

D3_out/D3_out.32001:
It appears to be the S.S. LIBRA, the missing 
POKéMON transport ship!
D3_out/D3_out.32022:

No one gets past here.
D3_out/D3_out.32023:

his name, either.
D3_out/D3_out.32025:

Sheesh...
D3_out/D3_out.32026:
{speaker}: But that's all right.
We'll get back to snagging POKéMON just like
the old days and terrify the world again!
D3_out/D3_out.32027:
{speaker}: And we'll do that by using
your SNAG MACHINE!
D3_out/D3_out.32028:
{speaker}: Whoops!
I know you're a great battler!
But I'm not having any of that! {speaker}: GLOOM!
Release your SLEEP POWDER!
Send this kid off to beddy-bye!
D3_out/D3_out.32029:
{speaker}: Yahaha!
The SNAG MACHINE is mine!
D3_out/D3_out.32030:
{speaker}: Quick!
Let's get back to the hideout!
D3_out/D3_out.32031:
{speaker}: Aye!
Can you imagine how happy GONZAP's going to
be with us?
D3_out/D3_out.32046:
{speaker}: I'm WAKIN of TEAM SNAGEM!
It wouldn't hurt you to remember that!
D3_out/D3_out.32048:
The SCOOTER's tires bogged down in the sand!
It's impossible to go any farther. {player} had to turn back to PHENAC CITY.

D3_ship_B1_3/D3_ship_B1_3.32020:
Startled by the mail message's noise, the
POKéMON fled somewhere...

D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.32032:
{speaker}: Hi, are you awake now?
Looks like you had a rough time of it.
Are you all right?
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.32033:
{speaker}: Oh, hey, my friend!
What's that?
You still can't get close to that POKéMON? {speaker}: Why don't you try going up to
it nice and gentle so you don't scare it off?
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.32034:
{speaker}: That bunch I saw...
Weren't they TEAM SNAGEM?
Why would they want to pick a fight with you?
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.32036:
{speaker}: Is that right?
So that's been happening in the world at large. {speaker}: TEAM SNAGEM is a bunch of crooks and thugs.
They were snagging POKéMON from people with 
CIPHER's help. {speaker}: I hadn't heard about them for the last couple
years, so I figured they fell apart.
I guess not, eh? {speaker}: Anyways, it seems to me you need to get back
that thing they took from you. {speaker}: I think they took off north chasing after
another bunch of strange characters.
Maybe you ought to join the chase, too.
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.32037:
{speaker}: What's that?!
You say that other strange bunch was CIPHER?! {speaker}: Sounds like you got yourself involved in
something huge.
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.32038:
{speaker}: You went out to ECLO CANYON chasing
TEAM SNAGEM? {speaker}: So that lot's up to no good out there,
do you think?
They're a crude and violent bunch, so you watch
yourself!
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.32039:
{speaker}: Oh, hey!
That machine on your arm! {speaker}: I get it.
You managed to get it back.
That's excellent to hear! {speaker}: But you know, this place is getting too hectic,
what with TV people coming around and all.
Maybe it's time I left.
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.32045:
{speaker}: I reckoned I can finally get some peace
and quiet here.
So you can imagine my surprise when a TV crew 
showed up! {speaker}: I'd hate to see this place turn into a tourist
attraction.
Maybe I should move on.
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.32052:
{speaker}: Well?
Did you get some decent rest? {speaker}: You're free to use that bed whenever you
feel tired, okay?
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.32053:
{speaker}: By the way...
I've got this favor to ask of you.
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.32054:
{speaker}: See, every so often, I hear these odd noises
coming from deep in the ship's hull. {speaker}: I think there's someone skulking around down
there, but it's too creepy for me to go take
a look-see.
How about you go look for me?
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.32055:
{speaker}: Oh, hey, please.
You're some kind of strong, I know it.
You've got to do this for me!
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.32056:
{speaker}: Thank you kindly.
That noise has been really eating at my nerves
lately.
I can hardly sleep now! {speaker}: So, when you're done investigating,
I need you to tell me if you've found anything.
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.32062:
{speaker}: When you go investigate, come tell me if you
find anything.
Eh, tell me if you don't find anything!
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.32063:
{speaker}: Oh, hey!
Thanks for helping me out! {speaker}: Don't be a stranger if you happen to be in
the area!
Drop in and see me anytime!
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.32064:
{speaker}: Oh, so you finally found that POKéMON you've
been looking for.
Good for you! {speaker}: I've been sleeping well since you helped
me out.
Drop in and see me anytime!
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.54202:
It's the ship's wheel for the rudder.
It doesn't move anymore.
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.54203:
It appears to be a gauge of some sort.
It doesn't move anymore.
D3_ship_bridge/D3_ship_bridge.54209:
It's a bed.
Want to rest?

D3_ship_cabine/D3_ship_cabine.32018:
{speaker}: I see, so it was a POKéMON down there.
I'll sleep better at night knowing that! {speaker}: Huh?
You want to catch that POKéMON?
Well, you're a TRAINER, aren't you?
Just throw your POKé BALLS! {speaker}: ...Is that right?
So it was a POKéMON that a girl asked you to
find. {speaker}: Well, I'd bet that POKéMON's scared out of
its wits being away from its TRAINER and then
going through all this. {speaker}: Why don't you try going up to it nice and
gentle so you don't scare it off?
It's worth a shot. {speaker}: Anyways, I'll be able to get some decent
sleep now.
Thanks to you!
D3_ship_cabine/D3_ship_cabine.32058:
{speaker}: Whoa, wait!
You're not leaving, are you?
You have to investigate the ship's deep innards
for me. {speaker}: I'm counting on you!
My good night's sleep depends on this!
D3_ship_cabine/D3_ship_cabine.32059:
{speaker}: Oh, hey!
So, how was it?
Was there anything down there?
D3_ship_cabine/D3_ship_cabine.32060:
{player} described the POKéMON that was
deep in the ship's hull.
D3_ship_cabine/D3_ship_cabine.32061:
{speaker}: I see, so it was a POKéMON down there.
I'll sleep better at night knowing that! {speaker}: ...Is that right?
So it was a POKéMON that a girl asked you to 
find.
And you say it got away? {speaker}: Well, this place isn't a very welcome place
for a wild POKéMON to survive in... {speaker}: Why don't you try looking for it in places
where wild POKéMON are apt to gather? {speaker}: Anyways, I'll be heading off for home now.
After all, you've solved what worries I had. {speaker}: I'm surely indebted!
Come see me whenever you like.
You're always welcome!
D3_ship_cabine/D3_ship_cabine.54200:
There is a newspaper with the headline
"S.S. LIBRA Sets Sail!
Cargo of POKéMON and Big Dreams."
D3_ship_cabine/D3_ship_cabine.54201:
There's a book titled "Preventing Seasickness
in POKéMON."

D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32002:
{speaker}: Tch! {speaker}: After all I do to get here, we let one get
away on us!
Isn't that right, SNIDLE?
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32003:
{6a}{speaker}: Oh yes, indeed!
Such a lost opportunity, for it was
obviously rare!
If only it had been caught! {speaker}: Why, if you caught it, 
GORIGAN, your collection would have been 
enhanced by 0.7%!
Such a disappointing loss!
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32004:
{speaker}: It took off because you made so much noise,
GORIGAN, sir.
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32005:
{6a}{speaker}: I heard that!
You're pinning the blame on me?!
That's blatant insubordination! {speaker}: I'm in a foul mood today.
Not plain foul, foul foul!
Today, of all days...
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32007:
{speaker}: Urgggggh!
That fool SNATTLE had to screw up!
Someone let this outsider get in here?! {speaker}: Our recovery plan's done, but
we can't let you go.
Not after you've seen us here!
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32010:
{speaker}: Teach this little boy a thing 
or two about pain.
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32011:
{speaker}: Aye, aye, sir!
You just leave everything to me!
You can be assured the job will be done while 
you return to the LAIR.
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32013:
{speaker}: Well, now, you heard the man.
I must get back to the LAIR, too.
You know what to do.
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32014:
{speaker}: Wait a second!
That's not what you said!
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32015:
{speaker}: Allow me to explain.
We have a crucial job to do at the LAIR.
We need to make SHADOW POKéMON from those
that were on this ship. {speaker}: You do agree this is indeed 
important, don't you?
If you were to do the job, you would take 38%
more effort than I. {speaker}: In that case, GORIGAN's 
mood would worsen by 72%.
You do agree that is indeed most inefficient,
don't you? {speaker}: As a result, if you were to 
take this boy on in my place, we would be ahead 
63% in terms of overall efficiency. {speaker}: You do understand, don't 
you?
It's only for efficiency's sake.
I'll be going now.
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32016:
{speaker}: ...Why do I always get the feeling that I've
been had?
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32017:
{speaker}: Oh, well.
If I don't beat you here, I wouldn't be fulfilling 
my duties.
Don't hold a grudge for this!
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32040:
{speaker}: POFTY!
We're done with this location shoot.
Let's get back to PYRITE!
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32041:
{speaker}: Oh, hi!
{player}!
Can you say something to POFTY, too? {speaker}: She's gotten a bit too excited and won't listen
to me.
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32042:
{speaker}: A ship in the desert!
Don't you think that's more than just a little 
mysterious and romantic?
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32043:
{speaker}: That is so right!
If there were a handsome guy here, it would be 
perfect!
Giggle!
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32044:
{speaker}: Oh?
How could you be so unromantic?
And you're so young, too!
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32049:
{speaker}: I watched you battling those downright-bizarre
people.
You're some kind of tough, aren't you?
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32050:
{speaker}: I watched you battling those downright-bizarre
people.
Too bad you didn't win.
Still, you're some kind of tough.
D3_ship_deck/D3_ship_deck.32051:
{speaker}: Huh? Me?
I just happened to stumble across this ship, so
I made it my home. {speaker}: You know, there's plenty of food and all.
I have to admit certain things bugged me, but
nothing's perfect in life! {speaker}: I've got to admit I'm glad that weird bunch
is gone.
I owe you thanks for that at least. {speaker}: You must be tired after that battle, right?
You can rest up at my place.
It's in the wheelhouse.

D4_dome_3/D4_dome_3.33005:
{speaker}: I'm thinking of entering
COLOSSEUM BATTLES. {speaker}: But before I do that, I'll stock up on items at
this shop.
D4_dome_3/D4_dome_3.33021:
{speaker}: If you're thinking about entering COLOSSEUM
BATTLES, you should stock up on items here. {speaker}: You should be prepared for all situations!

D4_dome_4/D4_dome_4.33006:
{speaker}: BATTLE BINGO's an exciting challenge. {speaker}: How should I say this?
It's fun because it makes you think about the
types of POKéMON you may face.

D4_out_2/D4_out_2.33001:
{speaker}: Wow.
I can never get over how tall this place is.
D4_out_2/D4_out_2.33002:
{speaker}: On top of that TOWER is a COLOSSEUM. {speaker}: I'd love to take part in COLOSSEUM BATTLES,
but I'm afraid of heights.
D4_out_2/D4_out_2.33003:
{speaker}: I'm supposed to keep quiet about it, but I was
the one millionth visitor to PHENAC CITY. {speaker}: So, someone in PHENAC gave me a BATTLE
CD as a memento! {speaker}: Well?
Don't you think that's lucky?
I intend to stay around here for some more
good times!
D4_out_2/D4_out_2.33004:
{speaker}: This is REALGAM TOWER.
It's the summit of battling! {speaker}: Let's see...
There are the COLOSSEUM BATTLES,
BATTLE SIMs, and BATTLE BINGO! {speaker}: So many choices!
I can't decide what kind of battle I should try
today!
D4_out_2/D4_out_2.33012:
{speaker}: PHENAC was taken over? {speaker}: What kind of nonsense is that? {speaker}: PHENAC has a fantastic TRAINER named
JUSTY.
With him around, nothing like that could possibly 
happen.
D4_out_2/D4_out_2.33013:
{speaker}: What's that?!
The people of PHENAC have been replaced by 
CIPHER members? {speaker}: You mean even that generous lady who gave
me this BATTLE CD was... {speaker}: No! That just can't be true!
I mean look at this!
She gave me something this awesome!
D4_out_2/D4_out_2.33015:
{speaker}: PHENAC was under CIPHER's control?
Really? {speaker}: It must have been PRE GYM's JUSTY who
solved that crisis! {speaker}: Oh?
It wasn't JUSTY?
I wonder who, then.
It must have been one amazing TRAINER.
D4_out_2/D4_out_2.33016:
{speaker}: Oh, I see...
So CIPHER's members really were taking the 
place of PHENAC's people. {speaker}: That means that generous lady who gave me
that BATTLE CD was one of them... {speaker}: Oh, I don't know who to believe anymore!
Someone that generous shouldn't be a bad
person!
D4_out_2/D4_out_2.33018:
{speaker}: Wow.
I can never get over how tall this place is.
D4_out_2/D4_out_2.33019:
{speaker}: I suffer from vertigo, but I screwed up my
courage and went to the COLOSSEUM on top. {speaker}: But I couldn't take it.
It was all I could do to stay standing, never
mind battling!
D4_out_2/D4_out_2.33020:
{speaker}: I'm totally into BATTLE SIMs now. {speaker}: I'd like to get hold of some new BATTLE CDs,
but they're awfully hard to get. {speaker}: I wish another nice, generous lady would
give me some...
D4_out_2/D4_out_2.33024:
{speaker}: What is it with these BATTLE 
CD things?! {speaker}: POKéMON appear all right, but
when the battle ends, they just fade away!
You don't get to keep them?!
D4_out_2/D4_out_2.33025:
{speaker}: Oh, sheesh...
I dropped all my secret savings into them 
because I thought I'd get rare POKéMON
for real! {speaker}: There goes money down the
proverbial drain!
Let's get out of here!
D4_out_2/D4_out_2.33026:
{speaker}: What'll we do with these 
BATTLE CD things?
D4_out_2/D4_out_2.33027:
{speaker}: What good are they if they 
won't give us any POKéMON?
Just toss them out somewhere.

D4_tower_1F_1/D4_tower_1F_1.33007:
{speaker}: Welcome to REALGAM TOWER!
The pride of PHENAC CITY, it is a fully integrated
facility dedicated to battling. {speaker}: TRAINERS may take part in COLOSSEUM
BATTLES, BATTLE SIMs, and BATTLE BINGO. {speaker}: We sincerely hope you enjoy to your heart's
content all that we have to offer. {speaker}: Also, you can earn POKé COUPONS here.
They can be exchanged at MT. BATTLE for items 
and TMs.
D4_tower_1F_1/D4_tower_1F_1.33008:
{speaker}: I'm not saying BATTLE SIMs aren't
fun--they are, but I prefer doing things for real.
MT. BATTLE's more my style. {speaker}: Let me tell you what I'm striving at now.
A nonstop 100-TRAINER run through 
MT. BATTLE! {speaker}: I don't rightly know if my POKéMON or I have
the willpower to gut it out, but it's something
I will do one of these days!
D4_tower_1F_1/D4_tower_1F_1.33009:
{speaker}: The MAYOR of PHENAC used to drop in
pretty much every day.
But I haven't seen him around for some while 
now. {speaker}: I hope he's not sick or anything.
D4_tower_1F_1/D4_tower_1F_1.33010:
{speaker}: Oh! Your face!
I've seen you somewhere before!
Um... Where was it now? {speaker}: I remember now!
You were on TV!
Um... You were with that moustache man! {speaker}: But you know what?
You look better on TV than in person!
D4_tower_1F_1/D4_tower_1F_1.33014:
{speaker}: Huh?
PHENAC's been taken over?
That sounds preposterous... {speaker}: But if that's true, they may target this place
next!
Oh, my gosh!
This is serious!
D4_tower_1F_1/D4_tower_1F_1.33017:
{speaker}: Is that right!
PHENAC's takeover is finished!
Am I glad to hear that! {speaker}: The MAYOR of PHENAC should be relieved!
D4_tower_1F_1/D4_tower_1F_1.33022:
{speaker}: Darn it...
I always get beat during COLOSSEUM BATTLES. {speaker}: I really would like to know what sort of a
TRAINER is waiting for me at the end, you know?
D4_tower_1F_1/D4_tower_1F_1.33023:
{speaker}: Oh! Your face!
I saw it on TV!
You're the guy who raided PHENAC! {speaker}: ...No, wait.
You're the boy wonder TRAINER who sent the
bandits packing.
Isn't that right? {speaker}: Hmm...
You're surprisingly boyish still.
Maybe you look better on TV!
D4_tower_1F_1/D4_tower_1F_1.33036:
{speaker}: Hello!
Welcome to REALGAM TOWER. {speaker}: Unfortunately, I must inform you that the
COLOSSEUM is undergoing maintenance. {speaker}: Please do come back and make a challenge
when we reopen.
D4_tower_1F_1/D4_tower_1F_1.55035:
{speaker}: The boss is at the COLOSSEUM.
Why?
Because loads of POKéMON gather here. {speaker}: Hehehe.
It makes it easier for us to do our jobs.
D4_tower_1F_1/D4_tower_1F_1.55036:
{speaker}: Wait a second...
Are you thinking about making a COLOSSEUM
challenge? {speaker}: Don't do it.
It's not worth your time.
Our MIROR B. is in there now. {speaker}: If you want to win a challenge,
next time'd be better.
D4_tower_1F_1/D4_tower_1F_1.55037:
{speaker}: A place this glittery and bright...
It doesn't feel right for a guy like me. {speaker}: It's the right place for our boss,
MIROR B.
He's right at home in a glitzy place like this.
D4_tower_1F_1/D4_tower_1F_1.55038:
{speaker}: Darn it!
The POKéMON on BATTLE CDs aren't real! {speaker}: We couldn't swipe them if we
tried!

D4_tower_1F_2/D4_tower_1F_2.50051: This item can't be used now.
D4_tower_1F_2/D4_tower_1F_2.56008:
{speaker}: Welcome to BATTLE BINGO!
How may I serve you today?
D4_tower_1F_2/D4_tower_1F_2.56009:
{speaker}: Thank you. {speaker}: These CARDS are available for play right
now.
D4_tower_1F_2/D4_tower_1F_2.56011:
{speaker}: BATTLE BINGO is a strategy game that is
played on a BINGO CARD with 16 PANELS
arranged in a 4-by-4 grid. {speaker}: The 16 PANELS are turned over and exposed
one by one. {speaker}: Flip over PANELS to form a vertical,
horizontal, or diagonal line to score a BINGO. {speaker}: Keep forming BINGO lines until all PANELS are
flipped over or you run out of moves. {speaker}: If all PANELS are flipped over, 10 BINGO lines
will be completed, and you win the game.

POKéMON and two MASTER BALLS. {speaker}: Your POKéMON will also have ENTRY
POINTS (EP).

PANELS can be flipped over. {speaker}: At that point, it's game over for you.
D4_tower_1F_2/D4_tower_1F_2.56015:

16 PANELS and flip it over. {speaker}: The next PANEL that can be flipped must be

D4_tower_1F_2/D4_tower_1F_2.56016: What happens when a PANEL is flipped?
D4_tower_1F_2/D4_tower_1F_2.56017:
{speaker}: There are two kinds of PANELS.

the other with a question mark. {speaker}: If you try to flip a PANEL marked with a
POKéMON type, a hidden POKéMON will appear. {speaker}: You must battle this POKéMON with the
POKéMON you entered in the game. {speaker}: The battle will be a strictly one-on-one match
with no switching of POKéMON. {speaker}: If you win the battle or catch the opposing
POKéMON with a MASTER BALL, the contested
PANEL can be flipped over. {speaker}: If the opposing POKéMON is caught, you may
choose it as your own for PANEL battles from
the next PANEL on. {speaker}: The "?" PANELS can be opened just by using
1 EP.
They hide EP and MASTER BALLS for the
player's use.
D4_tower_1F_2/D4_tower_1F_2.56018: What happens when I get a BINGO?
D4_tower_1F_2/D4_tower_1F_2.56019:
{speaker}: If you complete a line of flipped-over
PANELS, you score a BINGO.
You are awarded a single EP for each BINGO
line. {speaker}: If you quit the game before the end, you are
given POKé COUPONS matched to the number of
BINGO lines you made. {speaker}: If you complete the CARD, you are awarded
a bonus for leftover EP and MASTER BALLS in
addition to the regular prize. {speaker}: If all your POKéMON run out of EP, it's game
over since you will no longer be able to flip
PANELS. {speaker}: In that case, you will not be given any POKé
COUPONS that you may have earned in
that game.
Please be aware of that.

D4_tower_1F_3/D4_tower_1F_3.58119:
{speaker}: A move's power is boosted if its type is the
same as its POKéMON's type. {speaker}: A POKéMON that is up in the sky using FLY

smartly.

D4_tower_1F_3/D4_tower_1F_3.58149:
{speaker}: In order to win, it is necessary to use the

turns.
D4_tower_1F_3/D4_tower_1F_3.58150:
{speaker}: Defeat the SHUCKLE by cleverly using the
move COUNTER.
D4_tower_1F_3/D4_tower_1F_3.58151:
{speaker}: Consider the type matchups of POKéMON

METRONOME?

points.

SHEER COLD.
D4_tower_1F_3/D4_tower_1F_3.58161:
{speaker}: The opponent will often use the move ROAR
if you use a status-enhancing move.
D4_tower_1F_3/D4_tower_1F_3.58162:
{speaker}: Beware of the REGIROCK's move
EXPLOSION.
D4_tower_1F_3/D4_tower_1F_3.58163:

D4_tower_1F_3/D4_tower_1F_3.58164:

D4_tower_1F_3/D4_tower_1F_3.58165:

{speaker}: You get on my nerves, the 
way you scurry around!
D5_factory_4F/D5_factory_4F.34041:
{speaker}: The man in charge,
MR. GORIGAN, is on the top floor of this 
factory. {speaker}: Are you an acquaintance of MR. GORIGAN?
D5_factory_4F/D5_factory_4F.34042:
{speaker}: Oh, busy, busy, busy!
I have to put in overtime every day!
Unbelievable!
It's terrible for my complexion!
D5_factory_4F/D5_factory_4F.34043:
{speaker}: Nobody called for me, but 
here I am!
Tadaaaaah!
D5_factory_4F/D5_factory_4F.34044:
{speaker}: No, no!
You're not allowed to go any farther!
D5_factory_4F/D5_factory_4F.34045:
{speaker}: We achieved a technological 
breakthrough for transforming many POKéMON into SHADOW 
POKéMON at the same time, unlike the old, 
slow way. {speaker}: That's how we managed to 
deal with all the POKéMON from the S.S.
LIBRA in this short time.
We can keep doing it, too. {speaker}: If anyone tries to meddle 
with our fantastic plan, this is what happens!
D5_factory_4F/D5_factory_4F.34046:
{speaker}: The majority of the SHADOW 
POKéMON we made here have already been 
transported out. {speaker}: I've also heard that the 
CIPHER HQ has completed final tuning of XD001,
the ultimate SHADOW POKéMON. {speaker}: Looks like you got here just 
a little bit late.
Ahaha!
D5_factory_4F/D5_factory_4F.34047:
{speaker}: So, it's you, is it?
The one who's been causing a 14% loss in 
manufacturing productivity?
D5_factory_4F/D5_factory_4F.34048:
{speaker}: Ah!
You're the kid that dropped in on us at
the S.S. LIBRA?! {speaker}: I see now.
You know far too much more about CIPHER than 
you need to know. {speaker}: If nothing's done about you, 
there's a 98% likelihood that this factory and 
the SHADOW POKéMON plan will be endangered. {speaker}: In that event, the danger to 
CIPHER goes up a whopping 54%.
That's critically bad news. {speaker}: I suppose we'll have to coax 
you into giving up the chase right here.
D5_factory_4F/D5_factory_4F.34049:
{speaker}: I had a hunch that you had 
a 28% chance of coming back.

D5_factory_B1/D5_factory_B1.34037:
{speaker}: That ruckus upstairs...
You're the cause?!
D5_factory_B1/D5_factory_B1.34038:
{speaker}: Oh, whew...
I am downright bone-weary. {speaker}: We're under orders to take a full shipload
of POKéMON and turn them into SHADOW
POKéMON. {speaker}: But we'll be done with this job soon.
Then, I'm going to take a good long bath to 
unwind!
D5_factory_B1/D5_factory_B1.34080:
{speaker}: What?
You shut the factory down?! {speaker}: MASTER GREEVIL is going to be furious when
he hears that!
I don't want to be around to see that!
D5_factory_B1/D5_factory_B1.54117: Cartons of some sort are being moved.

D5_factory_hat/D5_factory_hat.34066:
{speaker}: Where are all my crew?
...You wiped them out?
Every last one?! {speaker}: Impossible!
One kid took down all those SHADOW POKéMON 
we made? {speaker}: Urrrgggh!
In wrecking my factory, you smeared dirt all 
over my good name and standing!
D5_factory_hat/D5_factory_hat.34067:
{speaker}: What?! Back again?!
I'll stomp you, whale on you, pulverize you,
and devastate you!
D5_factory_hat/D5_factory_hat.34068:
{speaker}: Ugwaaah!
That's it!
You're not getting away with this!
No way, no how, no ifs or buts! {speaker}: I'm not taking this!
I'll blow up the factory with you in it!
Gwaaooooh!
D5_factory_hat/D5_factory_hat.34069:
{speaker}: GORIGAN.
That is quite enough.
Accept that you have lost.
D5_factory_hat/D5_factory_hat.34071:
{6a}{speaker}: Hohoho.
We meet again.
You do remember me, don't you? {speaker}: Yes, indeed!
I am MR. VERICH.
Or perhaps I should say GREEVIL, the GRAND 
MASTER of CIPHER. {speaker}: I must say I am taken aback.
I never once imagined that you would destroy 
our factory. {speaker}: But that's not important.
Even though the mass output of SHADOW 
POKéMON has ended, our plan itself is
unharmed. {speaker}: We have already completed 
XD001's final tuning.
It now rests with me.
D5_factory_hat/D5_factory_hat.34072:
{speaker}: XD001?!
The ultimate SHADOW POKéMON that's resistant 
to purification?!
D5_factory_hat/D5_factory_hat.34073:
{speaker}: Now, I shall prepare our final 
plan to activate XD001.
Do you honestly think you can stop me? {speaker}: I shall be at CIPHER's HQ.
It is on CITADARK ISLE off the coast of 
GATEON PORT. {speaker}: It is an impregnable fortress 
that repels all with cruel waves and thick clouds.
No one can reach it! {speaker}: Come if you dare.
I'll enjoy waiting for you.
Hohohoho!
D5_factory_hat/D5_factory_hat.34074:
{speaker}: Hyahyahya!
MASTER GREEVIL has such a wicked sense of 
humor! {speaker}: No ordinary ship can get 
close because of the rough seas.
And even if you do manage to get on the 
island... {speaker}: The place will be swarming 
with TRAINERS carrying the SHADOW POKéMON 
I made! {speaker}: ...Even though there should 
be a lot more SHADOW POKéMON... {speaker}: If XD001 didn't drop that ship 
in the desert, we wouldn't have taken so long
tuning the SHADOW POKéMON. {speaker}: Hyahyahya!
But it doesn't matter.
There're plenty of SHADOW POKéMON to
welcome you in style! {speaker}: How many are there?
Heheh, I can't tell you that.
If I did, it'd floor you! {speaker}: It's just a matter of time 
before the world belongs to us.
You'd better be ready for it!
D5_factory_hat/D5_factory_hat.34075: It's a list of manufactured SHADOW POKéMON!
D5_factory_hat/D5_factory_hat.34100:
{speaker}: You've done it now!
I'm steaming mad, and there's no forgiving that. 
Ever!
Be prepared to drop!
D5_factory_hat/D5_factory_hat.34103: {player} downloaded the list onto the P★DA.

D5_factory_top/D5_factory_top.34050:
{speaker}: Hmm!
I'm impressed that you got here!
I'll have to make you feel welcome!
D5_factory_top/D5_factory_top.34051:
{speaker}: Above here is the factory's 
all-important CONTROL MACHINE! {speaker}: I can't let you pass, even if 
it takes inches off my chest!
D5_factory_top/D5_factory_top.34052:
{speaker}: Okay...
Now, all there's to do is adjust the voltage...
D5_factory_top/D5_factory_top.34053:
{speaker}: Let me see...
Where's the SYSTEM LEVER?
Huh?
... {speaker}: Whoops!
I left it on my desk!
That's not smart...
D5_factory_top/D5_factory_top.34054:
{speaker}: Oh, hi!
You've come along at just the right time! {speaker}: If you're not busy, can you run a little errand
for me?
Go downstairs and grab the SYSTEM LEVER 
that is sitting on my desk.
D5_factory_top/D5_factory_top.34055:
{speaker}: Oh, hey!
That's my SYSTEM LEVER!
You went and got it for me!
Thank you! {speaker}: ...Wait!
Who are you anyway?!
You don't belong here! {speaker}: Darn!
If the voltage goes up even a little, 
the computer controlling this whole facility will 
shut down! {speaker}: And, oh my gosh!
If that were to happen, the SHADOW POKéMON 
production software could be destroyed! {speaker}: I can't let you lay one finger on this
CONTROL MACHINE!
D5_factory_top/D5_factory_top.34056:
{speaker}: If you don't want to be 
punished again, hand over my SYSTEM LEVER!
D5_factory_top/D5_factory_top.34057:
{speaker}: If you don't want to be punished again,
hand over my SYSTEM LEVER!
D5_factory_top/D5_factory_top.34058:
It says, "To adjust voltage, use the SYSTEM 
LEVER.
WARNING: Do not raise voltage too high." Raise the voltage?
Or do you want to lower it?
D5_factory_top/D5_factory_top.34059:
{player} used the SYSTEM LEVER to lower 
the CONTROL MACHINE's voltage. ...But nothing happened!
D5_factory_top/D5_factory_top.34060:
{player} used the SYSTEM LEVER to raise 
the CONTROL MACHINE's voltage.
D5_factory_top/D5_factory_top.34061: The CONTROL MACHINE has gone wild!
D5_factory_top/D5_factory_top.34062:
{6a}{speaker}: What's going on?!
The production line's stopped!
The control computer's not responding!
D5_factory_top/D5_factory_top.34063:
{speaker}: Oh! You're that punk from
the S.S. LIBRA!
You're behind this, aren't you?!
D5_factory_top/D5_factory_top.34064:
{speaker}: Oh, no! What the blazes?!
The SHADOW POKéMON production software's 
been deleted! {speaker}: GORIGAN gets furious if 
things don't go his way!
He's going to chew me out again!
D5_factory_top/D5_factory_top.34065:
{speaker}: You shouldn't have wrecked 
our manufacturing system.
You're going to pay for it now.
D5_factory_top/D5_factory_top.54107: The door is locked from inside.

D5_out/D5_out.34001:
{speaker}: You're not running off with 
them?
You've got guts, but...
Huh?!
D5_out/D5_out.34002:
{speaker}: Wait a second!
You're that brat who was at GATEON PORT!
What are you doing here?!
D5_out/D5_out.34003:
{speaker}: You're nothing but bad news!
Ever since I saw you, I've had nothing but the
worst luck! {speaker}: First, at GATEON PORT, some
guy challenged me to a battle out of the blue 
and promptly stomped me flat. {speaker}: Then GORIGAN gave me one 
major dressing-down for showing off SHADOW 
POKéMON without permission. {speaker}: Because of that, he made me 
stand guard here as punishment.
D5_out/D5_out.34004:
{speaker}: There's one thing I can't 
figure out, though.
How'd GORIGAN ever find out about me anyway?
D5_out/D5_out.34005:
{speaker}: Gaaah!
Remembering that is getting me riled!
This time, I'll flatten you!
D5_out/D5_out.34006:
{speaker}: Tenacious little punk.
You're not getting past here, though!
D5_out/D5_out.34007:
{speaker}: Hey, hey, hey!
This is no place for a kid like you!
D5_out/D5_out.34008:
{speaker}: No, no.
Can't let you in, nope!
You run along now!
D5_out/D5_out.34009: {speaker}: This is no place for a kid like you!
D5_out/D5_out.34010:
{speaker}: Huh? Wait a minute.
That weird machine on your left arm... {speaker}: You look sort of like that kid I saw on TV,
but maybe not.
Hey, kid, were you ever on TV?
D5_out/D5_out.34011:
{speaker}: W-what?
The kid taking the fight to CIPHER is you? {speaker}: Well, what an opportunity!
I'll knock you out and earn myself a promotion 
to ADMIN!
D5_out/D5_out.34012:
{speaker}: Yeah, you're right.
A little kid like you couldn't possibly be taking 
the fight to CIPHER.
D5_out/D5_out.34014:
{6a}{speaker}: That kid's special.
He's not anyone you lot can beat.
If you know what's best, let him through without 
a fuss.
D5_out/D5_out.34016:
{speaker}: Hey, kid.
You let us handle things here. {speaker}: It wouldn't pay to make 
a racket.
All it'd do is alert the guys inside the building.
D5_out/D5_out.34019:
{speaker}: Hey!
You guys are from TEAM SNAGEM!
What do you think you're doing here?
D5_out/D5_out.34020:
{speaker}: GLOOM!
Hit them with SLEEP POWDER!
D5_out/D5_out.34021:
{speaker}: Waah! What is this?!
What do you think...
This isn't fair...
Zzz...
D5_out/D5_out.34023:
{speaker}: Heheh!
Glad to be of service!
D5_out/D5_out.34024:
{speaker}: Now's our chance!
Hurry!
We can wreck CIPHER right now!
D5_out/D5_out.34025:
{speaker}: Heheh!
GLOOM's some kind of useful, hey?
D5_out/D5_out.34081:
{speaker}: We've been spotted, so there's no point in
hiding anymore.
Who are we?
We're TEAM SNAGEM!
D5_out/D5_out.34082:
{speaker}: TEAM SNAGEM?
Can't rightly say I know them.
D5_out/D5_out.34083:
{speaker}: See?
He doesn't know either!
It's bringing tears to my eyes! {speaker}: Hey, we should go.
We should leave this up to GONZAP.
D5_out/D5_out.34084:
{speaker}: Be quiet!
We've finally managed to track down CIPHER, 
haven't we?
We're not just leaving now!
D5_out/D5_out.34085:
{speaker}: Hey, you, you big lunk!
We have business in that building!
Stand aside if you don't want to get hurt!
D5_out/D5_out.34087:
{speaker}: You're calling the dashing 
and terrific MR. {speaker} a lunk?
How dare you! {speaker}: Grrrrr!
You're not getting away with this!
D5_out/D5_out.34089:
{speaker}: See, what'd I say?
If we would've just waited for GONZAP, this 
wouldn't have happened. {speaker}: WAKIN must have reached the hideout by
now and given that SNAG MACHINE to GONZAP.
D5_out/D5_out.34090:
{speaker}: Hey, you want more of where 
that came from?
D5_out/D5_out.34092:
{speaker}: We'll pull back and regroup!
Let's get back to the hideout!
D5_out/D5_out.34093:
{speaker}: Humph!
That's what you get for acting tough!
D5_out/D5_out.34094:
{speaker}: There, see?
That's the mighty ZOOK's real power!
I can take anyone if no one's bothering me!
D5_out/D5_out.34095:
{speaker}: Get lost, punk!
Or are you angling for another thrashing at the
hands of the mighty ZOOK?
D5_out/D5_out.34096:
{speaker}: You're just some kid!
How could I, the mighty ZOOK, get beat by just 
some kid?! {speaker}: Because you fluked out!
You only won because you got lucky!
That's got to be the answer! {speaker}: I won't battle you again.
If you win by a fluke again, my reputation will
take a beating!
D5_out/D5_out.34097:
{speaker}: Get lost, punk!
If I, the mighty ZOOK, get serious, you'll be 
crushed in no time!
D5_out/D5_out.34098:
{speaker}: You're getting on my nerves 
the way you keep poking around where you're 
not welcome! {speaker}: And what's with that weird 
machine on your arm?
You wanting me to thump you again or what? {speaker}: If that's what you want, I'll 
bash, thrash, and crash you!
D5_out/D5_out.34099:
{speaker}: Quit scurrying around!
You're getting on my nerves!
Don't think you're hot stuff just because you 
beat me once by a fluke! {speaker}: And what's with showing off 
that weird machine on your arm?
You're begging for a thumping, and I'll deliver it 
this time! {speaker}: I'll bash, thrash, and crash 
you, just like you want!
D5_out/D5_out.34104:
{speaker}: Oh, hi, {player}!
Imagine meeting up with you here! {speaker}: I'm covering the police 
authorities and their raid on CIPHER's secret 
factory. {speaker}: Aren't they awful people?
How could they do such terrible things to 
POKéMON?
D5_out/D5_out.34105:
{speaker}: Boy, when we're lucky, we 
get on a roll.
I didn't think we'd get to capture scenes of 
actual arrests. {speaker}: Whoops!
I'd better get my camera set up!
D5_out/D5_out.34106:
{speaker}: Ah, it's you.
Apparently, there are still perpetrators here that 
are involved in the production of SHADOW 
POKéMON. {speaker}: We've arrived with backup 
units to make mass arrests of those 
perpetrators.
D5_out/D5_out.34108:
{speaker}: Urrrrgh...
The punk thumped me...
And GORIGAN will be furious with me again... {speaker}: ...I should go away.
Somewhere far away where CIPHER won't have 
any influence. {speaker}: So long, punk.
I've had enough of battling you to last a lifetime.

D6_dome_1F/D6_dome_1F.35053:
{speaker}: Hohoho!
Now this is quite a surprise.
You managed to defeat ARDOS. {speaker}: Of course, you have also 
beaten so many of my followers.
Perhaps it's no surprise that you won.
D6_dome_1F/D6_dome_1F.35054:
{speaker}: Hohoho.
I imagine you won't be able to get in, even
someone so clever as you.
D6_dome_1F/D6_dome_1F.35061:
{speaker}: Who allowed this child to 
penetrate our defenses so deeply?!
What is the meaning of this?! {speaker}: The others can't be counted
on at all.
I am giving you the responsibility of dealing with
this child.
D6_dome_1F/D6_dome_1F.35062:
{speaker}: You've finally managed to
anger MASTER GREEVIL. {speaker}: I thought I would end up 
battling you one day... {speaker}: But this isn't how I had hoped
to face you.
D6_dome_1F/D6_dome_1F.35063:
{speaker}: Fine. I understand.
But once we begin, expect no mercy.
That is my philosophy.
D6_dome_1F/D6_dome_1F.35064:
{speaker}: I'm sorry...
The GRAND MASTER's orders are absolute.
I can't refute them.
D6_dome_1F/D6_dome_1F.35065:
{speaker}: If that's what you want, I will
accept your challenge.
Expect no mercy!
D6_dome_1F/D6_dome_1F.35066:
{speaker}: You are powerful.
Much more than I had imagined. {speaker}: If you aim to stop our plan,
then you should keep going. {speaker}: However, the GRAND 
MASTER's power is probably far greater than 
you can imagine.
I doubt you will beat the man...
D6_dome_1F/D6_dome_1F.35067:
{speaker}: Thunderstorms above, and
whirlpools below.
What could it be? {speaker}: You have to be kidding,
though.
I don't stand a chance against a guy who
thumped ELDES!
D6_dome_1F/D6_dome_1F.35068:
{speaker}: Working at the HQ makes me 
an elite!
What more proof do you need? {speaker}: However bleak the situation,
I never give up!
D6_dome_1F/D6_dome_1F.35105:
{speaker}: I must say that I haven't been
this excited in a long time.
I do have an appreciation for the strong, 
you see. {speaker}: However, I also cannot allow
your interference.
My SHADOW POKéMON plan is nearing 
completion.
D6_dome_1F/D6_dome_1F.35106:
{speaker}: So, for the time being, I think
I will have you securely out of the way right
where you are now.
D6_dome_1F/D6_dome_1F.35115:
{speaker}: If we battle, it will only be
unfulfilling and without meaning.
Will you challenge me knowing that?
D6_dome_1F/D6_dome_1F.54211:
It's a gigantic wall of glass.
It appears impossible to go any further.

D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35069:
{speaker}: Hohoho.
So, you have even come this far. {speaker}: I had no idea that a mere
child like you would pursue me this long.
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35070:
{speaker}: The creation of SHADOW 
POKéMON that permanently resist purification.
That was the first step. {speaker}: Next, I plan to create an army
of SHADOW POKéMON that work independently
on my orders alone. {speaker}: When this second step is
done, I will take over the world without having to
rely on bothersome people. {speaker}: And now...
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35071:
{speaker}: Let me introduce you to my
faithful servant.
The one that shall become the central figure in
my SHADOW POKéMON army.
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35073:
{speaker}: Code name XD001...
Now freed of all adjustments, I present to you
SHADOW LUGIA! {speaker}: This LUGIA is the first of the
SHADOW POKéMON that cannot be purified. {speaker}: Now, let us celebrate the
completion of my SHADOW POKéMON plan 
in advance!
Fall prey to SHADOW LUGIA!
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35074:
{speaker}: Hohoho!
My LUGIA is delighted to see new prey arrive!
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35075:
{speaker}: How dare you, child!
How dare you defeat my SHADOW LUGIA!
My one loyal subject!
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35076:
{speaker}: How dare you, child!
How dare you snag my SHADOW LUGIA!
My one loyal subject!
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35077:
{speaker}: There's nothing left!
But I will personally see to the total destruction
of your POKéMON!
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35078:
{speaker}: Hohoho!
Return as often as you wish! {speaker}: The more you rebel, the
happier my POKéMON become!
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35079:
{speaker}: How...
A mere child...
A mere child crushed my cherished plan?
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35081:
{speaker}: Grrr...
It's your fault!
I won't forgive...
There is no forgiving you!
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35082:
{speaker}: GRAND MASTER!
We're done here!
We should blow up CITADARK ISLE with the
child still on it!
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35083:
{speaker}: But...
If I did that, our SHADOW POKéMON data and
our subordinates would be lost as well...
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35084:
{speaker}: GRAND MASTER, such things
can be replaced!
We must ensure our own survival! {speaker}: I've readied a helicopter for
our escape.
We've got to leave now.
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35087:
{6a}{speaker}: Please wait.
You're willing to sacrifice everyone so you can
escape?
You should be ashamed!
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35088:
{speaker}: Ashamed?
Clinging to foolish pride will guarantee CIPHER's
demise! {speaker}: CIPHER must survive.
That is our first duty.
The GRAND MASTER feels the same way.
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35089:
{speaker}: Y-yes...
For CIPHER's sake, sacrifices must be endured...
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35090:
{speaker}: What are you saying?
The SHADOW POKéMON factory has been 
destroyed!
XD001 was defeated! {speaker}: Nothing remains of CIPHER!
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35093:
{speaker}: GRAND MASTER!
Please give the order to blow up CITADARK
ISLE!
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35094:
{speaker}: ...Yes. It can't be helped.
Don't begrudge us, child.
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35095:
{speaker}: Stop!
Let's put a stop to this.
...Father!
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35096:
{speaker}: Don't call him Father!
Call him the GRAND MASTER!
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35097:
{speaker}: Father, you've lost sight of
what is important.
You got carried away by this whole GRAND
MASTER nonsense. {speaker}: It isn't possible to take over
the world by producing powerful POKéMON.
Just think of this child...
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35098:
{speaker}: This child's pure heart won
out over XD001.
We were in the wrong.
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35099:
{speaker}: Silence, silence, silence!
Why aren't you showing some spine!
We've come so far!
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35100:
{speaker}: CIPHER is finished.
Father, you yourself should know that more than
anyone.
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35101:
{speaker}: Now, please.
Stand up. {speaker}: This is how it should be.
The laws of the land will render judgment on
what we have done.
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35102:
{speaker}: Oh...
Everything I did...
All of it was a mistake...
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35103:
{speaker}: Thanks to your courage, we
were finally able to wake from our nightmare. {speaker}: Thank you.
You'll have nothing to fear from us ever.
You should return home to your family. {speaker}: Let us meet again, too.
The next time we battle, it won't be as mortal
enemies.
I will look forward to it.
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35116:
{speaker}: PROF. KRANE, DATA ROMs,
and the LAIR...
You alone derailed every one of our well-laid
plans. {speaker}: Well, perhaps not just you.
The news broadcast by ONBS did not help
CIPHER's cause at all. {speaker}: However, my SHADOW 
POKéMON plan isn't finished yet.
The final act is about to unfold. {speaker}: Having come this far, I think
you've earned the right to know what I have
planned.
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35129:
{speaker}: The creation of SHADOW 
POKéMON that permanently resist purification.
That is the first step. {speaker}: Next, I plan to create an army
of SHADOW POKéMON that work independently
on my orders alone. {speaker}: When this second step is
done, I will take over the world without having to
rely on bothersome people. {speaker}: And now...
D6_dome_2F/D6_dome_2F.35130:
{speaker}: Now, let us celebrate the 
success of my SHADOW POKéMON plan in
advance. {speaker}: I will personally see to the
destruction of your POKéMON.

D6_dome_B1/D6_dome_B1.35058:
{speaker}: You won't quit being a pest,
will you?!

D6_fort_1F/D6_fort_1F.35004:
{speaker}: You look suspicious.
I won't let you go on!
D6_fort_1F/D6_fort_1F.35005:
{speaker}: He usually never leaves the
LUXO CRUISER...
Where's he off to in such a hurry?
D6_fort_1F/D6_fort_1F.35006:
{speaker}: Oh, I know!
You chased him off!
Hahaha, just joking!
Want to race me?
D6_fort_1F/D6_fort_1F.35007:
{speaker}: You're pretty decent!
So, who are you? Huh?
I guess it doesn't matter!
D6_fort_1F/D6_fort_1F.35008:
{speaker}: I should be swabbing down 
MASTER GREEVIL's LUXO CRUISER, but I'm 
completely lost. {speaker}: What is wrong with me?
I've got to buck up and focus.
Hey, kid, what say we battle?
D6_fort_1F/D6_fort_1F.35009:
{speaker}: You're a bighearted kid!
I'll show my respect and go all out!
D6_fort_1F/D6_fort_1F.35010:
{speaker}: What?!
That's mighty cold and cheap of you!
I'll straighten you up with a battle!
D6_fort_1F/D6_fort_1F.35011:
{speaker}: I don't back-talk to any tough
battler.
D6_fort_1F/D6_fort_1F.35012:
{speaker}: Huh?
Maybe...
Are you someone suspicious?
D6_fort_1F/D6_fort_1F.35014:
{speaker}: Oh, oh!
You are so that little boy who ran off with 
PROF. KRANE!
D6_fort_1F/D6_fort_1F.35015:
{speaker}: Oh, you came again?
Did you want to see me that much?
Oh, I am such a heartbreaker...
D6_fort_1F/D6_fort_1F.35016:
{speaker}: Oh, you're terrible!
I mean really!
MASTER GREEVIL will be oh so cross with me
again! {speaker}: Ooh, how I so dislike you!
I'll be glad, little boy, when MASTER GREEVIL 
and XD001 make you pay!
D6_fort_1F/D6_fort_1F.35107:
{speaker}: Because of what you did, 
MASTER GREEVIL was oh so angry!
It made everyone miserable, and it's so all your
fault!
D6_fort_1F/D6_fort_1F.35108:
{speaker}: But it's okay now.
We didn't need PROF. KRANE anyway! {speaker}: I just so needed to be serious
just a little tiny bit to get XD001's final 
adjustments just right! {speaker}: It is so perfect now!
Purification will so not work on it ever!
I'm so amazed because I am so a genius! {speaker}: Oh? You want to see my 
XD001?
Oh, so sorry, that is so not possible!
Why? Because...
D6_fort_1F/D6_fort_1F.35109:
{speaker}: I am so going to defeat you, 
little boy!
Here I come!

D6_fort_2F_1/D6_fort_2F_1.35026:
{speaker}: You're hanging tough in this
magma-hot heat!
I thought I was going to melt waiting!
D6_fort_2F_1/D6_fort_2F_1.35128: The E-MAIL text is cut off...

D6_fort_2F_3/D6_fort_2F_3.35027:
{speaker}: You look cute, but you're 
also brave and bold to come to a place like this. {speaker}: It would be a shame to beat
someone like you, but this is a good chance to
score some points with MASTER GREEVIL!

D6_fort_3F_1/D6_fort_3F_1.35028:
{speaker}: Oh, sorry.
This is a dead end.
D6_fort_3F_1/D6_fort_3F_1.35029:
{speaker}: Sorry, I can't tell you what 
I'm doing at this dead end.
D6_fort_3F_1/D6_fort_3F_1.35030:
{speaker}: You're going this way?
I don't think that's a wise decision. {speaker}: Because you have to beat me
to go this way!
D6_fort_3F_1/D6_fort_3F_1.35032:
{speaker}: Whoa!
You're making a huge mistake if you think you
can get past me without an incident!
D6_fort_3F_1/D6_fort_3F_1.35033:
{speaker}: I was the one who made 
a huge mistake!
D6_fort_3F_1/D6_fort_3F_1.35034:
{speaker}: I know what you're after! {speaker}: So, I'm not going to let you
pass!
D6_fort_3F_1/D6_fort_3F_1.35035:
{speaker}: Wahahaha!
You thought there was no one this way, 
didn't you? {speaker}: You're not getting off the
hook that easily!
D6_fort_3F_1/D6_fort_3F_1.35036:
{speaker}: I'm throwing everything at 
you with no restraint!
I can't take this brutal heat anymore!

D6_fort_3F_2/D6_fort_3F_2.35039:
{6a}{speaker}: Together, we bring...
The power-double explosion attack!
D6_fort_3F_2/D6_fort_3F_2.35040:
{6a}{speaker}: Get this!
You'll learn that I have incredible power even 
by myself!

D6_fort_4F/D6_fort_4F.35041:
{speaker}: Gorgeously I make my 
entrance!
With flowing elegance I battle!
D6_fort_4F/D6_fort_4F.35042:
{speaker}: Did I startle you?
I did spook you, didn't I?
I should do that to you in battle, too!

D6_fort_6F/D6_fort_6F.35043:
{speaker}: Wroooaar!
Watch your head!
Keep an eye on the ground, too!
D6_fort_6F/D6_fort_6F.35044:
{speaker}: Kiyeeeh!
You're never getting by me!
I'll be yelled at if I don't stop you!

D6_fort_B1/D6_fort_B1.35017:
{speaker}: This is a proper research 
facility, sweetie.
A little guy like you shouldn't be in here.
D6_fort_B1/D6_fort_B1.35018:
{speaker}: DOCTOR, we can generate even bigger waves
this way...
Isn't it great...
Zzz...
D6_fort_B1/D6_fort_B1.35019:
{speaker}: We've got good waves going again today.
From the island it keeps others away.
Isolated is how we want to stay!
D6_fort_B1/D6_fort_B1.35020:
{speaker}: A whirlpool is created when water currents
collide.
Try it when you're taking a bath.
D6_fort_B1/D6_fort_B1.35021:
{speaker}: We don't get to see too many kids here.
Are you a child of one of our research people? {speaker}: We're responsible for keeping CITADARK ISLE
ringed with vicious waves. {speaker}: Thanks to this place, it's not easy for ships
to approach CITADARK ISLE.
D6_fort_B1/D6_fort_B1.35022:
{speaker}: We researchers are honored and happy to
serve MASTER GREEVIL. {speaker}: Our research funding is more than generous.
And it's incredibly fun to create giant waves!
D6_fort_B1/D6_fort_B1.35023:
{speaker}: I'm going to change into my white lab outfit,
so don't come in!
Promise me, okay?
D6_fort_B1/D6_fort_B1.35024:
{speaker}: The job of the research 
people is to conduct research.
But that's not our job! {speaker}: To terrify people into the pits
of despair through battling...
That is our purpose! {speaker}: With that clear vision, we are
not about to lose!
D6_fort_B1/D6_fort_B1.35025:
{speaker}: We're right in the middle of 
putting the finishing touches on our SHADOW
POKéMON plan.
We don't need your meddling!

D6_out_dome/D6_out_dome.35045:
{speaker}: Mufwofwo!
So, we meet again. {speaker}: My plan was perfect.
The only problems were the utterly useless
LOVRINA and GORIGAN, and... {speaker}: You.
You spoiled the brilliant plan I had devised for
PHENAC CITY. {speaker}: And thanks to that terrible, 
hard-nosed woman, I suffered the humiliation of 
having my worst moment broadcast all over 
ORRE...
D6_out_dome/D6_out_dome.35046:
{speaker}: Mufwofwo! {speaker}: My planning is perfection.
I shall be happy to battle with you as often as
you wish.
D6_out_dome/D6_out_dome.35047:
{speaker}: Urggggh!
My plan!
My perfect plan!
MASTER GREEVIL, forgive me!
D6_out_dome/D6_out_dome.35050:
{speaker}: It's been a while, boy.
Do you remember me? {speaker}: Do you recall this?
I helped you in GATEON PORT. {speaker}: ...There's no need for thanks.
I was merely punishing a fool that used 
a SHADOW POKéMON in public. {speaker}: At that time, we didn't want 
the world to know what we, CIPHER, were
planning. {speaker}: Back then, I thought you 
were just an ordinary child...
D6_out_dome/D6_out_dome.35051:
{speaker}: I had expected you to do 
better, but you disappoint me.
Your abilities are strictly limited. {speaker}: You are but a puny presence
not worthy of battling.
Be gone!
D6_out_dome/D6_out_dome.35052:
{speaker}: I realize now that I should 
have crushed you much earlier.
D6_out_dome/D6_out_dome.35055:
{speaker}: Heheh!
It's me again, kid! {speaker}: You know, it makes me kind 
of happy to see you since I've seen you so
often! {speaker}: But the way you keep beating
me, my cred's taking a beating!
Aiyeeeh!
D6_out_dome/D6_out_dome.35056:
{speaker}: Feh!
Back again?!
Come back all you want, but nothing's going to
change!
D6_out_dome/D6_out_dome.35057:
{speaker}: Bleah!
That was the very last chance MASTER GREEVIL
gave me!
D6_out_dome/D6_out_dome.35110:
{speaker}: So, MASTER GREEVIL gave 
me this one last chance to redeem myself.
But this is it! {speaker}: If I lose this one, there's no 
tomorrow!
Here goes!
D6_out_dome/D6_out_dome.35111:
{speaker}: How could I keep losing to 
some kid over and over?
If there were a tree, I'd climb it to get away
from all this!
D6_out_dome/D6_out_dome.35112:
{speaker}: To gain MASTER GREEVIL's 
forgiveness, and for me to assume my rightful
position as the GOVERNOR of ORRE, I must 
defeat you. {speaker}: This time, I won't be shy 
about revealing to you the full extent
of my power.
D6_out_dome/D6_out_dome.35113:
{speaker}: Little did I suspect that you 
would become CIPHER's biggest and most
damaging threat. {speaker}: That's enough talk.
You have the skills and wherewithal to reach
CITADARK ISLE.
Let me see your abilities in full glory!
D6_out_dome/D6_out_dome.35114:
{speaker}: This is out of my hands now.
I must defer you to MASTER GREEVIL himself. {speaker}: But, boy, don't think
that this is over.
I won't abandon my dreams!

D6_out_foot/D6_out_foot.35001:
{speaker}: Hey, you!
That thing you're riding on--it's kind of cool! {speaker}: I have this feeling I met you in a port
somewhere, but I don't give a hoot about that. {speaker}: I do have a problem when someone shows up
here without passage on our boat!
D6_out_foot/D6_out_foot.35002:
{speaker}: Hey, you!
You came back again?! {speaker}: I told you--we have a big 
problem with strangers showing up uninvited!
D6_out_foot/D6_out_foot.35003:
{speaker}: Darn it!
I've got to report this!
D6_out_foot/D6_out_foot.35048:
{speaker}: You're leaving already?
But not before I show you my brand of 
hospitality!
D6_out_foot/D6_out_foot.35049:
{speaker}: Going upstairs?
While we're waiting for the elevator, let's battle,
you and I!
D6_out_foot/D6_out_foot.35120:
{speaker}: Huh?
How'd you manage to get to this island?
D6_out_foot/D6_out_foot.35121:
{speaker}: You rode that here?!
That's awesome!
Even MR. VERICH, the world's richest man, 
doesn't have one of those! {speaker}: Oh, aye!
It excites the sailing man's heart in me!
Listen, how about letting me take a ride 
sometime, huh?
D6_out_foot/D6_out_foot.35122:
{speaker}: That's right!
That's the spirit of the man of the sea!
I don't know if this is much of a thanks, but 
I found this in the ship.
D6_out_foot/D6_out_foot.35123:
{speaker}: Oh, now, come on!
A luxury cruiser's fine and dandy, but for a real
sailing man, a tough and wild boat's the ultimate,
am I right? {speaker}: So, come on, fellow!
Think it over just one more time!
D6_out_foot/D6_out_foot.35124:
{speaker}: By the way, what brings you here?
Get your errand finished quick so I can go sail
with you!

D7_out/D7_out.35501:
{speaker}: Hello, {player}.
Very good of you to come. {speaker}: If you plan to take the ORRE 
COLOSSEUM challenge, go to the reception 
area there.
D7_out/D7_out.35502:
{speaker}: It's too bad how things 
turned out this time.
Still, it was to be expected since there were
so many tough TRAINERS. {speaker}: Go off and train some more.
Everyone will be looking forward to a battle with
you, {player}.
D7_out/D7_out.35503:
{speaker}: Congratulations!
My hat's off to you for a most splendid victory! {speaker}: In recognition of your brave 
achievement, {player}, {4d}
has conferred on you a new title. {speaker}: This is it.
Do accept it.
D7_out/D7_out.35505:
{speaker}: This title seems to express 
{4d}'s feelings.
D7_out/D7_out.35506:
{speaker}: {player}.
Don't be satisfied with this victory.
Keep up with your training!
D7_out/D7_out.35507:
{speaker}: Congratulations!
My hat's off to you for a most splendid victory! {speaker}: However, don't be satisfied 
with this victory.
Keep up with training every day!

{speaker}: Welcome to the ORRE COLOSSEUM. {speaker}: At the ORRE COLOSSEUM, we use different
rules from the PYRITE and REALGAM
COLOSSEUMS. {speaker}: If you wish, I can explain the rules.
Would you like me to do that?
D7_out/D7_out.35509:
{speaker}: That's fine, then.
If you need anything, please feel free to 
let me know.

{speaker}: Welcome to the ORRE COLOSSEUM.
How may I serve you today?
D7_out/D7_out.35514: {speaker}: Which topic would you like me to explain?
D7_out/D7_out.35518:
{speaker}: At the ORRE COLOSSEUM, DOUBLE BATTLES
are conducted.
You are permitted to battle with four POKéMON. {speaker}: Please be aware that certain kinds of

D7_out/D7_out.35519:

competing at the ORRE COLOSSEUM. {speaker}: For example, SHADOW POKéMON are strictly
prohibited.

kind of POKéMON. {speaker}: These POKéMON are also forbidden: MEWTWO,

D7_out/D7_out.35523: {speaker}: Which set would you like to challenge?
D7_out/D7_out.35532:

Here are your POKé COUPONS for winning

by MR. EAGUN, the ORRE COLOSSEUM's
PRESIDENT. {speaker}: Please go see MR. EAGUN to claim it.

We look forward to your next challenge.

I will be happy to give you this information

information.

No. {2f} begin!

                                      LOVRINA
