M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36028:
{speaker}: Hi, this is PRE GYM! {speaker}: Actually, it's really named PRESTIGE
PRECEPT CENTER.
But everyone calls it PRE GYM.
M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36029:
{speaker}: Hm?
You're an unfamiliar face.
Are you a traveling TRAINER? {speaker}: The name's JUSTY.
I'm the LEADER of this PRESTIGE PRECEPT
CENTER. {speaker}: Things are too hectic, so all battles here
are canceled.
Can I help you with anything?
M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36030:
{speaker}: Huh? What's that?
CIPHER is going to attack the town?
And you came to warn the MAYOR? {speaker}: Hahaha!
Are you sure you didn't dream all this up?
M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36031:
{speaker}: It's weird...
Our teacher's saying things she usually
wouldn't say...
M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36032:
{speaker}: Oh, hello.
Are you here to attend my class?
I'm glad you're here to hear this. {speaker}: POKéMON are just tools for battling.
Use them wisely and destroy your opponents
without mercy.
M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36084:
{speaker}: Welcome to the PRESTIGE PRECEPT
CENTER, or as everyone says, the PRE GYM. {speaker}: Oh?
You have a letter from the MAYOR for JUSTY?
Is that right? {speaker}: Oh?
I hear a little voice whispering to me...
M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36085:
{speaker}: And that voice tells me to take that letter
from you!
M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36086:
{speaker}: Oh, good for you!
Such determination to deliver that letter!
M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36088:
{speaker}: You are good. {speaker}: But the way you battle is different.
POKéMON are just tools for battling. {speaker}: The way you battle...
You play things too safe with your POKéMON!
M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36089:
{speaker}: Since you don't seem to hear what I'm saying,
I suppose I'd better just beat it into you!
M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36090:
{speaker}: Now do you get it?
POKéMON are just tools for battling.
M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36091:
{speaker}: You're good.
You figured out that I'm the real JUSTY. {speaker}: Huh?
You're wondering if I'm a fake, too?
Okay, yes, if you want to be precise, I'm the real
JUSTY impersonator!
M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36092:
{speaker}: Even JUSTY couldn't do a thing when we
showed him we had hostages galore. {speaker}: He's being a model prisoner along with the
MAYOR and the rest of them right here in PRE
GYM's basement. {speaker}: If you want to play hero and rescue them...
Well, you need to deal with me first!
M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36093:
{speaker}: You want to play hero that much and
rescue that sorry bunch we have downstairs? {speaker}: I hate to break it to you, but
you're too weak for the job!
M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36094:
{speaker}: Snicker...
Sorry, pal, beating me won't set the bunch
downstairs free. {speaker}: You need the ELEVATOR KEY
to get into PRE GYM's basement. {speaker}: Sorry to say, nobody trusts me
with anything important like that.
M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36095:
{speaker}: I...
I'm having a bad dream!
This is just a nightmare, isn't it?!
M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36121:
{speaker}: Oh?
Isn't that the ELEVATOR KEY you have there? {speaker}: If you use that on the control desk over there,
the elevator should operate.
But why would you have it?
M1_gym_1F/M1_gym_1F.36122:
{player} inserted the ELEVATOR KEY

Don't use that condescending tone on me.
I'm older than you!
And besides, we're both JUSTY now.
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36170:
{speaker}: What the...
What are you looking at?
You think we're putting on a show or something?
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36171:
{speaker}: But, what's been seen can be used as
witness testimony.
You can curse your luck, but we can't let you
walk away!
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36172:
{speaker}: Hey, look!
That kid's come back!
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36173:
{speaker}: Oh, sheesh!
Didn't I tell you we're not some sideshow?
Or...
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36174:
{6a}{speaker}: Can't you get over my gorgeous
and elegant battle style?
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36175:
{speaker}: You're tough enough that I'm
willing to let you become my little brother.
Think it over, okay?
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36176:
{speaker}: Humph.
You're just a kid, but you're good at battling. {speaker}: I hate battling.
I wish you'd leave me alone.
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36177:
{speaker}: Buzz off, already.
I'm trying to project myself as a cool and
intellectual JUSTY. {speaker}: A cool and smart guy doesn't waste his time
battling.
However...
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36178:
{speaker}: It's a different story when it comes
to pests!
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36179:
{speaker}: Boy, you're persistent.
Why don't you go play somewhere else?
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36180:
{6a}{speaker}: Oh, all right.
I'll take you on just this once.
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36181:
{speaker}: Haven't you had enough?
Go somewhere and play.
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36231:
{speaker}: Hello, hello, {player}!
So good of you to come! {speaker}: Our city was saved by your
selfless actions.
I sincerely thank you! {speaker}: This is a mere token of our
appreciation.
Please accept it.
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36232:
{speaker}: I must say, you saved us in our
darkest hour.
JUSTY couldn't do a thing knowing that we were
being held hostage. {speaker}: Honestly, if you hadn't arrived,
I shudder to think what could have become
of our city.
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36255:
{speaker}: Hello, hello, {player}!
I saw you on the news driving away that
scoundrel SNATTLE. {speaker}: To prevail in battle over such
a daunting opponent...
You have my admiration!
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36261:
{speaker}: I beg your pardon?
Did you say that the S.S. LIBRA was out in the
desert? {speaker}: That must be why CIPHER
attacked our city.
They were seen transporting POKéMON from the
missing ship.
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36314:
{speaker}: Ah, {player}!
I saw the S.S. LIBRA on television! {speaker}: It simply amazes me that a huge
ship would be beached out in the desert. {speaker}: But I understand that the
POKéMON on board were already gone when the
ship was found.
That is rather worrisome...
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36320:
{speaker}: Ah, {player}.
PHENAC is at peace, and it's all because of
you, {player}. {speaker}: Did you know, {player},
about the "SHADOW incident" five years ago?
The mastermind behind that whole sordid
affair was... {speaker}: None other than the mayor of
this city! {speaker}: In public, he was a kindhearted mayor.
But his secret identity was CIPHER's boss with
visions of taking over the ORRE REGION! {speaker}: It's frightening even now!
I beg your pardon?
Me?
I'm a purely authentic and civic-minded mayor!
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36324:
There is something shiny between some books!
But it's wrong to take anything that belongs
to someone else.
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36331:
{speaker}: Oh, you found another one
of those things?
CIPHER must have run off in an awful hurry. {speaker}: They left behind all sorts of
things in their haste.
Please, if you find it useful, do take it with you.
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.36338:
{speaker}: Have you visited the REALGAM
TOWER already? {speaker}: One day, I would like to see you
in a battle, {player}.
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.54123:
There's a book titled "PHENAC CITY'S
History."
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.54191:
It's a music software player.
"Rumba of Love" is loaded.
Want to hear it?
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.54210:
It's a music software player.
"Rumba of Love" is playing.
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.54212:
It appears to be a device for playing
music software.
M1_houseA_1F/M1_houseA_1F.54213:
It's a music software player.
"Rumba of Love" is loaded. But this is no time for rumba!

M1_houseA_2F/M1_houseA_2F.36041:
Wow!
This appears to be a letter from the MAYOR
to JUSTY!
M1_houseA_2F/M1_houseA_2F.36043:
JUSTY, there is bad trouble brewing!
Of all places, our beloved PHENAC is now the
target of CIPHER! Already, CIPHER's members are secretly
taking the places of prominent members of our
community! If something's not done, the city will be taken
over by CIPHER without anyone noticing what's
happened. JUSTY, I must turn to you for help.
We need your abilities to overcome the crisis
facing our city. You, as the LEADER of the PRESTIGE PRECEPT
CENTER, should be able to do something. It may be too late, however.
Already, I feel threatened by...
M1_houseA_2F/M1_houseA_2F.36045:
{speaker}: Oh, hi, guy.
What might you be reading?
M1_houseA_2F/M1_houseA_2F.36046:
{speaker}: You're not getting the silly idea of
delivering that letter to PRE GYM's JUSTY?
M1_houseA_2F/M1_houseA_2F.36047:
{speaker}: Oh, you naughty boy!
You need to be taught a lesson for snooping!
M1_houseA_2F/M1_houseA_2F.36048:
{speaker}: You weren't supposed to find that. {speaker}: But, you know what? I think you'll
be wasting your time delivering that to JUSTY.

M1_houseB_1F/M1_houseB_1F.36021:
{speaker}: Oh?
A young traveler, are you?
It's good of you to visit. {speaker}: I wish I could be more hospitable, but my
wife's gone out and hasn't come
back yet.
M1_houseB_1F/M1_houseB_1F.36022:
{speaker}: If you're just looking for a little rest, feel free
to take a snooze in that bed there.
M1_houseB_1F/M1_houseB_1F.36023:
{speaker}: If you're bored, you can listen to some tunes.
I think there's something there.
M1_houseB_1F/M1_houseB_1F.36024:
It appears to be a MUSIC DISC with a song
by a pop idol.
M1_houseB_1F/M1_houseB_1F.36025:
{speaker}: Oh, that.
It's popular among girls, but it's not what a man
like me needs or wants. {speaker}: It seems a waste to just throw it out, so you
can have it.
Take it with you, okay? {speaker}: Oh, and if you're tired, feel free to have
a snooze in that bed there.
M1_houseB_1F/M1_houseB_1F.36026:
{speaker}: Do you remember that MUSIC DISC?
It's popular among girls, but it's not what a man
like me needs or wants. {speaker}: It seems a waste to just throw it out, so you
can have it.
Take it with you, okay?
M1_houseB_1F/M1_houseB_1F.36027: {speaker}: Where did my wife go off to, anyway?
M1_houseB_1F/M1_houseB_1F.36225:
{speaker}; Ahh, whew!
Home...
It's the best place to be. {speaker}: Huh?
Trapped underground?
What are you saying? {speaker}: I just got back from a stay at MT. BATTLE.
I haven't the faintest idea what you're trying
to say.
M1_houseB_1F/M1_houseB_1F.36226:
{speaker}: Hello, traveling kid!
My wife finally came back! {speaker}: The poor thing!
She must have been held against her will with
everyone in town. {speaker}: For the next while, I'll do the chores around
here so she can recover.
M1_houseB_1F/M1_houseB_1F.36252:
{speaker}: This is weird...
Food seems to spoil very quickly in my new
refrigerator. {speaker}: I just got it new, too.
It seems to be working properly.
I don't get it...
M1_houseB_1F/M1_houseB_1F.36253:
{speaker}: I was so surprised when I saw the news.
I didn't know we had that kind of trouble while
I was away.
M1_houseB_1F/M1_houseB_1F.36313:
{speaker}: Hi, did you hear?
They found that S.S. LIBRA in the desert! {speaker}: Lately, my husband's been doing all the
chores, so I've got time on my hands.
I wouldn't mind going to take a look for myself.
M1_houseB_1F/M1_houseB_1F.54108:
It's a bed.
Want to rest?
M1_houseB_1F/M1_houseB_1F.54110: There are many music software titles.

M1_houseC_1F/M1_houseC_1F.36227:
{speaker}: I'm finally home where I belong, and it's all
thanks to you.
I'll be forever grateful, son. {speaker}: I should tell you, CIPHER attacked PHENAC
because they're doing a recovery operation in
the desert in the north. {speaker}: I'm certainly old, but my hearing is quite fine,
thank you!
So, I eavesdropped on their furtive little chats.
M1_houseC_1F/M1_houseC_1F.36229:
{speaker}: It was really noisy!
There were so many of them roaring about in the
desert! {speaker}: There were these big trucks running back
and forth pulling big cargo. {speaker}: The people in the trucks looked really shady,
too.
It was just so weird, I just had to tell everyone! {speaker}: Want to hear it again?
M1_houseC_1F/M1_houseC_1F.36230:
{speaker}: Aww!
You don't want to hear about the trucks again?
M1_houseC_1F/M1_houseC_1F.36254:
{speaker}: I saw your heroic deed
on television!
We were so lucky to have you! {speaker}: I should tell you, CIPHER
attacked PHENAC because they're doing
a recovery operation in the desert in the north. {speaker}: I'm certainly old, but my hearing
is quite fine, thank you!
So, I eavesdropped on their furtive little chats.
M1_houseC_1F/M1_houseC_1F.36259:
{speaker}: Oh, my!
You say the S.S. LIBRA was in the northern
desert! {speaker}: That recovery operation CIPHER mentioned
must have been for the POKéMON on the
S.S. LIBRA.
M1_houseC_1F/M1_houseC_1F.36260:
{speaker}: What? What?
What was in the desert in the north?
The S.S. LIBRA? {speaker}: Was the ship making all that noise carrying
POKéMON?
M1_houseC_1F/M1_houseC_1F.36318:
{speaker}: It's all because of you that we can spend time
at home in peace and quiet.
M1_houseC_1F/M1_houseC_1F.36319:
{speaker}: Now that it's become peaceful, I feel like I'm
missing something.
I wonder if there's anything exciting going on? {speaker}: I might go out to the REALGAM TOWER and
try my luck at BATTLE BINGO.
M1_houseC_1F/M1_houseC_1F.36323:
There is something shiny between some books!
But it's wrong to take anything that belongs
to someone else.
M1_houseC_1F/M1_houseC_1F.36327:
{speaker}: Oh!
What is that?
What's something like that doing in my place? {speaker}: Is it maybe...?
Did CIPHER leave it behind?
M1_houseC_1F/M1_houseC_1F.36328:
{speaker}: Bah...
It makes me uncomfortable knowing those
CIPHER crooks lived here even a short while.
M1_houseC_1F/M1_houseC_1F.36329:
{speaker}: If that's useful to you, then you should take it.
We're all counting on you to defeat CIPHER for
good.
M1_houseC_1F/M1_houseC_1F.54126:
There's a book titled "Run Like a Stampede
and Flee Like a BEEDRILL."

M1_out/M1_out.36001:
{speaker}: Welcome to PHENAC!
And, hooray!
Congratulations! {speaker}: Incredible as it may seem, you're exactly the
one millionth visitor to PHENAC! {speaker}: In commemoration, please accept this: a DISC
CASE which already comes with some
BATTLE CDs!
M1_out/M1_out.36002:
{speaker}: Okay!
You should take that to the REALGAM TOWER
next to the town.
Go, go, go!
M1_out/M1_out.36003:
{speaker}: Oh, you're back already?
You should have gone off to play at the
REALGAM TOWER forever...
M1_out/M1_out.36004: {speaker}: This uniform's too tight on me.
M1_out/M1_out.36005:
{speaker}: This is all there was that fit me, though. {speaker}: Uh...
It's nothing... I was just thinking out loud.
M1_out/M1_out.36007:
{speaker}: Hup, two!
Hup, two! {speaker}: Huh?
You're looking for the MAYOR's house?
Um... Where is it, now...
M1_out/M1_out.36009:
{speaker}: You say you've come from PYRITE? {speaker}: When I was young, I often battled in the
town's square.
It brings back memories.
M1_out/M1_out.36010:
{speaker}: Oh?
Have I seen a TV cameraman and a reporter? {speaker}: Not me.
I'm not interested in that sort of thing.
M1_out/M1_out.36011:
{speaker}: Sorry, kid.
We're not open today. {speaker}: Shops need to take holidays, too, right?
Ahahaha!
M1_out/M1_out.36012:
{speaker}: The MAYOR's house?
It's right over there.
M1_out/M1_out.36013:
{speaker}: Now that you mention it, I haven't seen him
around lately.
Has he gone away on vacation?
M1_out/M1_out.36014:
{speaker}: Isn't this one fine town? {speaker}: We'll be living here for a long time, I figure.
It's awesome.
Isn't that right, ABSOL?
M1_out/M1_out.36016:
{speaker}: The REALGAM TOWER is a top battling facility
where TRAINERS can enjoy BATTLE SIMs, among
other events, using BATTLE CDs. {speaker}: Off you go!
Have a good time!
M1_out/M1_out.36017:
{speaker}: Hi, are you a visitor?
Oh, so you're traveling. {speaker}: This is the PRESTIGE PRECEPT CENTER,
but everyone just calls it PRE GYM. {speaker}: The LEADER is JUSTY.
He's very skilled, and he's a great person.
Everyone looks up to him!
M1_out/M1_out.36018:
{speaker}: Hello, youngster.
The STADIUM up ahead is no longer in use. {speaker}: Ever since the REALGAM TOWER went up,
all the battles have been held there.
M1_out/M1_out.36050:
{speaker}: Oh, no!
CIPHER has infiltrated this city? {speaker}: Tch!
Our cover's blown already!
M1_out/M1_out.36051:
{speaker}: You should have just stayed happily
entertained at the REALGAM TOWER!
M1_out/M1_out.36053:
{6a}{speaker}: You should have just stayed happily
entertained at the REALGAM TOWER!
M1_out/M1_out.36054:
{speaker}: Sounds like things are getting hectic here.
I'm guessing that our cover's been blown. {speaker}: I'd say it's about time!
I needed to get out of this tight outfit anyway!
M1_out/M1_out.36055:
{speaker}: Heheh!
I can move freely again!
Now I can battle without feeling squashed!
M1_out/M1_out.36056:
{speaker}: Heh, you've figured out who we are now,
right?
M1_out/M1_out.36057:
{6a}{speaker}: Heheh!
I can move freely again!
Now I can battle without feeling squashed!
M1_out/M1_out.36058:
{speaker}: Uh-oh...
What's your hurry?
Why so rushed? {speaker}: Hah?
You're asking me if I'm a fake? {speaker}: How rude of you!
How could there be any fake as handsome as
me, I ask you!
M1_out/M1_out.36059:
{speaker}: Help me!
POKéMON are chasing after me! {speaker}: Huh?
You'll help me? {speaker}: Why, thanks!
But you should be worried about yourself first!
M1_out/M1_out.36061:
{speaker}: What?
You want to help me again?
M1_out/M1_out.36062:
{6a}{speaker}: Why, thanks!
But you should be worried about yourself first!
M1_out/M1_out.36063:
{speaker}: I'm sorry, lad.
The shop's closed today. {speaker}: What's that?!
You're taking on CIPHER in town?! {speaker}: I bet you could use an item for healing your
POKéMON.
I'll tell you what!
M1_out/M1_out.36064:
{speaker}: I'm sure you'll get something if you can
beat me!
M1_out/M1_out.36065:
{speaker}: Okay, okay.
You really want that useful item, don't you?
M1_out/M1_out.36066:
{6a}{speaker}: I'm sure you'll get something if
you can beat me!
M1_out/M1_out.36067:
{speaker}: Oh, now look here!
That look you're giving me says it all!
It says you know my real identity! {speaker}: Guess what?
You're right!
M1_out/M1_out.36068:
{speaker}: There are many things that you'll be better off
not knowing, little boy!
M1_out/M1_out.36069:
{speaker}: I'll admit you do have guts to come back after
learning my identity.
M1_out/M1_out.36070:
{6a}{speaker}: You'll see that you were better
off not knowing, little boy!
M1_out/M1_out.36071:
{speaker}: Whoa, whoa, whoa...
A whole bunch of JUSTYS popped out! {speaker}: It would take someone as good as JUSTY to
pull off a DOUBLE TEAM himself!
He's so awesome!
M1_out/M1_out.36072:
{speaker}: You're kidding?!
There was an impostor pretending to be JUSTY? {speaker}: So that weird guy that went running off toward
the STADIUM--he must have been the fake!
M1_out/M1_out.36073:
{speaker}: I saw a bunch of odd-looking people come
tearing out of the MAYOR's place. {speaker}: Oh?! They were CIPHER?!
You must be joking...
Is the MAYOR all right?!
M1_out/M1_out.36074:
{speaker}: Huh?
You're looking at me with suspicion, aren't you?
M1_out/M1_out.36075:
{speaker}: Uhyahyahya!
Well, aren't you the good judge of character!
M1_out/M1_out.36076:
{speaker}: Huh?
Are you still eyeing me with suspicion?
M1_out/M1_out.36077:
{6a}{speaker}: Uhyahyahya!
You remain a good judge of character!
M1_out/M1_out.36078:
{speaker}: Bah!
Looks like our secret's out of the bag already! {speaker}: We didn't want any attention until our recovery
operation was done, but it's too late for that
now!
M1_out/M1_out.36079:
{speaker}: Whoops!
Did I say recovery operation?
Don't you worry about it!
It's got nothing to do with you!
M1_out/M1_out.36080:
{speaker}: Looks like our secret's out of
the bag already! {speaker}: We didn't want any attention until
our recovery operation was done, but it's too
late for that now!
M1_out/M1_out.36118:
{speaker}: Oh, hi!
How was it?
The REALGAM TOWER, I mean. {speaker}: Huh?
You haven't gone yet?
Oh, you don't know what you're missing! {speaker}: It's not even out of your way or anything.
Go enjoy yourself at the REALGAM TOWER. I'm
sure you'll love it! {speaker}: Off you go for a good time!
M1_out/M1_out.36120:
{speaker}: The JUSTY who was at PRE GYM was a fake,
wasn't he? {speaker}: Where is the real JUSTY, then?
M1_out/M1_out.36144:
{speaker}: We are all JUSTY!
We are! We are!
People all look up to us!
For we are the JUSTY GANG!
M1_out/M1_out.36152:
{speaker}: When we all look this much alike, even I,
your own brother, can't tell any of us apart... {speaker}: Everyone knows why we're here?
Our job is to confound any enemies that stumble
onto us here. {speaker}: We'll all scatter and deflect attention away
from PRE GYM. {speaker}: If my plan works, we may be in line for an
ADMIN position!
...Maybe.
M1_out/M1_out.36153:
{speaker}: Brothers!
May you undertake your orders with pride
and diligence!
To your positions!
M1_out/M1_out.36154:
{speaker}: Oh!
I've seen that kid before...
Wasn't that at the desert LAB?
M1_out/M1_out.36155:
{speaker}: ...No, my mistake!
I'm JUSTY now, hahaha!
I couldn't have seen him!
M1_out/M1_out.36156:
{speaker}: Hi, there!
I'm JUSTY and I brawl for justice!
If it's advice you need, I'm here for you,
my friend! {speaker}: Huh?
A LAB? In the desert, you say?
I don't have the faintest idea.
...You don't believe me.
M1_out/M1_out.36157:
{speaker}: You little snoop!
Why can't you just let certain things slide by?
M1_out/M1_out.36158:
{speaker}: Hi, I'm JUSTY!
If it's advice you need, I'm here for you,
my friend.
M1_out/M1_out.36159:
{6a}{speaker}: ...Right, okay.
That ruse doesn't work with you.
M1_out/M1_out.36161:
{speaker}: Yeah, I'm JUSTY.
I'm the toughest of the toughs, and the most
popular guy in all PHENAC besides! {speaker}: In other words, I look just like JUSTY even
without putting on a disguise!
M1_out/M1_out.36162:
{speaker}: Look at me!
I look cool like JUSTY, eh?
Come on, I'll take you on!
M1_out/M1_out.36163:
{speaker}: I'm tougher than JUSTY, who seems to be
some pop idol!
M1_out/M1_out.36164:
{6a}{speaker}: I'm saying this only because
I really am cool!
M1_out/M1_out.36165:
{speaker}: When I get serious, the
consequences could be really bad.
That's why I took it easy on you!
M1_out/M1_out.36182:
{speaker}: You're too young a kid to understand this,
but women, they like snooty kinds of cool guys. {speaker}: So I figured by impersonating JUSTY, I'd be
a homing beacon to the ladies, but...
M1_out/M1_out.36183:
{speaker}: All the women here are my comrades
in arms!
They all know me!
There's no point in chatting them up!
M1_out/M1_out.36184:
{speaker}: I'm tired of acting all snooty and cool when
it's not helping me attract any ladies!
M1_out/M1_out.36185:
{6a}{speaker}: If I push you around,
I think I'll feel a whole lot better.
Here goes!
M1_out/M1_out.36186:
{speaker}: You're just a kid!
You're too strong for one!
M1_out/M1_out.36187:
{speaker}: I'm JUSTY!
My fellowship is six!
So there are also six JUSTYS! {speaker}: There are six of us, so our sense of presence
is sixfold!
Our appeal is sixfold, too!
We're not just bit players!
M1_out/M1_out.36188:
{speaker}: Come on, kid.
I'll take you with my sixfold power!
M1_out/M1_out.36189:
{speaker}: Fufufu, kid.
I'm not just some ordinary JUSTY no one
notices.
M1_out/M1_out.36190:
{6a}{speaker}: Come on, kid!
I'll take you on with presence and appeal
boosted sixfold!
Oh, and power boosted six fold, too!
M1_out/M1_out.36191:
{speaker}: You haven't seen anything of
our brotherly love yet!
M1_out/M1_out.36193:
{speaker}: What did CIPHER want to keep secret so much
that they would imprison us all?
M1_out/M1_out.36194:
{speaker}: Oh!
Could it be...that they're building a new base in
the northern desert?
M1_out/M1_out.36195:
{speaker}: Thanks to you, we got out from that
cooped-up place.
My AZUMARILL's delighted, too!
M1_out/M1_out.36196: {speaker}: By the way, have you heard about the desert?
M1_out/M1_out.36197:

{speaker}: It's amazing.
They pulled a caper of this scale so brazenly in
broad daylight... {speaker}: If this incident is any
indication, it appears certain that CIPHER will
become even more active in the days to come.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37250:
{speaker}: Oh, {player}!
I hope MARCIA is safe...
I'm so worried...
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37252:
{speaker}: Even though I had that horribly scary time
here, I still love visiting ONBS.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37253:
{speaker}: Looks like it'll take more time before we can
get our database back together. {speaker}: Those rotten CIPHER cretins...
They sure made a huge mess of things.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37254: {speaker}: I'm worried about MARCIA... {speaker}: Oh, and CAMERAN, the cameraman, too.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37255:
{speaker}: Wow, RAZELL and DAZELL were good,
but KANDEE here has a spark of her own, too. {speaker}: We need to begin filming her as soon as our
system is back up.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37256:
{speaker}: Please listen!
It's my daughter singing now!
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37257:
{speaker}: When it's sunny, SOLARBEAM~♪
When it's rainy, HYDRO PUMP~♪
POKé POKé POKéMON are so cute~♪ {speaker}: In case of paralysis,
PARLYZ HEAL~♪
For sleepyheads there's AWAKENING~♪
POKé POKé POKéMON are so fun~♪ {speaker}: If you're feeling hungry,
there are LEFTOVERS~♪
And quench your thirst with MOOMOO MILK~♪
POKé POKé POKéMON bring so much joy~♪
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37258:
{speaker}: I hope you'll learn the song
and sing along with me.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37280:
{speaker}: Oh, {player}!
Thanks to you, MARCIA returned safe
and sound! {speaker}: She's right back into her
high-energy work mode and high-spirited ways.
I admire her.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37281:
{speaker}: With NETT providing sure tech advice, it looks
good that we'll recover the data CIPHER deleted
on us.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37282:
{speaker}: You've been busy, haven't you?
You saved MEGG, MARCIA, and everyone in
PHENAC CITY, too. {speaker}: I should develop a new program series
modeled after you.
Don't you think that's a terrific concept?
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37283:
{speaker}: Wow, RAZELL and DAZELL were good,
but KANDEE here has a spark of her own, too.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37297:
{speaker}: Oh, {player}!
We've been expecting you! {speaker}: The person who needs your
help finding the lost POKéMON is in my brother
NETT's room on the roof.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37329:
{speaker}: Oh, {player}!
Have you met the owner of the missing
POKéMON? {speaker}: It breaks my heart seeing that
little girl's sad expression.
I hope the POKéMON is found soon!
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37343:
{speaker}: Oh, {player}!
I saw you on the news! {speaker}: I heard about you from
MARCIA, of course, but I didn't realize that you
did so much!
I'm simply stunned!
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37344:
{speaker}: I've got to hand it to NETT.
We recovered all the deleted data without
a hitch. {speaker}: ONBS is 100% back in business!
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37345:
{speaker}: I'm planning on developing a program series
modeled after you.
I've already come up with a title. {speaker}: "{player} on the March--the Dawning of
ORRE's New Era is at Hand!" {speaker}: Isn't that a great title?
I'm confident that the series will be a big hit.
I expect big things from it!
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37365:
{speaker}: {player}, welcome!
My brother NETT's in his room as usual. {speaker}: I hope you find that lost
POKéMON for the little girl and her grandpa soon.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37388:
{speaker}: {player}, welcome!
Oh?
There's something about you...
Something's different. {speaker}: Did you change your
hairstyle?
Or is it your outfit?
Um... What could it be?
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37396:
{speaker}: Welcome to ONBS! {speaker}: {player}, I love how
you're always full of energy!
I can learn something from you.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37462: There is something shiny between some books.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37463:
{speaker}: That's a BATTLE CD.
Do you know what BATTLE SIMs are?
Hahaha, I guess you wouldn't yet.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37466: There is an empty case between some books.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37467:
{speaker}: Oh, hey, little dude.
Do you like BATTLE SIMs?
If you'd like, you're welcome to take that
BATTLE CD, and... {speaker}: Oh, wait a second.
There's no BATTLE CD in the case.
That's strange. Is someone using it?
I'll find it for you by the next visit.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37468:
{speaker}: Sorry, little dude.
I haven't found that BATTLE CD yet.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37483:
{speaker}: Hi, kid.
Do you like BATTLE SIMs?
That's excellent to hear. {speaker}: We're too busy at ONBS, so we don't get to go
very often.
If you play, you can take that with you.
Don't worry about it!
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37484:
{speaker}: Oh, yes.
We got our missing BATTLE CD back.
You can have it if you'd like. {speaker}: We're too busy here to go very often, if at all.
So go ahead, take it.
There's nothing to worry about.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37495:
{speaker}: Welcome to ONBS! {speaker}: SECC and his people have been
very busy after you told them that CITADARK
ISLE is CIPHER's base. {speaker}: Of course, {player}, I bet
you're terribly busy, too.
I hope you succeed.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37501:
{speaker}: ...Whoops.
I don't have the time to waste, sorry!
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37502:
{speaker}: We broadcast TV signals all
across the ORRE REGION.
I hope you'll take the time to see how we work.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37503:
{speaker}: You're welcome to wander 
throughout the BUILDING and observe how ONBS
operates.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37508:
{speaker}: Oh, {player}!
You came for us?!
Thank you! {speaker}: Please have a look at this
SHROOMISH.
It's had no energy at all lately.
What could be wrong with it?
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37510:
{player} made SHROOMISH listen to
the VOICE CASE.
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37513:
{speaker}: Oh, the SHROOMISH cried!
I'm so glad!
{player}, thank you!
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.37514:
{speaker}: This phenomenon has been seen
among POKéMON in places like GATEON PORT
and PHENAC, too. {speaker}: I wonder what is going on?
I hope all the afflicted POKéMON get well soon...
M2_building_1F/M2_building_1F.54146:
There's a book titled "The Battle of the Kids:
from the KIDS NETWORK to ONBS."

M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37091:
{speaker}: Aack!
Did you hear me?
Oh, no!
It's so embarrassing! {speaker}: That was the ONBS song that I composed.
It's catchy and memorable, don't you think?
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37092:
{speaker}: Hi, welcome to ONBS.
The name's SECC.
I'm supposed to be in charge here.
I'm glad to meet you. {6a}{speaker}: Started by kids five years
ago during the "SHADOW incident," a tiny
network has grown into this today. {speaker}: I operate this place with my
partner, NETT.
We're convinced that reporting the unvarnished
truth will be for the good of peace and justice. {speaker}: Anyways, did you want
something from me?
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37093:
{player} passed on PROF. KRANE's message
to SECC.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37094:
{speaker}: You're kidding!
CIPHER was using its desert lab again? {speaker}: Okay, understood.
You should take that DATA ROM and show it to
NETT right away. {speaker}: I'm sure he can decipher
whatever information is stored on that
DATA ROM.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37095:
{speaker}: After fighting against CIPHER
five years ago, we decided a free press that
reports the truth was necessary to protect the
peace and justice of people. {speaker}: That's why NETT and I
founded the ONBS. {speaker}: It's not an easy job to report
the unvarnished truth in a fair manner.
In a way, this is a battle, too.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37096:
{speaker}: NETT's a guy you can count on.
You won't have a thing to worry about where
he's concerned.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37097:
{speaker}: I'm hoping to put together a new POKéMON
battle program.
I'm gathering information for it. {speaker}: I'm trying to decide on the star.
Hmm... {speaker}: Since it is a program about battling, I suppose
the legendary TRAINER EAGUN would be the
logical choice.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37099:
We bring you a special news bulletin! PROF. KRANE, the abducted head of the
POKéMON HQ LAB, has been safely rescued! PROF. KRANE had been held captive in CIPHER's
desert research facility, which was widely
believed to have been abandoned. Reports say that PROF. KRANE was rescued by
a lone teen. This incident is evidence that CIPHER has
returned after apparently being crushed five
years ago. The authorities fear that CIPHER's return could
result in more serious incidents.
Citizens are urged to be vigilant and cautious.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37100:
{speaker}: That's a wrap!
Good job, ANCHA.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37101:
{speaker}: It might be hard to imagine, but when ANCHA
was starting out, she was prone to on-air
disasters. {speaker}: Now look at her.
She's become ONBS's top newscaster.
There's absolutely no question about that
these days.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37102: {speaker}: ANCHA's looking great like she always does.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37103:
{speaker}: I'm ANCHA.
I'm a newscaster here at ONBS.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37104:
{6a}{speaker}: My job is to deliver the news
to as many people as possible. {speaker}: When I was starting out, I did
experience some close calls.
But still, I find this job to be fulfilling.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37105:
{speaker}: Waaaah!
I don't know where my mommy is! {speaker}: Please!
Can you help me find my mommy?
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37106:
{speaker}: Yay, thank you!
I wonder where my mommy went?
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37168:
{speaker}: Oh, sweetie, I was waiting
for you.
You can bring it on.
I don't go easy on little kids.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37169:
{speaker}: Humph!
All you need to do is answer our questions.
If you comply, you won't get hurt.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37170:
{speaker}: Hold it, punk.
You shouldn't be snooping around!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37171:
{speaker}: Ouch...
I didn't expect CIPHER to pull a stunt this bold or
reckless...
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37172:
{speaker}: They came looking for NETT.
I'm guessing that your DATA ROM contains
sensitive information that they want to keep
secret at all costs. {speaker}: I'll be fine.
I'm worried about NETT, though.
Please go to him.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37173:
{speaker}: It was terrible!
They suddenly barged in here and started
beating SECC up.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37174:
{speaker}: We drove those freaky thugs out with some
unfriendly persuasion. {speaker}: Can you imagine the nerve of them?
Coming after defenseless women like me!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37175:
{speaker}: Heheheh!
ANCHA, you're a doll!
I see your pretty face on TV all the time. {speaker}: But, you know?
You're a lot prettier in person than on TV.
Heheheh.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37176:
{speaker}: W-what?
Who are you?! {speaker}: I'm getting ANCHA's
autograph!
You stay out of this!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37177:
{speaker}: Darn it!
They slashed all the power cables!
We could've broadcast everything that
happened here!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37178:
{speaker}: You're our savior!
I was terrified by the thought that they might
hurt ANCHA.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37179:
{speaker}: Thanks for your help!
I don't think anyone expected the ONBS to be
made the target. {speaker}: But you watch.
We'll get this story out on the news in a big way.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37180:
{speaker}: Hahaha!
You look mystified!
You don't know how I managed to be on the
elevator with you, do you? {speaker}: I'll tell you what I did...
I braced myself flat up against the ceiling! {speaker}: It takes a lot of strength!
Not bad, huh?
I demand your respect!
And now, we battle!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37220:
{speaker}: I keep telling him not to move, but he just
won't listen.
He is so obstinate!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37221:
{speaker}: What's that?!
CIPHER is going to attack PHENAC?! {speaker}: Not good!
We've got to get MARCIA to come back!
Owowowow!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37222:
{speaker}: Darn it!
I'd go myself, but they worked me over pretty
darn thoroughly. {speaker}: {player}, please.
Can you go help MARCIA?
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37259:
{speaker}: What?!
CIPHER is already in PHENAC?
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37261:
{speaker}: This isn't good...
The situation is far more serious than
we had imagined. {speaker}: MARCIA is really determined.
Once she sets off to do something, she won't
give up easily.
It's an admirable trait, but...
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37262:
{speaker}: Against CIPHER, her
dedication could endanger her. {speaker}: {player}, please!
We need you to help MARCIA.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37263: {speaker}: I hope MARCIA will be okay...
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37264:
{speaker}: Those CIPHER creeps...
They even cut our power cables.
The rotten swine!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37265:
{speaker}: If they hadn't cut power to our cameras, we
could've gotten an incredible scoop.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37266:
{speaker}: We'll start running the news
again when ONBS's systems are 
restored.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37284:
{speaker}: I heard all about you from MARCIA!
You were truly heroic, it sounds like!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37285:
{speaker}: Thanks for saving MARCIA! {speaker}: If it hadn't been for you,
both ONBS and PHENAC would have fallen under
CIPHER's control. {speaker}: I intend to see CIPHER off
properly in due time.
They have to be made to pay for their crimes. {speaker}: But we're journalists.
We'll chase and corner CIPHER in our own way--
a way that's different from yours. {speaker}: I hope you'll watch how ONBS
does things.
The truth can change the world.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37286:
{speaker}: I intend to see CIPHER off
properly in due time.
They have to be made to pay for their crimes. {speaker}: I hope you'll watch how ONBS
does things.
The truth can change the world.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37287:
{speaker}: MARCIA's next door.
I think she's editing the footage they shot and
writing her story. {speaker}: She's doing that even after getting caught up
in a serious incident.
She's one dedicated journalist!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37288:
{speaker}: Oh, hello!
Thank you for rescuing me. {speaker}: I'm editing footage of what
happened in PHENAC for the news. {speaker}: As soon as the story's ready,
we'll be broadcasting it on TV.
Look for it, okay?
Because you're the hero!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37289:
{speaker}: Oh, hello!
Thanks for everything in PHENAC! {speaker}: I feared the worst when
CIPHER caught us, but it turned out great.
We're stoked about the awesome footage
we shot!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37290:
{speaker}: We've completely repaired all the cables that
CIPHER cut on us.
We're ready to go back on the air anytime!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37291:
{speaker}: Be sure to tune in.
We'll be running a huge news story soon.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37292:
{speaker}: On our latest news story,
SECC himself is directing the production crew. {speaker}: It must be one huge story.
The atmosphere in the news studio is electric
with tension.
It's almost scary, even.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37298:
{speaker}: Hi, {player}.
I got word from NETT about you.
Go on, scoot up to the roof. {speaker}: Oh, by the way, we're almost
finished preparing the news story using the
report and footage filed by MARCIA's team.
It's shaping up to be a great story.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37299:
{speaker}: Our PHENAC news story is
shaping up beautifully. {speaker}: Of course, you're a huge part
of our story.
Look forward to the broadcast, okay?
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37330:
{speaker}: Hi, {player}.
I guess you met the people that lost their
POKéMON. {speaker}: But a lost POKéMON...
CIPHER's acts seem to be sowing misery
wherever they appear. {speaker}: We intend to settle things with
CIPHER in ONBS's own way.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37346:
{speaker}: I saw you on the news!
You did some amazing things!
Even SECC was surprised.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37347:
{speaker}: Have you seen the news?
Thanks to your exploits, we managed to get
high-impact footage right from the scene.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37348:
{speaker}: We'll keep supporting your
efforts by continually getting the truth out to our
viewers. {speaker}: That's how we fight.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37349:
{speaker}: MARCIA's in the next room.
I think she's already working on the next special
news feature. {speaker}: She's doing that even after getting caught up
in a serious incident.
She's one dedicated journalist!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37350:
{speaker}: Have you seen the news?
I told you we caught you looking dashing and
brave on film. {speaker}: Keep at it!
You've become a true hero now. {speaker}: Oh, also, I have a favor
to ask.
Please don't tell my dad, DUKING, that I was
caught up in a serious situation.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37351:
{speaker}: We're getting tons of inquiries
about our news footage. {speaker}: This might even make
me famous!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37352:
{speaker}: The news story about you was fantastic!
You're quite the guy.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37353:
{speaker}: Public response to your news story has been
overwhelming! {speaker}: We were buried by all sorts of inquiries like
"Who is that boy?" and "I want him to marry my
daughter."
It was crazy!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37354:
{speaker}: SECC's news program is so
immediate and hard hitting...
It's eye opening... {speaker}: I've got to straighten up and
work so much harder so I don't get left behind. {speaker}: I expect to see you even more
in top news stories from now on.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37366:
{speaker}: Everyone's amazed at you.
You're the talk of ONBS! {speaker}: I should write a song about you, {player}!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37368:
{speaker}: Say what?!
You discovered the S.S. LIBRA?!
That's huge news!
We've got to get a reporter out there now!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37369:
{speaker}: Wow, it would take you to find
the S.S. LIBRA!
You put our reporters to shame!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37370:
{speaker}: I'm thinking about my next
news story.
I wonder how I can dig deeper into CIPHER's
nefarious plot. {speaker}: Maybe it's time I go
undercover again and try to get the inside
scoop even if it means taking a serious risk...
...Bad idea. {speaker}: Just don't tell my dad, DUKING,
about that serious mess I got in, okay?
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37389:
{speaker}: {player}!
I'm glad you're here.
I've been waiting for you.
...Huh?! {speaker}: What happened to your left
arm?
Weren't you wearing the SNAG MACHINE on it?
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37397:
{speaker}: Great!
You managed to recover the SNAG MACHINE!
Way to go, {player}! {speaker}: But, wow...
You battled and defeated GONZAP to get it back.
You must be wickedly powerful in your own right.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37398:
{speaker}: We're depending on you.
We'll investigate TEAM SNAGEM while you're
gone.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37399:
{speaker}: That look on your face...
You're ready to infiltrate CIPHER's secret
factory, aren't you? {speaker}: {player}, knowing you,
I'm confident that you'll be all right. {speaker}: We'll have MARCIA on standby.
She'll be ready to go in and provide press
coverage whenever necessary. {speaker}: We'll corner CIPHER in our
own way.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37400:
{speaker}: The S.S. LIBRA is in the desert...
I guess it's impossible to get it out to sea again.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37401:
{speaker}: CIPHER's secret factory?
Whoa!
That's a blockbuster-class scoop! {speaker}: Please don't leak that
information to anyone before I get there.
That's a promise to keep!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37402:
{speaker}: CIPHER's secret factory...
Just hearing about that gives me the chills.
I sure don't want to go there! {speaker}: But I bet MARCIA will be all eager
to cover the scene in person.
This is so distressing...
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37409:
{speaker}: Hi, how're things with you? {speaker}: Say what?!
You not only found CIPHER's secret factory,
you also ruined it? {speaker}: Okay!
I'll give MARCIA's crew the green light to cover
that story.
She's been itching to go.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37410:
{speaker}: That MARCIA...
She's been itching to get out in the field.
I'm sure she'll get out there like a rocket. {speaker}: {player}, take care.
We'll keep supporting you by reporting the
honest truth.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37412:
{speaker}: Eek!
Did you hear that?!
Oh, no, I'm so embarrassed! {speaker}: I started composing a song about you, but it's
not coming together that well. {speaker}: I've got to watch all the news stories about
you again.
I need to get a better image of you as a person!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37420:
{speaker}: What to do...
The news crew we sent to the S.S. LIBRA hasn't
returned yet. {speaker}: I want to send them to CITADARK
ISLE undercover, but who knows where
they've gone off to. {speaker}: If I knew that this was going to
happen, I wouldn't have sent MARCIA to
investigate the SHADOW POKéMON factory.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37425:
{speaker}: SECC is in a meeting.
May I get you to return in a little while?
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37427:
{speaker}: I see...
It was TEAM SNAGEM's doing.
It's not surprising that they wanted your SNAG
MACHINE. {speaker}: Up to five years ago, TEAM
SNAGEM was in a partnership with CIPHER. {speaker}: But when they lost their SNAG
MACHINE, CIPHER gave them up as a lost cause.
I thought TEAM SNAGEM just folded after that... {speaker}: They must have spotted your
SNAG MACHINE somewhere.
Oh, my... {speaker}: I'll start investigating TEAM
SNAGEM right away.
I'll let you know as soon as we discover
anything.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37428:
{speaker}: Oh, right!
I'd forgotten completely about this E-MAIL
message I received. {speaker}: You see, ONBS got contacted
by someone who claimed to have fled from
CIPHER's base. {speaker}: We debated sending out a
news team immediately, but there's no guarantee
that it won't be a trap or another risky situation. {speaker}: I hate to impose, but could
you go and investigate for us, {player}?
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37429:
{speaker}: That's not what I was hoping for.
I thought this would be the perfect job for you,
{player}. {speaker}: Please, we need your help.
Please reconsider!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37430:
{speaker}: Thank you.
We know that you can be entrusted with this,
{player}. {speaker}: The man who contacted us is
named HORDEL.
He said he'll be at the OUTSKIRT STAND.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37431:
{speaker}: HORDEL is supposed to be at
the OUTSKIRT STAND.
Could I get you to meet him, if even just
to talk? {speaker}: While you're off talking to
him, we'll keep busy getting information on
TEAM SNAGEM.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37432:
{speaker}: Hi, {player}.
Did you meet with that man HORDEL? {speaker}: Hmhm...
He said a SHADOW POKéMON factory?
This could be a huge story... {speaker}: Thank you very much.
But I think I'll keep this from MARCIA until we
get a little better picture. {speaker}: ...She's prone to dashing
headlong into trouble without any heed for the
consequences.
I can't let her out of my sight!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37433:
{speaker}: Oh, yes.
I sent you an E-MAIL message about TEAM
SNAGEM's whereabouts.
Have you read it? {speaker}: It turns out that they're still
holed up in the hideout they were using before.
They don't seem to learn from past mistakes.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37434:
{speaker}: Poor SECC.
That whole incident in PHENAC really seemed to
affect him badly. {speaker}: Being ONBS's chief, he couldn't run off to
rescue someone dear to him when she was in
danger. {speaker}: If I were SECC, I wouldn't have been able
to stand it!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37486:
{speaker}: Oh, that?
It's something CIPHER dropped in their haste to
escape.
You're welcome to it, if you'd like.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37500:
{speaker}: Hi, {player}!
I heard from PROF. KRANE about how you
rescued a lot of POKéMON. {speaker}: Let us do an in-depth profile on
you soon, okay?
We'll be looking forward to it.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37506:
{speaker}: MARCIA's gone off to check out CIPHER's
SHADOW POKéMON factory. {speaker}: She's a journalist through and through!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37507: The little girl joined the party.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.37526:
{speaker}: You're still keeping at it!
I really look forward to reporting on your latest
exploits!
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.54152: There's a book titled "Peace and Justice."
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.54154: There's a book titled "Truth and Journalism."
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.54156:
Monolithic computers are lined up.
The whirring of motors can be heard.
M2_building_2F/M2_building_2F.54157:
The motors have fallen silent.
The computers appear to have stopped.

M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37109:
{speaker}: Man, is she slow...
How long is she going to keep me waiting?
Grrr... {speaker}: I'm supposed to be out covering a story with
our oldest veteran reporter, but she takes
forever getting ready every time. {speaker}: The day will be done at this rate!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37110:
{speaker}: I know that I still have my looks, but when I'm
going before the TV camera, I have to be extra
careful with my makeup.
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37111:
{speaker}: Oh... This isn't going well.
I have to go on the air soon, but my KANDEE
hasn't come back...
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37115:
{speaker}: Oh, am I glad to see you!
I was worried about you!
You seemed to just disappear!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37116:
{speaker}: I'm sorry, Mommy!
I went out of your room for just a minute, but
then I couldn't find it again. {speaker}: That guy there brought me here!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37117:
{speaker}: Oh, my!
How very kind of you!
Thank you!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37118:
{speaker}: When I was lost, I felt really
lonesome, Mommy. {speaker}: I'm so glad we found you,
Mommy!
Thank you, too!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37119:
{speaker}: Sincerely, thank you.
This is just a small token of my appreciation.
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37120: {player} received a SOOTHE BELL as thanks.
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37121:
{speaker}: KANDEE has to go into the studio to tape
a music program. {speaker}: I'm sure it will be aired soon.
When it is, I hope you'll tune in and see her sing.
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37122:
{speaker}: This is where we keep sets and props.
We can't have you getting hurt here, so out you
go, all right?
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37123:
{speaker}: Keeping information as data is fine, but I also
like seeing it kept in printed form on paper. {speaker}: You see, I enjoy the feel of paper as I flip
the pages.
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37181:
{speaker}: You lot!
One peep out of you, and you'll be sorry!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37183:
{speaker}: We were alone, my daughter and I.
We had no idea what would become of us.
Thank you very, very much!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37184:
{speaker}: Yay!
Thank you for saving us!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37185:
{speaker}: I'm pretty darn tough, I tell you!
Be ready to be creamed!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37186:
{speaker}: Hey, now!
This is where we keep our props.
We can't have you getting hurt here, so beat it!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37187:
{speaker}: Uh-huh.
I wonder who's going to be the one hurting?
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37188:
{speaker}: Huh?
What do you want, kid?!
Stay out of the way if you don't want to get hurt!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37189:
{speaker}: What was that all about?
I thought they were filming some special effects
scenes!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37190:
{speaker}: My goodness, what a racket.
I wish they'd keep things a little quieter.
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37267:
{speaker}: We finished covering the POKé SPOTS, and we
need to move on to our next assignment, but...
POFTY's acting up, like usual...
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37268:
{speaker}: When one gets to be as
popular as I am, things become different.
I may still be a newscaster, but I feel like a star
actress.
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37269:
{speaker}: I hope our dance routine will
become popular on TV!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37270:
{speaker}: Ouch...
I think I overdid it dancing.
My feet hurt now.
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37271:
{speaker}: Ah, youngster!
Would you care to hear some amazing news?
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37272:
{speaker}: Hold on to your hat!
The ONBS was attacked by CIPHER! {speaker}: ...
You don't seem to be very surprised...
How dull.
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37273:
{speaker}: Oh, don't be that way!
Humor me and hear me out!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37355:
{speaker}: When I go out to cover a story with POFTY,
it takes more time waiting for her to get ready.
It's a drag.
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37356:
{speaker}: I'll work hard on my next
story, too.
I'm going to own the number-one viewer rating,
just you watch!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37357:
{speaker}: You say that you were on the news, son? {speaker}: Well, it's only a news program.
I've been in the news, too. {speaker}: I took a tumble over a cliff when I was
still half asleep.
It was quite spectacular!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37464: There is something shiny between some books.
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37465:
{speaker}: Hey, hey!
We can't have you touching stuff without
permission!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37472:
{speaker}: Hey, now!
This is where we keep sets and props.
It's not safe, so scram...
Huh? A BATTLE CD? {speaker}: This room is only for big stuff!
It's no place for something that small.
Kid, go ahead, take it!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37493:
{speaker}: Dear, can't you see that a lady is getting
ready?
Please don't come in any closer.
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.37494:
{speaker}: Hey, hey!
We can't have you wandering around here!
It's not safe.
Come on, out you go!
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.54159:
There's a book titled "Survival in the
Paperless Era."
M2_building_3F/M2_building_3F.54162:
There's a book titled "News Reporting and 
Newscasting Beauties."

M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37131:
{speaker}: Heheh, I'm called BITT.
Glad to meet you.
NETT's over there.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37132:
{speaker}: Hello, I've been expecting you.
You're {player}, right?
I'm NETT.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37133:
{6a}{speaker}: And this is BITT.
He's my friend and an invaluable partner.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37135:
{speaker}: Oh?
I heard that you were alone.
Did you bring your little sister with you?
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37136:
{speaker}: We heard from PROF. KRANE.
Sounds like you pulled off a daring rescue.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37137:
{speaker}: Yes, BITT, but now's not the
time to waste chatting.
Let's see the data PROF. KRANE called about.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37138: {player} handed the DATA ROM to NETT.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37139:
{speaker}: I've deciphered something
similar to this before.
It brings back memories. {speaker}: Okay...
I think it's going to take some time for me to
check the contents of this DATA ROM. {speaker}: Can you wait while I do that?
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37140:
{speaker}: Hey, NETT!
How's this for an idea?
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37141:
{speaker}: Hey, that's good.
Good suggestion, BITT.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37142:
{speaker}: Are you interested in wild
POKéMON?
It wouldn't hurt to go look, you know.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37143:
{speaker}: Oh, yes.
May I have your P★DA number?
I'll contact you as soon as I find anything out.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37144: {player} gave the P★DA number to NETT.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37145:
{speaker}: Thank you.
I'll try to decipher this as quickly as possible.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37146:
{speaker}: Heh, it's your fault for being
in my way. {speaker}: But I've got what I came for.
I don't need to stick around when I've got this
DATA ROM.
Adios!
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37147:
{speaker}: Okay, {player}.
Go out to the POKé SPOT and wait for me
to call.
Who knows, you may see some wild POKéMON.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37148:
{speaker}: The POKé SPOT that DUKING
discovered is outside of town and to the east.
That's where wild POKéMON have appeared.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37150:
{speaker}: Our news team should be out
visiting DUKING at one of his POKé SPOTS to file
a story about wild POKéMON. {speaker}: Since he's got free time, why
not have him go visit DUKING as well?
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37151:
{speaker}: By the way, BITT.
Where is our news team?
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37195:
{speaker}: Now, hand over our DATA ROM! {speaker}: Of all the people it could've ended up with,
it had to be with you, NETT, the wiz of data
analysis.
It wouldn't do to let you keep it.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37196:
{speaker}: ...All right.
Keep your hands off my sister.
The DATA ROM is right here...
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37197:
{speaker}: Good boy!
You catch on real quick.
Toss me that DATA ROM nice and easy now.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37198:
{speaker}: Heh...
Okay, I'll thank you for returning the DATA ROM. {speaker}: By the way...
Let me guess.
Are you maybe thinking it doesn't matter because
you've already copied the data on this?
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37199:
{speaker}: CAPTAIN!
We've finished completely scrubbing data from
ONBS's servers.
It's all gone, sir.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37201:
{speaker}: Waahahaha!
That's why I'm not worried!
It's heartbreaking, isn't it?! {speaker}: Well, thanks for being such a great host,
but we've got to go.
Here's your sister back.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37204:
{speaker}: Hunh?
What are you doing there, punk? {speaker}: I hate to be rude, but I've got no time to lose.
Get out of my way!
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37205:
{speaker}: Drat!
I didn't see this coming. {speaker}: But I've got what I came for.
I don't need to stick around when I've got this
DATA ROM.
Adios!
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37206:
{speaker}: You sent those horrible
people running!
Sincerely, thank you!
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37207:
{speaker}: Those horrible people left.
It's because of your determination.
Thank you.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37208:
{speaker}: By the sound of it, they must
think that we haven't managed to check out the
contents of that DATA ROM yet. {speaker}: Faulty assumption.
They shouldn't underestimate NETT here!
Heheh.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37209:
{speaker}: Oh, {player}!
Are you okay?!
You got us out of that jam!
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37210:
{speaker}: But not all the data analysis
was finished...
Tch!
Those CIPHER creeps!
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37211:
{speaker}: Still, from what we did manage
to decrypt, a part of CIPHER's criminal plans
became clear. {speaker}: For instance, CIPHER was
behind the disappearance of that cargo ship,
the S.S. LIBRA. {speaker}: There's more.
CIPHER is planning a major attack on
PHENAC CITY.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37212:
{speaker}: Oh, no, NETT!
Is that true? {speaker}: MARCIA's gone off to
PHENAC CITY!
She said she was going to investigate why the
town's communication systems are down.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37213:
{speaker}: What?!
CIPHER could attack there at any time!
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37214:
{speaker}: {player}, we need your help.
Please, could you inform the MAYOR of PHENAC
CITY about CIPHER's coming attack?
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37215:
{speaker}: Whoa, whoa!
Don't you want to know what was on that
DATA ROM?
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37216:
{speaker}: I'll do my best to recover the
precious data that they deleted.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37217:
{speaker}: In PHENAC CITY, there's a guy
named JUSTY who's the LEADER of the
PRESTIGE PRECEPT CENTER. {speaker}: Try to hook up with him.
I'm sure he'll be eager to help you stop CIPHER
from attacking his town.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37274:
{speaker}: What?!
CIPHER's already infiltrated PHENAC?! {speaker}: That's terrible news.
We've got to do something...
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37275:
{speaker}: I see...
I'm worried about the MAYOR, the people of
PHENAC, and of course MARCIA... {speaker}: Please go back to PHENAC
and keep an eye on what's happening there.
We really need your help on this.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37294:
{speaker}: I heard!
Even PRE GYM's JUSTY was caught and held
hostage, wasn't he? {speaker}: Then you rode in and solved
things just like that.
You're even more awesome than I imagined!
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37295:
{speaker}: Hi, {player}!
Thank you so much for helping MARCIA. {speaker}: We've been making good
progress at recovering the deleted data.
We're almost there, so we'll keep plugging away.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37296:
{speaker}: Yeah, we've got precious
data going back to our KIDS' GRID HQ days.
We can't lose that. {speaker}: We're not about to give up
the fight just because CIPHER managed to
sneak in.
We'll keep slugging away, all of us together!
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37300:
{speaker}: Yo, {player}!
We've been expecting you. {speaker}: That old gent there needs
help finding a missing POKéMON.
It'd be great if you could hear him out.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37301:
{speaker}: Yo!
I heard what happened in PHENAC from MARCIA.
I'm amazed that they even managed to hold
JUSTY hostage. {speaker}: By the way, that old gent came
here with his granddaughter.
He's looking for help finding a missing POKéMON. {speaker}: {player}, if you don't
mind, please hear him out.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37302:
{speaker}: These people here arrived
a while ago.
They came looking for ONBS's help.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37303:
{speaker}: They wanted our help finding
a POKéMON that went missing with the
S.S. LIBRA. {speaker}: This is where it gets exciting.
They say it's a POKéMON that's never been
discovered before.
Yow!
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37304:
{speaker}: Hi, {player}!
Thank you so much for helping MARCIA.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37305:
{speaker}: Speaking of help, these
people here came to us for some.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37306:
{speaker}: That old gent waiting there is
hoping someone will help him locate a
missing POKéMON.
Hear him out, okay?
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37307:
{speaker}: Waaaah!
BONSLY, where have you gone?
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37308:
{speaker}: I'm sorry...
I'm at my wit's end...
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37309:
{speaker}: You're familiar with the news about the ship
S.S. LIBRA's disappearance?
My granddaughter's POKéMON was on board,
and it vanished with the ship. {speaker}: The POKéMON is one I found while tending
to my garden.
It was among my tiny bonsai trees.
It's a new species, I'm certain of it! {speaker}: Please, I implore you!
Please find my missing POKéMON if only for my
granddaughter's sake!
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37310:
{speaker}: Oh, thank you!
You are so kind! {speaker}: Our POKéMON is named BONSLY.
It looks very much like a potted plant.
Please help us! {speaker}: My granddaughter has a photo of BONSLY.
Please ask her if you may see it.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37311:
{speaker}: We'll try collecting
information on our own, but to be honest,
it's like trying to find a needle in a haystack.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37312:
{speaker}: For the time being, there may
be nothing we can do but gather information
while tracking CIPHER's movements.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37313:
{speaker}: {player}?
Your clothes are covered in sand.
What happened to you?
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37314:
{player} explained what had happened in
the northern desert.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37315:
{speaker}: That's big news!
That could be CIPHER's new hideout!
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37316:
{speaker}: But it may be too difficult for
an ordinary scooter to cross the desert.
It won't be easy getting there to investigate.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37317:
{speaker}: Well, for help with something
like that, how about PERR in GATEON PORT?
If anyone can help...
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37318:
{speaker}: Oh, yes, that's it!
Good idea, BITT!
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37319:
{speaker}: PERR's an old buddy of ours.
He runs a mechanical parts shop with his
grandpa, MAKAN. {speaker}: Huh? You know the guy?
Well, then we can cut right to the chase!
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37320:
{speaker}: I'll get in touch with him.
I'm sure he'll come up with the means for you to
cross the desert.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37321:
{speaker}: Please help us, if only for my granddaughter's
sake!
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37322:
{speaker}: We'll try to gather more
information on the new POKéMON. {speaker}: In the meantime, {player},
you should speak to PERR about your scooter. {speaker}: It would be best if we could
get information on what's happening in the
northern desert as soon as possible.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37323:
{speaker}: We didn't expect you to know
about PERR.
Small world, huh? {speaker}: PERR's grandpa used to run
a junk shop in a town named THE UNDER. {speaker}: If it's anything to do with
machines and parts, leave it up to those two.
There's nothing to worry about with them.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37324:
{speaker}: I have a photo of BONSLY.
Please have a look.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37326:
{speaker}: I know I'm asking the impossible, but please
help us. {speaker}: I will wait with this child without losing hope.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37359:
{speaker}: Yo!
How does it feel?
You know, seeing yourself on TV. {speaker}: You may already be ONBS's
top star!
Too cool!
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37360:
{speaker}: We finally finished recovering
all the deleted data.
We also managed to get back on the air, too.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37361:
{speaker}: It's too bad CIPHER raided us
before NETT finished analyzing that DATA ROM. {speaker}: But we're not beaten.
We'll just keep on collecting information!
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37362:
{speaker}: {player}, we hope you'll
keep going until every SHADOW POKéMON
is saved from CIPHER's clutches.
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37363:
{speaker}: Thank you!
I'm so glad that my BONSLY is safe. {speaker}: I hope I can see my BONSLY soon...
M2_building_4F/M2_building_4F.37364:
