Would you look at WOBBUFFET's happy face?
I feel overjoyed, too!
M3_houseB_1F/M3_houseB_1F.38282:
{speaker}: My old dad's back to his
chipper self again.
Thanks to you, kid!
M3_houseB_1F/M3_houseB_1F.38285:
{speaker}: Do you think it might be because of that
POKéMON TRANSLATOR machine? {speaker}: That old man at the POKéMON CENTER sure
likes peculiar inventions.
But boy, this is really annoying.
M3_houseB_1F/M3_houseB_1F.38286:
{speaker}: So it was that weird POKéMON TRANSLATOR
machine causing trouble.
I had a feeling that it might be the cause. {speaker}: But, you know, I haven't heard of any
inventor by the name of KAMINKO before.
M3_houseB_1F/M3_houseB_1F.38294:
No quiz appeared!
This POKéMON TRANSLATOR appears to be
broken down.
M3_houseB_1F/M3_houseB_1F.38300:
{player} quietly made the WOBBUFFET
listen to the VOICE CASE.
M3_houseB_1F/M3_houseB_1F.38301:
But nothing happened.
This cry does not appear to be that of
WOBBUFFET.

M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38056:
{speaker}: Hello, what a darling TRAINER
you are!
I'm BELUH.
Did you want something of me? {6a}{speaker}: Oh?
EAGUN, you say.
Ah, so you've come calling to see my husband. {speaker}: Are you perhaps
{player}?
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38057:
{speaker}: Ah, just as I thought!
You are {player}!
We've been expecting you!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38058:
{speaker}: Oh...
Uh-oh, then are you maybe... {speaker}: Peddling those ridiculous
inventions of DR. KAMINKO's?
If that's the case, I'll ask you to leave.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38059:
{speaker}: We got word about you from
LILY, you see.
We understand that you want to purify SHADOW
POKéMON. {speaker}: The instant my husband heard
from LILY, why, you should have seen his
excitement and enthusiasm. {speaker}: Shouting, "This calls for my
services!" or some such, he went off running
to who knows where.
He hasn't come back since.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38060:
{speaker}: BELUH, dear!
I've got everything ready!
We're ready for our visitor from the HQ LAB
whenever he arrives... Oh?!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38061:
{speaker}: Oh, hello, dear.
Our guest, {player}, has just arrived.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38062:
{speaker}: Oh, so you're {player}!
We've been waiting!
I'm EAGUN! {6a}{speaker}: I've heard everything that
LILY had to say. {speaker}: As you know, to purify
a SHADOW POKéMON, it must open its heart to
the TRAINER. {speaker}: While there are several
approaches, battles are the best, no doubt at all! {speaker}: The place to do that here is
in the RELIC FOREST, which is home to the
RELIC STONE.
I will go ahead and wait for you there!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38063:
{speaker}: My husband is so impatient,
as you've just seen. {speaker}: In his day, he was hailed
as the greatest TRAINER.
But that's a long time ago.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38064:
{speaker}: The cave to the RELIC
FOREST is down the slope beside the POKéMON
CENTER. {speaker}: Good luck purifying your
SHADOW POKéMON!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38099:
{speaker}: This is a cause for
celebration!
You've successfully purified your first SHADOW
POKéMON without incident. {speaker}: Still, one can't be too happy,
not with the knowledge of PROF. KRANE's
abduction. {speaker}: You see, he was a frequent
visitor to AGATE up to several years ago.
He was conducting extensive research into the
RELIC STONE, you see. {speaker}: He said that it was for
completing an entirely new purifying system that
his friend thought up. {speaker}: I wonder where the
kidnappers have made off with PROF. KRANE.
It must be worrisome for you, too.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38100:
{speaker}: About that abduction, dear...
Didn't you need to mention what VANDER saw?
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38101:
{speaker}: Hm?
Ah, yes! That's right!
I needed to tell you about VANDER.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38102:
{speaker}: We have a friend by the name
of VANDER who lives on MT. BATTLE, which is
a place of training for TRAINERS. {speaker}: VANDER claims to have seen
sinister characters out in the desert, where few
people dare to tread.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38105:
{speaker}: The story of shady people in
the desert has me concerned, too. {speaker}: You should speak with
VANDER in person for details.
MT. BATTLE is to the northeast of this village. {speaker}: VANDER is an AREA LEADER
on MT. BATTLE, so you should have no trouble
finding him.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38106:
{speaker}: For someone so young,
you've already shown yourself to be admirable. {speaker}: You have the air of someone
who is about to accomplish great things. {speaker}: Oh, dear, I'm sorry.
The instincts of an old woman like me aren't
anything you could trust.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38107:
{speaker}: Oh, yes, {player}.
May I have your P★DA number?
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38108: {player} gave the P★DA number to EAGUN.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38109:
{speaker}: Fine!
If I hear of anything, I will make certain to get
in touch with you.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38132:
{speaker}: Oh! Oh!
So you've found PROF. KRANE safe and sound!
That's the important thing! {speaker}: And the POKéMON HQ LAB has
finished work on the new PURIFY SYSTEM? {speaker}: That is excellent news!
Now, {player}, it's up to you to rescue
SHADOW POKéMON for purification there. {speaker}: I sense that you have much
potential as a TRAINER waiting to be tapped.
I'm sure that you will find success!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38133:
{speaker}: I'm glad to hear that
PROF. KRANE was found safe. {speaker}: But, my goodness, I'm
surprised you went off and rescued that poor
man all by yourself. {speaker}: It's a big difference from what
my husband was like as a child. {speaker}: You see, he was a timid,
fearful boy who couldn't bear to even touch
a BUG POKéMON.
Isn't that funny?
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38137:
{speaker}: Who would have thought it?
I never expected to see wild POKéMON appearing
in the ORRE REGION. {speaker}: I wouldn't mind catching
a wild POKéMON.
It's been such a long time...
I can feel that old urge!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38139:
{speaker}: Hello, dear.
I saw you on television.
They said they found places where wild
POKéMON appear. {speaker}: After seeing that, my husband
can't seem to sit still.
It's rather silly.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38145:
{speaker}: Ah, {player}!
I hope you've been keeping well. {speaker}: What?!
CIPHER is after PHENAC?!
Whatever for?
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38146:
{speaker}: Hmm...
I'm worried about the DAY-CARE LADY who
went off to visit in PHENAC.
And let's not forget the townspeople. {speaker}: {player}!
The people of PHENAC need your help!
You must go to their aid.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38148:
{speaker}: My goodness gracious!
CIPHER is attacking a town?
How brazen and bold of them!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38150:
{speaker}: What?!
CIPHER is supplanting the townspeople with their
own members? {speaker}: Grr...
What has become of the town's citizens, not to
mention the DAY-CARE LADY who went to
visit PHENAC? {speaker}: {player}!
You've got to save the people of PHENAC!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38152:
{speaker}: Replacing the townspeople
with CIPHER members?
What happens to the people being replaced?
Where do they end up?
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38157:
{speaker}: Ah, {player}!
We've heard about your courageous exploits in
PHENAC from the DAY-CARE LADY! {speaker}: I didn't expect anything less!
After all, you're just how I was as a
lad of your age, {player}!
Bravo! Bravo, indeed!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38159:
{speaker}: We heard about you!
How you drove off that terrible CIPHER.
My, you're such an inspiring figure!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38165:
{speaker}: Ah, {player}!
Your selfless heroics in liberating PHENAC have
been all over the news! {speaker}: I didn't expect anything less!
After all, you're just how I was as a
lad of your age, {player}!
Bravo! Bravo, indeed!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38166:
{speaker}: It's not very often that one
gets the chance to compare someone on
television with the real thing in person. {speaker}: I would say you look
handsome in person and on TV.
Hohoho.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38171:
{speaker}: How incredible!
The missing S.S. LIBRA ended up in the desert! {speaker}: But how on earth did it get
there? {speaker}: What's more, what has
become of the POKéMON that were on the ship? {speaker}: You don't mean to tell me
that they've all been turned into
SHADOW POKéMON?
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38172:
{speaker}: What has become of the
POKéMON that were on the ship? {speaker}: You don't mean to tell me
that they've all been turned into
SHADOW POKéMON?
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38173:
{speaker}: From now on, I don't think
I could ever be surprised by anything I hear.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38175:
{speaker}: What?!
The SNAG MACHINE was stolen?
That is a massive disaster! {speaker}: But TEAM SNAGEM?
I'm blazed and amazed that those cretins were
still around!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38176:
{speaker}: Do you know about
TEAM SNAGEM?
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38177:
{speaker}: TEAM SNAGEM was a gang
of thugs that robbed TRAINERS of their
POKéMON. {speaker}: They would then supply CIPHER
with the stolen POKéMON. {speaker}: If your aim is to get your
SNAG MACHINE back, I urge you to be careful.
Exercise utmost caution, lad!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38178:
{speaker}: They are despicable brutes!
If you aim to get your SNAG MACHINE back,
go with extreme caution!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38179:
{speaker}: They took your SNAG
MACHINE?
Oh, how could they do such a thing? {speaker}: But not to worry, dear.
I'm sure that you will be able to get it back!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38181:
{speaker}: Oh, hello, {player}.
The S.S. LIBRA is on the news. {speaker}: But what became of the
POKéMON?
I hope they haven't been hurt.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38182:
{speaker}: How on earth did they manage
to carry that huge ship so deep into the desert?
It doesn't sound possible for people.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38183:
{speaker}: What's that?!
You destroyed CIPHER's secret factory?
Well done!
Bravo! {speaker}: That means that there won't be more
new SHADOW POKéMON appearing, at least.
...Hm?
Is something else on your mind?
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38184:
{player} told EAGUN what had happened with
GREEVIL.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38185:
{speaker}: What's that?!
CIPHER's boss challenged you to go to their
headquarters? {speaker}: Fine!
I'll go, too!
Lead the way to their headquarters! {speaker}: Huh?
They're on CITADARK ISLE?
Hmm... {speaker}: If memory serves, CITADARK is
an island to the south of GATEON PORT. {speaker}: However, I've heard that the sea
around the island is very vicious.
Even the people in the area have shunned it
from past to present. {speaker}: Is there any means of reaching
a place so forbidding?
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38186:
{speaker}: I had my heart set on cutting
loose with my PIKACHU like old times.
It's disappointing.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38188:
{speaker}: There's nothing I can do, then.
All I can do is cheer for you from here. {speaker}: I know!
I'll send you E-MAIL to cheer you on!
Look forward to hearing from me!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38189:
{speaker}: Oh, {player}!
Please don't try to do too much.
You will always be in my thoughts.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38190:
{speaker}: Boating accidents and
sinkings are common around CITADARK ISLE.
I understand that people go out of their way to
avoid it completely. {speaker}: Perhaps CIPHER took note of
that and deliberately built their headquarters
there.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38191:
{speaker}: Ah, {player}!
How goes it?
Are my E-MAILS getting through to you?
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38192:
{speaker}: Oh, very good!
I'll keep sending you my words of
encouragement by E-MAIL, then!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38193:
{speaker}: Oh?
Now that is odd...
Am I sending E-MAIL to the wrong address?
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38194:
{speaker}: Oh, {player}!
Please don't try to do too much.
You will always be in my thoughts.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38195:
{speaker}: My husband and mechanical
devices aren't a good fit. {speaker}: Whenever he sends you E-MAIL,
he sits down with the instruction book and refers
to it constantly.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38196:
{speaker}: My husband has gone off to
the ORRE COLOSSEUM. {speaker}: He left with a bounce in his
step, saying, "I can't let {player} take all the
glory." {speaker}: Like always, as soon as he
hears the word "battle," he gets all agitated and
antsy for a real one. {speaker}: It doesn't matter how old he's
become, he remains young at heart.
It can get tiresome, hohoho.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38197:
{speaker}: Oh!
You've got your SNAG MACHINE back!
Excellent! {speaker}: After all, without that SNAG
MACHINE it's impossible to rescue
SHADOW POKéMON.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38198:
{speaker}: You've recovered your
SNAG MACHINE!
Good for you! {speaker}: {player}, I'm glad to see
that you haven't been hurt, too.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38199:
{speaker}: What's that?!
You say that TEAM SNAGEM stole your SNAG
MACHINE, but you went and took it back? {speaker}: Well, I'll be...
Big things are afoot, it seems. {speaker}: Still, I'm glad to hear that
you've recovered your SNAG MACHINE. {speaker}: After all, without that SNAG
MACHINE it's impossible to rescue
SHADOW POKéMON.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38200:
{speaker}: M goodness, dear!
You keep getting involved in one crisis after
another.
But please, do be careful.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38201:
{speaker}: Now there's a ship in the desert?
My, that's quite startling!
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38210:
{speaker}: Oh, {player}!
You've come!
Thank you so much! {speaker}: Well, let's not waste any time.
Like I mentioned in my E-MAIL..
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38211:
{speaker}: Oh?
You don't know what I'm talking about?
Oh, dear, how annoying.
My E-MAIL to you was cut off. {speaker}: Well, let me explain.
Lately, a strange affliction seems to have taken
root among the POKéMON in AGATE VILLAGE..
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38212:
{speaker}: If you could, {player},
would you be so kind as to examine the
POKéMON of AGATE VILLAGE?
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38213:
{speaker}: Oh, how delightful!
Just a little while ago, SENILOR's son came
calling for advice. {speaker}: But since my husband is
away, I can't be of much help by myself.
That's why I'm glad you've come. {speaker}: There are five POKéMON in
AGATE VILLAGE in total.
Please examine them all.
I hope I can count on your success.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38214:
{speaker}: Oh, that's too bad.
But it can't be helped since you are very busy.
If you have a change of heart, please come
visit me again.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38215:
{speaker}: I wonder what on earth is
happening.
{player}, I'm counting on you.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38283:
{speaker}: {player}!
I heard what you did. {speaker}: Instead of just AGATE, you
went and checked POKéMON all over ORRE?
It would take you to do that, {player}! {speaker}: But this whole silly mess...
It was that eccentric DR. KAMINKO's doing,
wasn't it?
Doesn't he realize what he's done? {speaker}: If I see that DR. KAMINKO,
I'll be sure to give him a piece of my mind.
Oh, and this is a small token of appreciation
from me.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38284:
{speaker}: Now we'll be able to live in
peace here with our POKéMON again.
Thank you so much, dear.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38295:
{speaker}: {player}!
I heard about you from SENILOR. {speaker}: He said you made his
WOBBUFFET all better now.
I guess that leaves only that LOTAD. {speaker}: You can always find that
LOTAD beside the waterfall.
There's not much left to do now.
Please keep at it, dear.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.38305:
{speaker}: Ah, you've met VANDER? {speaker}: What's that you say?
CIPHER's old lab in the desert may be back in
operation? {speaker}: You intend to go to that
desert lab to see if PROF. KRANE was taken
there.
Go with care.
M3_houseC_1F/M3_houseC_1F.54173: There's a notebook titled "Secret News Leads."

M3_houseC_2F/M3_houseC_2F.54174:
It's lined with books written by EAGUN titled
"My Journeys with PIKACHU."
M3_houseC_2F/M3_houseC_2F.54205:
It's a bed.
Want to rest?

M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.38051:
{speaker}: The DAY-CARE LADY retired. {speaker}: But not to worry.
Her granddaughter's supposed to take over the
DAY-CARE business.
She went to bring the new girl here.
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.38160:
{speaker}: Oh! You're that boy!
Thank you sincerely for everything you did in
PHENAC. {speaker}: I just took over the DAY-CARE business from
my grandma.
I still have a lot to learn, but I'm trying.
I hope you'll trust me with your POKéMON.
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.38161:
{speaker}: Ah! It's you!
Thanks to you, I was able to get my DAY-CARE
up and running again. {speaker}: My granddaughter has much to learn about
the business, but I hope you'll bear with her and
become a good customer.
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.38162:
{speaker}: My granddaughter has much to learn about
the business, but I hope you'll bear with her and
become a good customer.
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.38167:
{speaker}: I've heard from BELUH that you were on the
news over that terrible incident in PHENAC. {speaker}: I had no idea that you were involved in
something that big!
It certainly startled me when I heard.
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.38303:
{speaker}: PHENAC's going to be attacked?
Will the DAY-CARE LADY be okay, I wonder? {speaker}: She'd just gone to PHENAC to get her
granddaughter, the girl who's going to be taking
over her DAY-CARE business.
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50701:
{speaker}: Hello!
I run the DAY-CARE service.
We raise POKéMON on behalf of busy TRAINERS
like yourself. {speaker}: I should tell you, though, we can't raise
SHADOW POKéMON.
So, now you know! {speaker}: Is there any POKéMON that you would like
us to raise?
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50702:
{speaker}: Oh?
That POKéMON looks like it's the only one fit
to battle. {speaker}: I can't raise any POKéMON for you if you
don't have at least one in your party that can
get out and battle.
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50703:
{speaker}: Oh?
You've only got SHADOW POKéMON?
That's a problem. {speaker}: Our DAY-CARE service isn't set up to
look after SHADOW POKéMON.
We can't raise one for you. {speaker}: Any POKéMON that isn't a SHADOW
POKéMON I can raise, though.
Please come see me when you do have one
I can raise.
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50706: A SHADOW POKéMON can't be left in DAYCARE.
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50707:
{speaker}: You'll be leaving your {32}?
Fine, we'll take good care of it.
You can look forward to its return!
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50708:
{speaker}: If you have any other POKéMON that you
would like raised, please don't hesitate to visit.
Thank you very much.
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50709:
{speaker}: Hello, welcome!
Your POKéMON is doing fine!
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50711:
{speaker}: Are you here to reclaim your
{32}?
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50712:
{speaker}: Your party is full.

M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50713:
{speaker}: Our fee for raising your {32}
is ${2f}.
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50714:
{speaker}: Uh-oh...

M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50715:
{speaker}: Here you go!
Your {32} seems happy to see you!
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50716:
{player} got the {32}
back from DAY CARE.
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50717:
{speaker}: Come see us whenever you want your
POKéMON back.
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50801:
{speaker}: Hello, hello!
I'm the NAME RATER!
You can consider me the fortune-teller of names! {speaker}: I shall be pleased to rate your
POKéMON's nickname.
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50802:
{speaker}: Which POKéMON's nickname should
I critique?
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50803:
{speaker}: Hm, hmm...
{32}, is it?
That is quite a fine name you bestowed.

nickname to something better?
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50804:
{speaker}: Fine, fine!
Then what shall the new nickname be?
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50805:
{speaker}: Oh? Oh?

Do you wish to keep it so?
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50806:
{speaker}: Fine, fine.
The original nickname was the one you liked

and affection!
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50807:
{speaker}: Done!
From now on this POKéMON shall be known
as {32}! {speaker}: Hmhm...
It is a name that is vastly superior than before!
Its luckiness is simply unsurpassed! {speaker}: Keep treating your {32} with love
and affection!
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50808:
{speaker}: I see.
That's too bad.
Visit me whenever you like.
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50809:
{speaker}: Hmm...
That POKéMON doesn't consider you its rightful
TRAINER yet. {speaker}: You should come see me when it accepts
you as its TRAINER.
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.50810:
{speaker}: Hmm... {32},
is it?
This is a magnificent nickname!
It is beyond reproach! {speaker}: Keep treating your {32} with love
and affection!
M3_houseD_1F/M3_houseD_1F.54171:
There's a book titled "The Smart Way to Raise
POKéMON."

M3_out/M3_out.38001:
{speaker}: This is AGATE VILLAGE.
We're famous for the RELIC STONE. {speaker}: You can consider this a retirement village. {speaker}: Elderly TRAINERS and POKéMON lead quiet
lives here.
M3_out/M3_out.38002:
{speaker}: I like the look of determination in your eyes.
When TRAINERS lock eyes with each other,
there's only one thing to do--battle!
M3_out/M3_out.38003:
{speaker}: Fwofwo!
This gets my blood pumping!
M3_out/M3_out.38005:
{speaker}: A fine battle that was!
Highly enjoyable, indeed!
Let us battle again sometime!
M3_out/M3_out.38006:
{speaker}: Listen, youngster!
What say we battle again?
M3_out/M3_out.38007:
{speaker}: Yes?
Oh, you've come calling on EAGUN? {speaker}: EAGUN's house is right there.
But he went out earlier and hasn't returned. {speaker}: He went running off shouting something
about someone coming or not coming.
I can't quite remember, though.
M3_out/M3_out.38008:
{speaker}: I have to hand it to EAGUN for his youthful
energy, though.
I swear, he must run faster than I can.
M3_out/M3_out.38009:
{speaker}: I heard this child calling for me, so I came
running to see what was the matter.
Well, I found something quite nice. {speaker}: I know!
We should have a battle, and if you can beat me,
I'll happily give you what I found.
Would you like to give it a try?
M3_out/M3_out.38011:
{speaker}: Oh, how disappointing.
I had rather been looking forward to a battle
with you.
M3_out/M3_out.38012:
{speaker}: Here you are, then.
Just as I promised, here is your prize.
M3_out/M3_out.38013: {speaker}: I'm sure you'll find it useful.
M3_out/M3_out.38014:
{speaker}: A battle is such a good thing.
I feel rejuvenated after every match.
Hohoho.
M3_out/M3_out.38015:
{speaker}: Oh, you wish to have another
battle with me?
M3_out/M3_out.38017:
{speaker}: Oh, so you won't.
It would be nice if you could humor an old
woman like me every so often.
M3_out/M3_out.38018:
{speaker}: A battle is such a good thing.
I feel rejuvenated after every match.
Hohoho.
M3_out/M3_out.38021:
{speaker}: Oh my, my.
It's quite rare to see a child visitor in our
village. {speaker}: Huh?
Aren't I a kid, too?
I may be young in body, but old in heart!
M3_out/M3_out.38022:
{speaker}: The villagers are all retired now, but they
were all outstanding TRAINERS in their younger
days. {speaker}: That's why I came here.
I wanted to learn the ins and outs of battling
from the people here. {speaker}: My older brother trained here before, and he
became very skilled.
I hate losing to him! {speaker}: But when it gets right down to it, the more
you battle, the tougher you become. So how about we battle?
M3_out/M3_out.38023:
{speaker}: That's what I want to hear!
Here goes!
M3_out/M3_out.38025:
{speaker}: I've got a lot to learn if I'm
losing to someone like you. {speaker}: I've got to study a lot more
about battling!
M3_out/M3_out.38026:
{speaker}: I'm going to stay here until
I become a better TRAINER.
Let me test how good I am with you.
Ready?
M3_out/M3_out.38027:
{speaker}: Oh, you're here to see EAGUN?
I saw him tearing around the village in a huge
rush a little earlier. {speaker}: Maybe BELUH would know where he went.
M3_out/M3_out.38029:
{speaker}: Oh, gosh!
There's no path out of the village this way!
M3_out/M3_out.38030:
{speaker}: Whoa!
Don't startle me like that!
Or are you looking for a battle with me?
M3_out/M3_out.38031:
{speaker}: You're on!
I'm feeling frustrated over getting lost, so I'll
take it out on you!
M3_out/M3_out.38032:
{speaker}: If you're not looking to battle,
leave me alone, okay?
M3_out/M3_out.38033:
{speaker}: I came to have a look at the
RELIC STONE, but they won't let me in.
And now I can't find my way out of here. {speaker}: I'm about to cry from
frustration!
M3_out/M3_out.38034:
{speaker}: Moan...
I looped back here again!
M3_out/M3_out.38035:
{speaker}: Whoa!
Don't you dare startle me like that again!
Oh, it's you again!
What do you want? A battle?
M3_out/M3_out.38036:
{speaker}: My dream is to become the
POKéMON CHAMPION one of these days.
Then, after I retire, I'm going to live here. {speaker}: To make that dream come
true, I've got to become a lot tougher. {speaker}: And to get a lot tougher...
It takes battles!
Right?
M3_out/M3_out.38038:
{speaker}: Tch!
How do you like that?
You couldn't help a guy trying to make his
dream come true?
M3_out/M3_out.38039:
{speaker}: Losing to a kid like you...
My dream of becoming the CHAMPION is nothing
but a pipe dream!
M3_out/M3_out.38040:
{speaker}: I won't abandon my dream of
becoming the CHAMPION!
Come on, let's battle!
M3_out/M3_out.38041:
{speaker}: This is the entrance to the RELIC FOREST,
where you'll find the RELIC STONE. {speaker}: But today, there will be some special battles.
So I can't let you into the FOREST.
If you're sightseeing, try another place.
M3_out/M3_out.38042:
{speaker}: Ah, you must be the {player} that EAGUN
was talking about. {speaker}: I've heard that you battle to open the hearts
of SHADOW POKéMON.
M3_out/M3_out.38043:
{speaker}: The RELIC is through this cave.
Don't give up!
M3_out/M3_out.38110:
{speaker}: Hey, I heard, I heard!
They say SHADOW POKéMON have appeared 
again! {speaker}: You brought your SHADOW POKéMON for
purification, didn't you?
That's quite impressive!
M3_out/M3_out.38111:
{speaker}: Oh?
You battled EAGUN, the legendary TRAINER?
Oh, you make me so jealous! {speaker}: Not only that, you actually
beat EAGUN? {speaker}: Then if I beat you, it would be
the same as me beating EAGUN, wouldn't it? {speaker}: That's it!
We've got to have a battle!
M3_out/M3_out.38112: {speaker}: That's what I wanted to hear!
M3_out/M3_out.38114:
{speaker}: Losing to you means I'm just
like EAGUN, I guess.
I can live with that!
M3_out/M3_out.38115:
{speaker}: Have you heard the news?
They say the man who runs the POKéMON HQ
LAB has been kidnapped! {speaker}: A ship disappearing, and now a brazen
kidnapping...
It's turning into a scary world.
M3_out/M3_out.38116:
{speaker}: Hi, {player}.
It looks like your SHADOW POKéMON has opened
its heart to you.
M3_out/M3_out.38117:
{speaker}: According to legend, that RELIC STONE is
said to have CELEBI's power of time travel. {speaker}: It's said that the power makes POKéMON
recall their fondest memories. {speaker}: If you catch another SHADOW POKéMON, you
should come back here again so you can purify
it.
M3_out/M3_out.38118:
{speaker}: While I was riding out this
way, I came close to being run down by a truck.
I almost had a heart attack, I tell you. {speaker}: There was a whole lot of
people on it, too.
They were dressed pretty strangely. {speaker}: They went roaring off towards
the desert without slowing down one bit.
M3_out/M3_out.38129:
{speaker}: Oh!
So CIPHER returned to its old desert lab?
And the boss is a cute girl?! {speaker}: ...Uh, yeah, um...
Well, that's not important, right?
Yup.
M3_out/M3_out.38130:
{speaker}: EAGUN let me battle him long ago. {speaker}: Back then, EAGUN was truly strong.
Everyone looked up to him.
M3_out/M3_out.38131:
{speaker}: Whaaat?
You're saying the truck that almost flattened me
was CIPHER's? {speaker}: Not only that, you stormed
their desert base and rescued that kidnapped
PROFESSOR? {speaker}: I've decided!
My dream is no longer trying to become the
POKéMON CHAMPION, but to be your disciple!
M3_out/M3_out.38140:
{speaker}: What?!
CIPHER is going to strike PHENAC next?! {speaker}: Those crooks!
If I had my own POKéMON, why, I'd take CIPHER
on by myself!
M3_out/M3_out.38141:
{speaker}: Oh no, not PHENAC!
PHENAC is where the DAY-CARE LADY's
granddaughter lives! {speaker}: Could that be why the DAY-CARE LADY still
hasn't returned from there?
M3_out/M3_out.38142:
{speaker}: You're serious?!
CIPHER's got their eyes on PHENAC? {speaker}: And you're intending to thwart
their sinister master plan?
... {speaker}: Okay!
My dream from now on is to cheer you on from
the sidelines! {speaker}: Let me begin cheering for you
with a battle!
M3_out/M3_out.38149:
{speaker}: Whoa!
PHENAC's MAYOR has gone missing?!
Is the town going to be all right?
M3_out/M3_out.38153:
{speaker}: Oh, wow!
You saved PHENAC?!
That's stupendous!
You're one stupendous fellow!
M3_out/M3_out.38154:
{speaker}: The DAY-CARE LADY retired and handed the
business to her granddaughter.
But she says the girl has a lot to learn. {speaker}: I hear that the girl can't take in certain kinds
of POKéMON, but she's just getting started in
the business.
I don't think you can blame her.
M3_out/M3_out.38155:
{speaker}: You're serious?!
You drove off CIPHER after they took over in
PHENAC?! {speaker}: Great!
From now on, my dream is to be friends with
a great guy like you!
Glad to know you! {speaker}: Let's cement our friendship
over a battle!
M3_out/M3_out.38163:
{speaker}: They showed you on TV setting PHENAC free?
That's incredible!
M3_out/M3_out.38168:
{speaker}: There was a ship in the desert? 
Aww, come on now.
SENILOR does enough dreaming out loud for
everyone here, believe me.
M3_out/M3_out.38225:
{speaker}: This POKéMON here would bark and call
for me whenever it dug something interesting up.
But recently, it's clammed up completely. {speaker}: What could be wrong with it?
I'm so worried, I can't even put it in battles.
M3_out/M3_out.38227:
{speaker}: This LOTAD has always been rather vacant,
but lately, it's been even more absentminded
than usual.
M3_out/M3_out.38229:
{speaker}: I'd like to share some BERRIES with you, but
my TAILLOW hasn't had any energy lately. {speaker}: It's very strange.
We'd just been to the POKéMON CENTER, too. {speaker}: Not only that, I had my TAILLOW fitted with
some unique machine.
This has me worried.
M3_out/M3_out.38244:
{player} made the POOCHYENA listen to
the VOICE CASE.
M3_out/M3_out.38247:
{speaker}: Oh!
That was the first cry in some time!
Have you found something for me, sweetie?
M3_out/M3_out.38248:
{speaker}: My POOCHYENA has gone back to digging
up all sorts of things for me.
It's bursting with energy again. {speaker}: It would be fantastic if it could dig up
something remarkable one day.
M3_out/M3_out.38251:
{player} made the TAILLOW listen to
the VOICE CASE.
M3_out/M3_out.38254:
{speaker}: Oh!
It cried! I'm sure of it!
Oh, good, good!
Go get BERRIES like you always do!
M3_out/M3_out.38255:
{speaker}: My TAILLOW has been picking
BERRIES for me again.
It's overflowing with power!
M3_out/M3_out.38258:
{speaker}: Oh, finally it cried.
I guess that the POKéMON TRANSLATOR or
whatever it was called has come off.
M3_out/M3_out.38259:
{speaker}: ...
You...
Are you just always naturally vacant?
M3_out/M3_out.38261:
{speaker}: ...
Come to think, I don't remember ever putting
any odd machine on it.
M3_out/M3_out.38263:
{speaker}: ...
That vacantness seems to be catching.
I'm beginning to feel vacant, too.
M3_out/M3_out.38289:
{speaker}: Whaaat?
You're saying the truck that almost flattened me
was CIPHER's? {speaker}: Not only that, you stormed
their desert base and rescued that kidnapped
PROFESSOR? {speaker}: I've decided!
My dream is no longer trying to become the
POKéMON CHAMPION, but to be your disciple! {speaker}: Let's not waste any time here!
Let's have a battle now!
Here goes, master!
M3_out/M3_out.38290:
{speaker}: Y-you're indeed my master!
You're too strong!
But battle with me again, please!
M3_out/M3_out.38291:
{speaker}: Y-you're great, as always.
It makes it more worthwhile to cheer for you!
M3_out/M3_out.38292:
{speaker}: Y-you're indeed my friend!
You're too strong!
But battle with me again, please!
M3_out/M3_out.38296:
{player} quietly made the POOCHYENA
listen to the VOICE CASE.
M3_out/M3_out.38297:
But nothing happened.
This cry does not appear to be that of
POOCHYENA.
M3_out/M3_out.38298:
{player} quietly made the TAILLOW
listen to the VOICE CASE.
M3_out/M3_out.38299:
But nothing happened.
This cry does not appear to be that of
TAILLOW.
M3_out/M3_out.38302:
{speaker}: I've decided to go home, but
now I can't find the exit to the village. {speaker}: I'm so frustrated I could cry!
M3_out/M3_out.38304:
{speaker}: It won't cry for me still...
Is it really because of that POKéMON
TRANSLATOR thing?
M3_out/M3_out.51201:
{speaker}: Do you see this?
My TAILLOW brings me BERRIES from somewhere
every day. {speaker}: Here, I'll share one with you.
M3_out/M3_out.51203:
{speaker}: If you'd like, feel free to visit every so
often. {speaker}: I'll share BERRIES with you if my
TAILLOW brings me some.
M3_out/M3_out.51204:
{speaker}: My TAILLOW brings me BERRIES from
somewhere every day. {speaker}: However, it doesn't seem to have found
any yet today.

M3_pc_1F/M3_pc_1F.38054:
{speaker}: Hmm...
For some reason, I feel dull and listless.
I seem to have no energy at all. {speaker}: I've been wearing these new sandals with
raised nubs on the insole.
I was told it was a great invention, but does it
actually do anything for my health?
M3_pc_1F/M3_pc_1F.38055:
{speaker}: Do you know SENILOR?
He's an old man who's been living here for many
years. {speaker}: Well, SENILOR says that he saw a WAILORD
flying high up in the sky. {speaker}: If that's true, it would be fantastic, I guess.
But if he mistook something for a flying
WAILORD, what did he really see?
M3_pc_1F/M3_pc_1F.38231:
{speaker}: What's that you say?
The POKéMON TRANSLATOR?
Yes, it is I who gave them to the good people
of AGATE VILLAGE. {speaker}: What's that you say?
The POKéMON wearing my machine have been
faring poorly?
Hmm...
M3_pc_1F/M3_pc_1F.38232:
{speaker}: This old man loves new inventions.
Even though they're usually useless.
M3_pc_1F/M3_pc_1F.38233:
{speaker}: Oh, child!
There's no need to remind me of that.
But this isn't good...
POKéMON shouldn't be affected this way... {speaker}: I was given those by, uh...
DR. KAMINKO, I think it was.
He comes by with peculiar inventions every so
often. {speaker}: But I have no idea where he lives, or
anything of that nature.
Hmm...
What to do...
M3_pc_1F/M3_pc_1F.38234:
{speaker}: DR. KAMINKO's inventions are often just
strange.
But they also have a unique charm that you
don't see in other items. {speaker}: That's what makes the act of inventing such
a noble and romantic endeavor!
Just once, I would love to visit the studio where
inventions are created.
M3_pc_1F/M3_pc_1F.38235:
{speaker}: This man has a history of being stuck with
ridiculous inventions.
Every time he gets a dud, he shouts, "I've blown
it!"
M3_pc_1F/M3_pc_1F.38287:
{speaker}: Testing peculiar inventions makes me feel so
alive!

M3_shop_1F/M3_shop_1F.38052:
{speaker}: Sometimes, it doesn't matter how strong
POKéMON are in a battle.
If the TRAINER doesn't know how to use items
properly, the battle could be lost. {speaker}: That's why I think it's important to buy 
a good mix of items that're
good for every conceivable situation.
M3_shop_1F/M3_shop_1F.38053:
{speaker}: Have you heard the news?
Someone abducted the director of a research 
lab somewhere. {speaker}: Isn't it scary?
It was finally becoming peaceful after CIPHER
disappeared, but now this happens.
M3_shop_1F/M3_shop_1F.38206:
{speaker}: Welcome!
We've just added POKé BALLS to our choice
selection of TRAINER merchandise!
M3_shop_1F/M3_shop_1F.38207:
{speaker}: Welcome!
We've just added POKé SNACKS to our fine
selection of POKéMON merchandise. {speaker}: I've got to tell you, I'm overjoyed to hear
that wild POKéMON have returned. {speaker}: Maybe EAGUN anticipated that would happen.
I wouldn't put it past that legendary TRAINER!
M3_shop_1F/M3_shop_1F.38209:
{speaker}: Listen, have you heard?
They say the director of a lab somewhere has
been rescued. {speaker}: I don't know the details, but I'm glad to hear
he was found unharmed.

M3_shrine_1F/M3_shrine_1F.38090:
{speaker}: Hah?
What's that you say?
You have no SHADOW POKéMON in your party? {speaker}: Quick!
Go get one!
M3_shrine_1F/M3_shrine_1F.38091:
{speaker}: Your SHADOW POKéMON
should be ready to open its heart after the
battles you've waged getting here. {speaker}: Now I shall be your
opponent. {speaker}: And here's my partner.
The one POKéMON that I caught as my first...
and that has stayed with me ever since. {speaker}: Go, PIKACHU!
Off we go to our first battle in five years!
Let's keep things tight!
M3_shrine_1F/M3_shrine_1F.38092:
{speaker}: My goodness.
It was a white-hot experience, our battle. {speaker}: And to defeat my PIKACHU...
That takes real skill!
M3_shrine_1F/M3_shrine_1F.38094:
{speaker}: Now, let's see how your
SHADOW POKéMON is doing.
M3_shrine_1F/M3_shrine_1F.38095:
{speaker}: Ah, this POKéMON is on the
verge of opening its heart to you!
You've done a good job looking after it.
M3_shrine_1F/M3_shrine_1F.38096:
{speaker}: Well done!
That POKéMON has finally returned to its former
self. {speaker}: For the time being, we should
return to my house.
M3_shrine_1F/M3_shrine_1F.38097:
{speaker}: Hmm...
This POKéMON isn't quite ready to open its heart
to you. {speaker}: You should travel some more
with it, or perhaps give it COLOGNE MASSAGES.
After it's been exposed to some more of your
kindness, bring it back here. {speaker}: Of course, if you would rather
battle, my four friends are waiting like before.
They're ready to do battle as often as you wish.
M3_shrine_1F/M3_shrine_1F.38098:
{speaker}: Hmm...
That POKéMON isn't quite ready to open its heart
to you. {speaker}: You should travel some more
with it, or perhaps give it COLOGNE MASSAGES.
After it's been exposed to some more of your
kindness, bring it back here. {speaker}: Of course, if you would rather
battle, my four friends are waiting like before.
They're ready to do battle as often as you wish.
M3_shrine_1F/M3_shrine_1F.38104:
{speaker}: Hah? What's that you say?
The SHADOW POKéMON in your party...
...Fainted? {speaker}: That's shameful!
Go heal your SHADOW POKéMON at once!
M3_shrine_1F/M3_shrine_1F.38208:
{speaker}: Now you should use the
power of the RELIC STONE to finally open that
SHADOW POKéMON's heart completely.
M3_shrine_1F/M3_shrine_1F.38288:
{speaker}: Now, now.
The RELIC STONE isn't that way.
M3_shrine_1F/M3_shrine_1F.50502:
There's a POKéMON that may open the door
to its heart!
M3_shrine_1F/M3_shrine_1F.54175:
This is a mystical relic.
It seems to be giving off a strange and fantastic
power.

M3_shrine_1F_rl/M3_shrine_1F_rl.50501:
This is a mystical relic.
It seems to be giving off a strange and fantastic
power.
M3_shrine_1F_rl/M3_shrine_1F_rl.50503: {32} opened the door to its heart!
M3_shrine_1F_rl/M3_shrine_1F_rl.50506:
Would you like to give a nickname
to {32}?

M5_apart_1F/M5_apart_1F.40020:
{speaker}: PLUPLU! MIMI!
Where are you? {speaker}: It's not fair!
They can't go on an adventure
without {speaker}!
M5_apart_1F/M5_apart_1F.40041:
{speaker}: Hi, {player}.
Isn't your sister with you?
It's rare to see you without JOVI. {speaker}: You two get along so good together.
Why, it makes me happy seeing you two.
Hohoho!
M5_apart_1F/M5_apart_1F.40042:
{speaker}: Have I seen JOVI anywhere?
Come to think, I haven't seen her since lunch.
M5_apart_1F/M5_apart_1F.40047:
{speaker}: My POKéMON and I, we're always together,
even when we're sleeping. {speaker}: If you want to become friends with POKéMON,
companionship is very important.
M5_apart_1F/M5_apart_1F.40077:
{speaker}: Big brother, there's an old man
with a really long beard standing outside. {speaker}: When JOVI asked, he let JOVI
touch the beard.
When JOVI tugged it, he said it hurt.
It must be real!
M5_apart_1F/M5_apart_1F.40078:
It's {player}'s room.
But lately, his kid sister appears to have the run
of the place.
M5_apart_1F/M5_apart_1F.40081:
{speaker}: It's fun underneath CHOBIN's
room.
Have you been there, big brother?
It's JOVI's favorite spot now.
M5_apart_1F/M5_apart_1F.40087:
Hey!
There's something on the desk!
M5_apart_1F/M5_apart_1F.40092: There is an empty case between some books.
M5_apart_1F/M5_apart_1F.40093: {speaker}: That's a BATTLE CD used in BATTLE SIMs.
M5_apart_1F/M5_apart_1F.40095:
{speaker}: Oh, {player}, are you interested in BATTLE
SIMs, too?
M5_apart_1F/M5_apart_1F.40115:
{speaker}: Oh, I guess someone's taken it.
I'll lend it to you when they return it.
M5_apart_1F/M5_apart_1F.40116: {speaker}: If you'd like, you're welcome to take that.
M5_apart_1F/M5_apart_1F.40119:
{speaker}: JOVI must have been very tired.
She's fallen asleep in your bed again.

CIPHER is headed for the final showdown.
It's not hard to imagine things becoming even
tougher for you, dear. {speaker}: But, {player}, I know that you
will win against the criminals.
I believe in you.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.40453:
{speaker}: Oh, my!
PROF. KRANE gave you a MASTER BALL?
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.40454:
{speaker}: What?!
You're taking CIPHER on in their headquarters?! {speaker}: That stuns me.
{player}, you have superhuman toughness. {speaker}: But they will be desperate, too.
Don't let down your guard!
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.40455:
{speaker}: {player}, you're finally going
off to the ultimate battle, aren't you? {speaker}: You've really grown in stature.
As your mother, it makes me feel conflicted.
I'm happy and proud on one hand, but I'm also
a little sad. {speaker}: Go and get rid of CIPHER, and
make it quick!
And come home safely.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.40457:
{speaker}: I'd hate to think so, but if they
use that SNAG MACHINE for criminal purposes,
there's going to be chaos! {speaker}: An instrument for justice can
easily become a weapon if it's not used properly. {speaker}: {player}!
You've got to get the SNAG MACHINE back!
That can't be allowed to fall into the hands of
criminals!
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.40466:
{speaker}: Listen, {player}.
That MASTER BALL is extremely precious.
Think long and hard before you use it. {speaker}: But once you decide to use it,
then do so without hesitation.
It won't do to let opportunity slip away.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.40469:
{6a}{speaker}: Hahaha.
You don't need to be that stiffly official, LILY.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.40470:
{speaker}: I wish everyone wouldn't drown
them with such gushing praise all the time. {speaker}: My son and daughter will become
spoiled rotten.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.40471:
{speaker}: There's nothing to worry about.
Both {player} and JOVI are wonderful kids.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.40472:
{speaker}: {player}, I hate to bother you,
but could you go find JOVI for me? {speaker}: {player}, I think you already
know, but several research projects are in their
critical phases in this LAB. {speaker}: That's why your mother can't afford
to take any time off right this instant.
So please, honey, will you go find JOVI for me?
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.40473:
{speaker}: Thank you.
I'm counting on you.
I don't think she could have wandered off too
far, but just in case, check outside, too.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.40474:
{speaker}: Oh, don't be so rebellious.
Please, will you go find JOVI?
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.40518:
{speaker}: CIPHER must have overrun
PHENAC CITY by now...
Promise me that you'll be extremely cautious. {speaker}: I'm counting on you,
{player}.
CIPHER's conspiracy can be shattered only by
you, {player}, and that SNAG MACHINE!
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.40519:
{speaker}: That's it for purification.
There are no more SHADOW POKéMON left. {speaker}: You've done it, {player}.
Thank you for your valiant effort, dear!
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.40529:
{speaker}: Hi, {player}.
Welcome back. {speaker}: {player}, there's something
that I'd like you to have.
Could you come with me downstairs?
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.40530:
{speaker}: Oh, right!
I heard that you were on TV on a news report
about POKé SPOTS.
Way to go! {speaker}: I'd heard that wild POKéMON were
appearing in the ORRE REGION.
So, yes, it's fantastic news, indeed.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.40535:
{speaker}: Hi, {player}.
You were great to destroy CIPHER's secret
factory. {speaker}: It's unlikely that more SHADOW
POKéMON will be created from now on. {speaker}: But there still remains the job of
snagging the SHADOW POKéMON left and
purifying them.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51402:
There are basically two types of battles.
Battles against POKéMON TRAINERS, and battles
against wild POKéMON.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51404:
TRAINER battles can take a variety of forms.
Standard battles are conducted with TRAINERS
you meet while traveling. There are also event-type battles that are
conducted at facilities such as the COLOSSEUMS
in the ORRE REGION. There are also BATTLE SIMs conducted using
BATTLE SIM SYSTEMS.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51405: How do I win a battle?
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51406:
A POKéMON loses HP if it is hurt in a battle.
It faints if it loses all its HP, and becomes
incapable of battling. You win by making all your opponent's POKéMON
faint. The reverse is also true.
If all your POKéMON faint, you lose.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51408:
Information about the opponent's POKéMON is
displayed on panels on the upper right of the
screen, while your information is on the
upper left. Each panel shows the respective POKéMON's HP
and status. At the lower part of the screen, the battle menu
is displayed.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51410:
When a battle starts, select "FIGHT" in the battle
menu.
This opens the move menu which lists the moves
the POKéMON knows. When a move is selected, its Power Points (PP)
are shown at the right.
The PP indicates how many more times the
selected move can be used. If a move's PP is "0," that move can't be used.
Beware of that.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51412:
In the battle menu, select "POKéMON" to display
all the POKéMON that are in your party. On the left are the two POKéMON in battle. On the right-hand side, your party POKéMON not
in battle (if any) are displayed. Selecting a POKéMON displays a menu.
Use the "SHIFT" command in the menu to switch
the selected POKéMON with another one. Shift your POKéMON in and out of battle
depending on type matchups and the situation.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51414:
Select "ITEM" in the battle menu to use an item
you have. Some items may not be used in battles, however.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51416:
Select "CALL" in the battle menu to call out to
the chosen POKéMON. The called POKéMON's attack accuracy rises.
A call will also awaken a sleeping POKéMON. The "CALL" command appears to have other
special effects.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51418:
Your POKéMON that are in battle gain EXP. Points
(Experience Points) whenever an opponent's
POKéMON faints. However, your POKéMON will not obtain
EXP. Points in certain COLOSSEUM BATTLES and
BATTLE SIMs.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51420:
If you defeat a POKéMON TRAINER in a battle
during your travels, you will be rewarded with
money. You may also receive other rewards in certain
COLOSSEUM BATTLES and BATTLE SIMs such as
TECHNICAL MACHINES (TM) and POKé COUPONS.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51422:
When a POKéMON earns a certain amount of
EXP. Points, it will level up. Upon leveling up, the POKéMON's stats--such
as HP, ATTACK, DEFENSE, and so on--will
be improved.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51424:
When a POKéMON levels up, it may learn a new
move. However, if the POKéMON already knows the
maximum four moves, one of the existing moves
must be forgotten for the new move to be
learned.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51426:
Upon leveling up, POKéMON may learn new
moves.
Some will even evolve.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51428:
When attacked in battle, POKéMON may suffer
a status problem such as a burn, paralysis,
or even faint. If such a problem arises, POKéMON can be
healed using the appropriate items.
They may also be healed at POKéMON CENTERS,
HEALING MACHINES, and so on.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51430:
There are many kinds of moves.
Besides those that inflict damage, there are
some that provide protection, and some that
cause status problems. Try to learn the effects of moves and use them
to your advantage.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51431: What makes a move super effective?
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51432:
If an attack move's type matches up favorably
against the defending POKéMON's type, it will
become super effective and cause extra damage. Choose your move types to suit the target's type
for the best effect.
This is an important point for battling effectively.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51433: What makes a move not very effective?
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51434:
Depending on the attack move's type
and the target's type, some moves may
not be very effective, or even
completely ineffective. Choose your move types to suit the
target's type for the best effect.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51436:
Any POKéMON that takes part in a winning battle
earns EXP. Points.
It's possible to have a weak POKéMON earn
EXP. Points safely. Place it at the top of the POKéMON list, then
shift it out as soon as a battle starts.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51438:
In a SINGLE BATTLE, POKéMON are sent into
battle one at a time.
In a DOUBLE BATTLE, POKéMON are sent into
battle two at a time. Among the POKéMON moves, there are some that
affect two POKéMON on either side, or even all
POKéMON in battle. Learn about how moves work in DOUBLE BATTLES
especially to ensure you may battle effectively.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.51440:
POKéMON become easier to catch when their HP
is low. They become even easier to catch if they have
a status problem such as being asleep or
paralyzed. The type of POKé BALL used may also affect how
easily POKéMON can be caught. Try to match the POKé BALL types to suit the
targeted POKéMON.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.54102:
There's information on POKéMON battles.
Want to read it?
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.54183:
There's a book titled "The Basics of POKéMON
Battles and Applied Techniques."
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.54184: It's lined with books on POKéMON.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.54186:
There's a scholastic paper titled "POKéMON
Matchups and the PURIFY CHAMBER."
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.54187: It's lined with books on POKéMON.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.54188:
There's a notebook titled "Joint Study on
Purification." "We dedicate our friendship to the realization
of the PURIFY CHAMBER!" is written on it.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57002:
Learn how a POKéMON can be healed
from a status problem using an item.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57004:
If a POKéMON's type and its attack move's
type are the same, the move will inflict
greater damage.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57006:
Every type of POKéMON has strengths and
weaknesses to other types.
Learn how POKéMON types match up.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57008:
Learn about the pros and cons of attack
moves that hit more than one POKéMON.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57010:
A POKéMON that is of two types is a little
complicated for matching move types.
Let's learn how this works.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57012:
Learn how POKéMON should be switched
out of battle and replaced with a reserve
when at a clear disadvantage.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57014:
Every POKéMON has a single ability.
Using LEVITATE as an example,
learn how this ability can affect battles.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57016:
Learn about items that POKéMON can hold
for use during a battle.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57018:
Learn how to battle advantageously by
causing status problems in the opposing
POKéMON.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57020:
Learn how moves that can boost or lower
stats can help you win battles easily.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57022:
Let's learn about a SINGLE BATTLE
combo using a basic weather combo.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57024:
Using combos can bring victory even
when facing tough opponents.
Learn how DOUBLE BATTLE combos work.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57027:
{speaker}: You can train using the BATTLE SIM
SYSTEM.
Would you like to do that?
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57028:
{speaker}: The BATTLE SIM SYSTEM lets you train by
simulating a variety of situations. {speaker}: When you're in a battle, do you know how
your POKéMON can be put to sleep or sustain
a burn? {speaker}: By taking training, you'll know what to do if
you ever face the situation in a real battle.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57030:
{speaker}: Okay, can I get you to enter the ring there,
please?
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57031:
{speaker}: Okay!
"{4d}"
is set and ready to go.
Should I begin?
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57032:
{speaker}: Good job!
That's how you do it!
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57033:
{speaker}: Too bad!
Looks like you need a little more training to
figure out this situation. {speaker}: Let me give you just a little advice.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57035:
{speaker}: Okay.
Just give me the word if you want to get in 
some training.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57055:
{speaker}: If a POKéMON gets a burn, it steadily loses 
HP during the battle.
It's best to heal it as soon as possible.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57056:
{speaker}: Use BURN HEAL to make a POKéMON recover
from a burn. {speaker}: If the opponent's POKéMON sustains a burn,
you can win even if your POKéMON is put to
sleep.
You should remember that.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57057:
{speaker}: If an attack move isn't the same type as the
POKéMON using it, you may be dismayed by how
little damage it causes. {speaker}: Learn to choose moves for your POKéMON
after you confirm the POKéMON and the move's
types.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57058:
{speaker}: The RATTATA and QUICK ATTACK are both
the NORMAL type.
So, the move causes greater damage. {speaker}: In contrast, THUNDERBOLT is an ELECTRIC-
type move, so the RATTATA failed to cause much
damage with it. {speaker}: Matching the attack move's type with its
POKéMON's type is basic.
It's one of the first lessons TRAINERS must
learn.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57059:
{speaker}: ELECTRIC-type POKéMON are strong against
WATER-type POKéMON, but are weak against
GROUND-type POKéMON. {speaker}: Think about what a GROUND-type POKéMON
would be weak against.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57060:
{speaker}: The MAGNEMITE is an ELECTRIC type, so it's
strong against the WATER-type GOLDEEN, but
weak against the GROUND-type SANDSHREW. {speaker}: However, the GRASS-type TANGELA is strong
against the GROUND type, so it was able to
defeat the SANDSHREW. {speaker}: Learn how POKéMON and move types match
up to gain the upper hand in battle.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57061:
{speaker}: In a DOUBLE BATTLE, a move that hits both
of your opponent's POKéMON is very useful. {speaker}: But, be careful.
There are some moves that also hit the POKéMON
in your party, too.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57062:
{speaker}: SURF is a move that hits both of the 
opponent's POKéMON in a DOUBLE BATTLE.
EARTHQUAKE, on the other hand, is an attack
that hits all POKéMON except the one using it. {speaker}: Some moves even hit the POKéMON that used
it in the first place.
That's why you need to be careful when using
certain moves.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57063:
{speaker}: A POKéMON of a single type may have a type
weakness, but a dual-type POKéMON may not 
have that same type weakness. {speaker}: On the other hand, a dual-type POKéMON may
have even more type disadvantages than 
a single-type POKéMON.
Knowing the difference is the key to victory.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57064:
{speaker}: For example, a WOOPER is a dual-type
POKéMON that is of the WATER and GROUND
types. {speaker}: If it is attacked by an ELECTRIC-type move,
which is strong against WATER-type POKéMON,
the fact that it is also a GROUND type makes
that attack completely ineffective. {speaker}: On the other hand, a GRASS-type attack,
which is strong against both the WATER and
GROUND types, would be devastating against
a WOOPER.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57065:
{speaker}: If the opposing POKéMON has a type 
advantage over yours, one tactic is to switch it
out of the battle and switch in a POKéMON held
in reserve. {speaker}: You should have POKéMON of different types
so that you can flexibly respond to whatever
type of POKéMON the opponent deploys.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57066:
{speaker}: When a PIDGEY and a PIKACHU battle, the 
FLYING-type PIDGEY is at a clear disadvantage
because of its type. {speaker}: In this situation, the PIDGEY should be
switched out and replaced by the GROUND-type
GEODUDE, which has a type advantage.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57067:
{speaker}: Many kinds of abilities provide an edge in
battle. {speaker}: That's why you absolutely have to confirm
what abilities your POKéMON have.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57068:
{speaker}: The ability LEVITATE completely protects
the POKéMON from being hit by any GROUND-
type attack. {speaker}: So, a POKéMON that's weak to GROUND-type
attacks won't take any damage if it has the
LEVITATE ability.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57069:
{speaker}: A POKéMON can hold one item and use it
during a battle to restore HP, raise stats, 
and so on. {speaker}: The holding POKéMON will use the item
automatically when needed, so it is very
convenient.
Not all items can be used by POKéMON, however.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57070:
{speaker}: The SITRUS BERRY held by the TAILLOW
automatically restores 30 HP if the POKéMON's
HP drops to half or less. {speaker}: There are many other kinds of items that can
be used by POKéMON during battle.
Make your POKéMON hold them and check what
happens.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57071:
{speaker}: Certain moves cause status problems, such
as confusion or a burn, in targets. {speaker}: If you're facing a tough POKéMON that's hard
to knock out, try using a move that enfeebles it
with a status problem.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57072:
{speaker}: For example, CONFUSE RAY causes
confusion.
WILL-O-WISP causes a burn.
These moves will give you an advantage. {speaker}: There are other enfeebling moves that cause
status problems.
Be sure you learn about them.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57073:
{speaker}: There are moves that can boost the stats of
your POKéMON.
There are also moves that lower the stats of the
opposing POKéMON. {speaker}: Try using moves that affect POKéMON stats
on a tough opponent.
You may get an easy victory out of it!
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57074:
{speaker}: By changing the stats of POKéMON in battle,
you can really change the amount of damage
inflicted and taken. {speaker}: Stat-changing moves are very useful when
you're up against tough opponents.
You should learn how they can help you.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57075:
{speaker}: The weather can affect the power and/or the
behavior of certain moves. {speaker}: A move that is somewhat tricky to use can
become extremely powerful if the weather
condition is changed in its favor.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57076:
{speaker}: For example, the move SOLARBEAM normally
requires a turn to charge up before firing on the
second turn. {speaker}: However, if the move SUNNY DAY has been
used, SOLARBEAM can fire every turn. {speaker}: Learn how certain moves work together to
create powerful combinations.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57077:
{speaker}: A DOUBLE BATTLE combo is one that
involves both the POKéMON in battle, obviously. {speaker}: By having two POKéMON work as a duo, even
tough opponents can be defeated.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57078:
{speaker}: When one POKéMON uses the move HELPING
HAND, its partner's attack move is made even
more powerful. {speaker}: The HELPING HAND combo is one of the most
basic DOUBLE BATTLE combos.
You definitely should know it.
M5_labo_2F/M5_labo_2F.57079: {speaker}: Now you're all set for a real battle!

M5_labo_B1/M5_labo_B1.40015:
{speaker}: {player}, over this way.
Come with me, please.
M5_labo_B1/M5_labo_B1.40016:
{speaker}: Go on, open that box and take
what's inside.
M5_labo_B1/M5_labo_B1.40447:
{speaker}: The battle against CIPHER
appears to have entered a decisive phase. {speaker}: I think the situation calls for a
special solution.
{player}, there's something here that I'd like
you to use.
M5_labo_B1/M5_labo_B1.40448:
{speaker}: Hold on, {player}!
Where are you going?
M5_labo_B1/M5_labo_B1.40450:
{speaker}: That's a MASTER BALL.
It's the one POKé BALL that is foolproof.
It has a 100% capture ratio. {speaker}: You should only use it if you're
sure that is the right thing to do.
Keep at it!

It's me, EAGUN!
Surely you haven't forgotten who I am?
M5_out/M5_out.40023:

Have you read it?
M5_out/M5_out.40027:

Have you read that E-MAIL I sent you?

M5_out/M5_out.40044:

Perhaps I made a mistake when I sent the E-MAIL

M5_out/M5_out.40045:

exploits, {player}, you see.
It made me want to have a battle with you. {speaker}: That said, {player}, there
are countless TRAINERS that would be honored
to battle with CIPHER's nemesis.
M5_out/M5_out.40057:
{speaker}: I therefore decided to take
charge and organize a COLOSSEUM event.
Impressed? {speaker}: But before we talk, we must
battle, you and I.
En garde!
M5_out/M5_out.40058:
{speaker}: {player}!
There is no need for you to hold back like
before!
This time, go all out!
M5_out/M5_out.40059:
{speaker}: Hey!
{player}! JOVI!
Where are you two off to?
M5_out/M5_out.40060:
{speaker}: Hi, {player}!
I heard about you!
Sounds like you've been racking up outstanding
scores on the BATTLE SIM SYSTEM. {speaker}: But instead of that virtual reality
stuff, how about a real battle for a change?
I'll be happy to battle with you anytime.
M5_out/M5_out.40061:
{speaker}: Okay, that's the spirit!
Let's get it on!
M5_out/M5_out.40062:
{speaker}: Okay.
If you're ever in the mood, give me a shout.
I'll be happy to battle with you anytime.
M5_out/M5_out.40063:
{speaker}: Well, that was an eye-opener!
{player}, you've become a lot tougher
without me noticing. {speaker}: Okay!
I'll train using the BATTLE SIM SYSTEM, too!
That's what I'll do.
M5_out/M5_out.40064:
{speaker}: Hoo, boy.
