{speaker}: We're lucky to have POKéMON CENTERS.
I mean, it's free! {speaker}: It doesn't matter how many POKéMON you
have--a POKéMON CENTER restores them all for
free!
Isn't that great?
M6_pc_1F/M6_pc_1F.41063:
{speaker}: There's a PC for anyone to use at every
POKéMON CENTER. {speaker}: You're free to use it, too!
M6_pc_1F/M6_pc_1F.54189:
There's a book titled "A Study of Sea-Dwelling
POKéMON."

M6_pc_2F/M6_pc_2F.41064:
{speaker}: I became a TRAINER at this age, so I've
been coming here daily to learn more about what
training involves. {speaker}: But, wow, I see that you're already raising
POKéMON at your age.
I consider that impressive. {speaker}: All right!
I'll do my best to keep up with you!
M6_pc_2F/M6_pc_2F.41065:
{speaker}: I've been up on dry land for so long now, I'm
losing the feel for life on the sea. {speaker}: I've assembled all my supplies, and my
POKéMON are restored to full health.
But who knows when the next ship will sail?
M6_pc_2F/M6_pc_2F.54190: It's lined with books on POKéMON.

M6_shop_1F/M6_shop_1F.41046:
{speaker}: Oh! Uh... Welcome!
Uh... Welcome to my POKéMON MART, and, uh...
M6_shop_1F/M6_shop_1F.41047:
{speaker}: Um... What was I supposed to say?
Oh, it doesn't matter!
I've finally become the owner of a POKéMON
MART!
M6_shop_1F/M6_shop_1F.41054:
{speaker}: ...Oh, no!
What am I saying?
I'm so sorry!
M6_shop_1F/M6_shop_1F.41055:
{speaker}: Welcome!
We've added to our fine selection of
merchandise to meet all your needs in
today's wild POKéMON boom!
M6_shop_1F/M6_shop_1F.41066:
{speaker}: POTION, POTION...
We seafaring men know to stock up on POTIONS
when in port! {speaker}: Unlike dry land, there's not a POKéMON
CENTER to be seen on the open sea.
So, you never want to be caught short on
POTIONS! {speaker}: I know!
Here, let me give you a POTION.
It's convenient, I tell you!
M6_shop_1F/M6_shop_1F.41067:
{speaker}: Even on dry land, in certain situations, that
POTION will be more trusty than a POKéMON
CENTER!
M6_shop_1F/M6_shop_1F.41068:
{speaker}: POTION, POTION...
We seafaring men know to stock up on POTIONS
when in port! {speaker}: Unlike dry land, there's not a POKéMON
CENTER to be seen on the open sea.
So, you never want to be caught short on
POTIONS!
M6_shop_1F/M6_shop_1F.41069:
{speaker}: There are so many items, it's utterly
bewildering.
What should I get, I wonder?
M6_shop_1F/M6_shop_1F.41070:
{speaker}: Hey, I'm buying a whole lot here.
How about throwing in a little bonus?
How about it?
Come on!
M6_shop_1F/M6_shop_1F.41092:
{speaker}: There we go!
That works!
Watch me make this shop the best in all of
the ORRE REGION!
M6_shop_1F/M6_shop_1F.41094:
{speaker}: ...Oh, no!
I'm so sorry!
Uh... POKé BALLS and POKé SNACKS!
The perfect companions for TRAINERS!
M6_shop_1F/M6_shop_1F.41095:
{speaker}: Greetings!
We've added new merchandise that's perfect for
outstanding TRAINERS!
M6_shop_1F/M6_shop_1F.41096:
{speaker}: Finally, my merchandise selection is the best
in all ORRE!
But my dream doesn't end here!
I want the best shop in the world!
M6_shop_1F/M6_shop_1F.41097:
{speaker}: Oh, no!
I beg your pardon!
Uh... MAX POTION, and uh... FULL RESTORE!
Would you like some?

M6_shop_2F/M6_shop_2F.41071:
{speaker}: For a poisoning, use an ANTIDOTE.
PARLYZ HEAL cures paralysis.
And AWAKENING wakes up a sleeping POKéMON. {speaker}: Oh, yes, if a POKéMON falls asleep in
a battle, you can rouse it by calling it.
M6_shop_2F/M6_shop_2F.41179:
{speaker}: I've decided to retire from selling herbal
medicine.
It's become too hard for me to gather the
ingredients, you see. {speaker}: It's not an easy task working one's way
through tall grass, searching among rocks,
and so on.
It's too physically taxing for me.
M6_shop_2F/M6_shop_2F.41435:
{speaker}: Oh! I'm so sorry!
I'm sorry for all the trouble we put you through!

M6_tower_2F/M6_tower_2F.41143:
{speaker}: Whew...
Oh? Now, you're a rare child.
Most people would take the elevator. {speaker}: Youngster, are you doing this for exercise?
Hohohoho.
M6_tower_2F/M6_tower_2F.41318:
{speaker}: Hi, youngster, beware.
There's a peculiar character loitering at the top
of the LIGHTHOUSE. {speaker}: What's peculiar about him?
Well, he has a huge round head, for one thing.
And his build is all stringy and gangly, but his
motions are all floppy and snaky. {speaker}: What kind of diet do you have to be on to get
a build like that?
That's what I'd like to know.
M6_tower_2F/M6_tower_2F.41344:
{speaker}: Oh, youngster, beware!
There are odd people still loitering at the top of
the LIGHTHOUSE.
M6_tower_2F/M6_tower_2F.41348:
{speaker}: Oh?
You drove off that round-headed, gangly, snaky
guy? {speaker}: Well, isn't that good of you!
You've made it safe to walk these streets again.
M6_tower_2F/M6_tower_2F.41349:
{speaker}: Oh, hello, lad.
Are you taking a stroll in the LIGHTHOUSE, too? {speaker}: The stairs here are excellent workouts for our
old legs.
Hohohoho.

M6_tower_4F/M6_tower_4F.41144:
{speaker}: When I look down from the top of the
LIGHTHOUSE, I get frightened as if I'm being
sucked down. {speaker}: But that sensation of falling...
It grows on you.
M6_tower_4F/M6_tower_4F.41319:
{speaker}: There's an odd bunch of goons upstairs that
have kind of taken over the place.
I can't go up there because they're intimidating. {speaker}: It's rather upsetting.
I wish they'd go away soon.
M6_tower_4F/M6_tower_4F.41345:
{speaker}: Since I last saw you, that weird bunch hasn't
left the top floor once.
I can't go up there because they're intimidating. {speaker}: It's rather upsetting.
I wish they'd go away soon.
M6_tower_4F/M6_tower_4F.41350:
{speaker}: I thought it got quiet upstairs.
So those bizarre guys are gone, huh? {speaker}: I'm glad to hear that.
People will be able to visit the LIGHTHOUSE
again.
M6_tower_4F/M6_tower_4F.41351:
{speaker}: When I look down from the top of the
LIGHTHOUSE, I get that sensation of falling.
It grows on you, that feeling. {speaker}: But the other night, I dreamt that I was at the
LIGHTHOUSE, then I fell out of bed.
I'm lucky it was just a dream!

M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41145:
{speaker}: You see the island in the distance out at
sea?
It's always obscured by clouds. {speaker}: If only those clouds weren't there, we would
get gorgeous sunsets at dusk.
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41275:
{speaker}: Lately, the clouds cloaking CITADARK ISLE
have been roiling even more than usual.
I hope it's not a sign of something bad.
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41320:
{speaker}: L-lad!
W-who are those people?! {speaker}: They've startled me so much, I've become
rooted to the spot!
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41321:
{speaker}: What? What?
Not you again! {speaker}: Our boss is busy dancing!
You can see that, can't you?
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41322:
{speaker}: Oh, Boss!
The way you gyrate is the greatest!
Shake, shake, shake!
Shake it!
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41323:
{speaker}: What?!
You brat!
You'd show up here?! {speaker}: Why do you always mess with our
plans to get all the POKéMON in the world? {speaker}: No thanks to you, we've lost
more POKéMON than we've caught!
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41328:
{speaker}: I, I, I!
Want you! Want you!
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41330:
{speaker}: Let me wind down the music and
take a look!
Oh, you are!
You are that super-annoying brat! {speaker}: It's all your fault that my
SHADOW POKéMON is the last of the kind! {speaker}: But you did worse!
You messed up my dance for celebrating the
future of TEAM MIROR! {speaker}: Today of all days, you're not
going to get away!
No, you'll never, never get away! {speaker}: Let the music play!
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41331:
{speaker}: Fuhohoho!
You've come back again?
You super-annoying brat, you! {speaker}: My dance to celebrate our future
is reaching a climax.
I can't let you meddle now!
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41332:
{speaker}: Oh, how dare you!
I say, how dare you! {speaker}: That SHADOW DRAGONITE was
CIPHER'S very last SHADOW POKéMON! {speaker}: There's only one thing to do now!
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41336:
{speaker}: Huh? What is this?
In my perfectly coiffed afro do, I found this little
device.
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41337:
Bzzownt! Nothing appears on the MIROR RADAR anymore.
It appears to have broken.
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41338:
{speaker}: Lad, you were splendid!
But that odd fellow with the gigantic head...
Who was that? {speaker}: At first, I thought he had a VOLTORB resting
on his shoulders.
But it turned out to be his hair... {speaker}: It just goes to show there are strange people
about in the world.
Even a POKéMON would be startled!
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41339:
{speaker}: Oh, how dare you!
I say, how dare you! {speaker}: But, I still have the SHADOW
DRAGONITE with me! {speaker}: All I need is a little rest.
When I feel chipper again, I'll show you who's
the star with my elegant dance steps!
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41340:
{speaker}: Our boss MIROR B.'s dancing
really is the greatest, but... {speaker}: Is the future really going to be
bright for TEAM MIROR?
Sigh...
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41341:
{speaker}: The boss is a man among men who
lives to make all the world's POKéMON his! {speaker}: He's not going to let a little thing
like losing to you bother him!
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41342:
{speaker}: Oh, not you again!
Don't mess up our boss's dance performance! {speaker}: Our bright future together
depends on how it goes!
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41343:
{speaker}: Our boss is aiming for the world! {speaker}: There's no way that he'd lose to
some kid like you!
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41346:
{speaker}: L-lad!
When is that funny-headed man going to stop
that dancing of his? {speaker}: It's so startling, I've grown rooted to the
spot!
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41352:
{speaker}: L-lad!
You're a ferocious battler! {speaker}: I'm so awed, I've grown rooted to the spot!
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41366:
{speaker}: You there!
You look like a TRAINER to me! {speaker}: Somebody gave me a wickedly
tough POKéMON.
I'll test it out on you!
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41367:
{speaker}: I'll give you another battle!
Bring it on!
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41368:
{speaker}: What was that all about?
I joined that organization because they said
they'd give me a strong POKéMON--something
that's not like the usual ones. {speaker}: Well, what was so tough about
that?
I was conned!
M6_tower_top/M6_tower_top.41369:
{speaker}: The organization that I joined?
I can't remember what they were called. {speaker}: They said they didn't have
enough supplies, so they wouldn't even give me
a uniform.
Maybe they're poor.

S1_out/S1_out.42001:
{speaker}: Belch!
Whew, did I ever pig out!
That was the first decent food I've had in too
long, I tell you!
S1_out/S1_out.42002:
{speaker}: Yeah, that's great and all,
TRUDLY, but are we really doing the right thing
living this way? {speaker}: I worry about my future, you know?
Maybe I really need to consider changing my
lifestyle.
S1_out/S1_out.42003:
{speaker}: Now what are you going on about,
FOLLY?
You're not your usual self. {speaker}: Don't tell me you've forgotten
the boss's dream?
We're going to own all the POKéMON in the
whole wide world.
S1_out/S1_out.42004:
{speaker}: Well, that's what I'm talking
about...
S1_out/S1_out.42007:
{speaker}: Fuhohoho!
Did I overhear you two talking about me?
S1_out/S1_out.42008:
{speaker}: Oh?
Well, if it isn't that super-aggravating little boy
who served me up a bitter memory at the POKé 
SPOT!
S1_out/S1_out.42009:
{speaker}: Oh?
Well, if it isn't that ultra-uncool little boy whom
I beat like a drum at the POKé SPOT!
S1_out/S1_out.42010:
{speaker}: Fuhohoho!
What perfect timing! {speaker}: For a little exercise after my meal,
I'll wipe you out with my elegant steps! {speaker}: Let the music start!
S1_out/S1_out.42011:
{speaker}: Fuhohoho!
I'll beat you as often as you wish!
S1_out/S1_out.42012:
{speaker}: Oh, how dare you!
I say, how dare you! {speaker}: Next time, I'll put things right
and lay down my elegant steps! {speaker}: Let's go!
Escape!
S1_out/S1_out.42020:
{speaker}: Hey, my name's WILLIE.
I remember who you are now, kid. {6a}{speaker}: You're the kid that sent CIPHER
packing in PHENAC, aren't you?
You were on TV.
S1_out/S1_out.42021:
{speaker}: Hey, listen.
Let's have a battle, you and me.
S1_out/S1_out.42022:
{speaker}: What are you saying?
You're joshing, right?
S1_out/S1_out.42023:
{speaker}: Yeahah!
That's the spirit! {speaker}: All right, all right.
Over here, this way!
S1_out/S1_out.42024:
{speaker}: Yeeeeeeaaaah!
I'm burning now!
I'm on fire!
It's full-throttle time! {speaker}: Vrum! Vrooom!
Let's roll!
S1_out/S1_out.42025:
{speaker}: But, yeah, you're tough.
Real tough, kid.
You stomped us good. {speaker}: So long as you're around,
ORRE's future is safe!
S1_out/S1_out.42026:
{speaker}: Oh, hey, it's you!
Just the kid I wanted to see! {speaker}: You see, I had the urge to have
another POKéMON battle with you.
It was like an itch I couldn't scratch! {speaker}: So, come on.
Let's battle.
I'm not losing this time!
S1_out/S1_out.42027:
{speaker}: But, yeah, you're tough.
Real tough, kid.
You stomped us good.
S1_out/S1_out.42028:
{speaker}: Hi there, kid!
Too bad about our last battle. {speaker}: But you weren't going all out in
that last battle of ours.
I could tell your heart wasn't in it. {speaker}: Let's have another battle!
This time, let's battle for real!

S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42013:
{speaker}: Is that right, my friend?
So you're traveling by your lonesome. {speaker}: If you're going to stay on the road, you
should stock up on supplies here.
I've got a selection of POKé BALLS, too! {speaker}: For the longest time, POKé BALLS were just
good for catching dust.
They're selling again, thanks to the wild
POKéMON!
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42014:
{speaker}: Did you see the news?
CIPHER's been brazen about what they do this
time around. {speaker}: But I wonder...
Where'd they take all the POKéMON that were on
the S.S. LIBRA?
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42015:
{speaker}: Hi!
We've been traveling around the ORRE REGION.
We've been jogging the whole time! {speaker}: Why don't you come run with us?
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42016:
{speaker}: When we ran out to ECLO CANYON, we found
the building that was TEAM SNAGEM's HIDEOUT. {speaker}: I'd heard that they broke up long ago, but I
got this feeling that there were people out there. {speaker}: Maybe it was the ghosts of TEAM SNAGEM?
Aiyeeeeh!
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42017:
{speaker}: Little guy, I've seen your face somewhere
before.
Are you maybe a famous POKéMON TRAINER?
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42018:
{speaker}: Fu...
I can tell.
Your eyes have the look of someone good. {speaker}: I bet your POKéMON are outstanding, too,
little guy. {speaker}: If the opportunity ever arises, I'd like to have
a battle with you. {speaker}: Fu...
Though I doubt you could beat me.
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42029:
{speaker}: I'm HORDEL.
Are you maybe {player}? {6a}{speaker}: Am I glad to see you!
I was terrified that CIPHER would find me and
drag me away if I stayed much longer. {speaker}: You see, I fled from CIPHER's
KEY LAIR way in the north.
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42030:
{speaker}: Oh?
You know that place?
Wow, you people at ONBS sure get information
quickly. {speaker}: The KEY LAIR is a factory.
It was made to mass-produce SHADOW
POKéMON. {speaker}: When I discovered that, I was
horrified.
I came to hate my job, so I escaped. {speaker}: When I fled, I managed to spirit
away just one SHADOW POKéMON. {speaker}: But even then, there were
already many SHADOW POKéMON.
I'm sure that they've produced even more since
then.
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42031:
{speaker}: While I was with CIPHER, there
were rumors about a boy who snags SHADOW
POKéMON and purifies them. {speaker}: Might that person be you?
If so, I have a giant favor to ask of you. {speaker}: Would you purify the SHADOW
TOGEPI that I fled from CIPHER with?
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42032:
{speaker}: I see...
Then I have no choice.
I'll just have to raise it myself. {speaker}: I want to return it to its natural
state as soon as possible, but I'm not good at
battling...
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42033:
{speaker}: Thank you so much!
Please take good care of it!
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42034:
{speaker}: ...I wish I could say that, but
your party is full.
I can't pass this guy over to you. {speaker}: I'm sorry, but please make room
in your party, then come back for it.
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42036:
{speaker}: Okay, there you go.
Please purify my little guy for me.
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42037:
{speaker}: I rescued a SHADOW TOGEPI
when I fled from CIPHER.
Can I please get you to purify it for me?
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42038:
{speaker}: Oh, hello.
How is my SHADOW TOGEPI doing?
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42039:
{speaker}: Besides my little guy, there were
many POKéMON that had been turned into
SHADOW POKéMON at CIPHER's KEY LAIR. {speaker}: In my desperation to flee, I wasn't
able to save other POKéMON... {speaker}: It still gnaws at my conscience,
wondering what became of the other POKéMON.
If only there were some way of saving them!
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42040:
{speaker}: Oh! The {4e} in your
party is my {4e}, isn't it? {speaker}: You've finished its purification!
Oh, thank you!
I'm so glad you're back to normal,
{4e}! {speaker}: Now, may I have my {4e}
back? {speaker}: I'm willing to trade you the
ELEKID I've been raising in return.
Would that be okay?
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42041:
{speaker}: I understand...
I guess you would get attached to it after seeing
it through its purification. {speaker}: Though I feel a twinge of jealousy,
please take good care of my {4e}
for me.
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42042:
{speaker}: Oh, you will!?
Great!
Let's trade right away!
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42043:
{speaker}: Great, our trade's done.
Please treat my ELEKID with kindness, the way
you did with my {4e}.
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42044:
{speaker}: Even though that ELEKID is
cute, it doesn't measure up against my
{4e} at all. {speaker}: Thank you so much for
purifying it!
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42045:
{speaker}: Oh, hello, {player}.
How's my old {4e}?
Is it doing well?
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42046:
{speaker}: I've been thinking things over...
Will you please trade your {4e} for
my ELEKID?
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42048:
{speaker}: Hello, {player}.
How have you been? {speaker}: I beg your pardon?
You wrecked CIPHER's KEY LAIR, {player}?! {speaker}: {player}, are you perhaps
really tough as a TRAINER?
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42049:
{speaker}: Oh, so modest, too!
But the moment I laid my eyes on you, I sensed
that you were different. {speaker}: I guess very talented people do
have a different atmosphere about them.
It's very impressive to see in someone so young
as you!
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42050:
{speaker}: Wow, to think that my
{4e} was purified by someone as great
as you...
What an honor. {speaker}: I'll have to get you to autograph
my {4e}'s back sometime!
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42051:
{speaker}: Wow, to have a fantastic
TRAINER like you purify my POKéMON,
{player}... {speaker}: My {4e} is sure lucky. {speaker}: Please treat my ELEKID with
kindness, the way you did with my
{4e}.
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42052:
{speaker}: Oh! The {4e} in your
party is my {4e}, isn't it?
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42053:
{speaker}: Your {4e} seems to be
holding the item {2d}.
Will you trade it to me anyway?
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42055:
{speaker}: By the way, are you searching for
TEAM SNAGEM's HIDEOUT?
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42056:
{speaker}: I passed it while fleeing from
CIPHER's KEY LAIR.
It was in a desolate spot.
S1_shop_1F/S1_shop_1F.42057:
{speaker}: TEAM SNAGEM must be a hardy
bunch to put up with a building that far gone to
rack and ruin.

S2_building_1F_2/S2_building_1F_2.43001:
{speaker}: Hm!
Are you a new recruit seeking to join TEAM
SNAGEM?
Or just an intruder? {speaker}: Let me battle you and see!
S2_building_1F_2/S2_building_1F_2.43002:
{speaker}: You know what you're doing with
your POKéMON.
I hate to admit it, but you've wiped me out. {speaker}: We could use your toughness.
Come, join TEAM SNAGEM!
We're always on the lookout for outstanding
talent!
S2_building_1F_2/S2_building_1F_2.43003:
{speaker}: Huh?
Kid, didn't I see you before?
S2_building_1F_2/S2_building_1F_2.43004:
{speaker}: I get it now!
You were on the S.S. LIBRA when I went to
get the SNAG MACHINE!
S2_building_1F_2/S2_building_1F_2.43005:
{speaker}: Okay, I got it now.
I won't have to agonize over this!
You're the kid from back there. I got it now.
S2_building_1F_2/S2_building_1F_2.43042:
{speaker}: Sigh...
So the SNAG MACHINE ends up with you again... {speaker}: Darn...
After all the trouble we went through to get it,
too.
S2_building_1F_2/S2_building_1F_2.43044:
{speaker}: GONZAP and WAKIN have gone
out, and they haven't been back yet. {speaker}: They didn't abandon us, did they?
... {speaker}: Ahaha!
Th-they wouldn't do anything like that!
Long live GONZAP!
S2_building_1F_2/S2_building_1F_2.43045:
{speaker}: You're {player}, aren't you?
I met you on the S.S. LIBRA! {speaker}: Ahahahaha!
I won't forget about you again--don't you worry
about that!
S2_building_1F_2/S2_building_1F_2.43049:
{speaker}: GONZAP and WAKIN came back
finally. {speaker}: They sure had us worried, but
now things are back to normal.
Hehehe.
S2_building_1F_2/S2_building_1F_2.43050:
{speaker}: That SNAG MACHINE is sweet.
I wish we'd kept it.
S2_building_1F_2/S2_building_1F_2.43060:
{speaker}: GONZAP finally came back, but
then he took off again. {speaker}: This time, WAKIN went, too.
Where'd they go this time?

S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43006:
{speaker}: I'm with TEAM SNAGEM!
But I don't have a SNAG MACHINE, so I've never
snagged anything yet! {speaker}: Do you understand how pathetic
that makes me feel?
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43007:
{speaker}: When I joined up, the SNAG
MACHINE was already gone!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43008:
{speaker}: Waah! {player}!
Darn it!
You came to get the SNAG MACHINE back!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43009:
{speaker}: I've already taken the SNAG
MACHINE to the boss!
GONZAP's mighty tough!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43010:
{speaker}: Sheesh...
This wall hasn't been repaired for a long time... {speaker}: It can't be helped because we
haven't made much money lately.
This just stinks...
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43011:
{speaker}: Huh?!
While I was feeling sorry for myself, an intruder
appeared!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43012:
{speaker}: You wait...
We'll get our spot in the sun back!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43022:
{speaker}: But, uh...
It's not because the MACHINE's small, it's
because your arm is so thick, GONZAP...
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43023:
{6a}{speaker}: Shut your yap!
Bring me something so useless as this...
Huh?
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43025:
{speaker}: Hey! You!
You're that kid! {speaker}: He must've come for the SNAG
MACHINE!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43026:
{speaker}: Good work getting out here.
But we're not about to let you have it
back.
Give up now, kid!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43027:
{speaker}: Heh, you're not as tough as the
rumors say you are. {speaker}: For a TRAINER at your level, there
was no need to put anything to sleep.
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43028:
{speaker}: If we snag all the SHADOW
POKéMON from them using this SNAG MACHINE,
CIPHER will collapse. {speaker}: When that happens, TEAM
SNAGEM will step up and take over!
So, how about it?
Will you join us?
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43029:
{speaker}: Gwahahaha!
Don't lie, because you're obviously no good
at it!
Your lips are twitching! {speaker}: All you really want to do is get
this SNAG MACHINE back, don't you? {speaker}: Fine!
You'll have your SNAG MACHINE back, but only
if you can beat me!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43030:
{speaker}: All right.
You mean to get this SNAG MACHINE back, no
matter what. {speaker}: Fine!
You'll have your SNAG MACHINE back, but only
if you can beat me!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43031:
{speaker}: What do you think you're doing
hanging around like that? {speaker}: Before you really tick off GONZAP,
you'd better get lost fast, I'm telling you.
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43032:
{speaker}: Oh, hey.
You're weak in battle, but you do have guts. {speaker}: Right now, we need this SNAG
MACHINE more than we need your guts. {speaker}: If you're going to be a pest, this
is what you'll get!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43033:
{speaker}: If we had your expertise and the
SNAG MACHINE, we'd have no trouble crushing
CIPHER. {speaker}: But, fine!
A promise is a promise!
Here, take your SNAG MACHINE back.
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43034:
{speaker}: Hah?
Are you serious, GONZAP?
After all the trouble we went through to get it? {speaker}: Weren't we going to use that to
teach CIPHER a lesson for dumping us?
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43035:
{speaker}: This kid's fighting to bring
CIPHER down, right?
Him and us, we're both after the same thing.
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43036:
{speaker}: Here, kid, take it.
You can have your SNAG MACHINE back.
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43038:
{speaker}: That thing didn't fit my arm
anyway.
Gwahahaha! {speaker}: Oh, yeah!
I may as well give you this, too!
It just goes to show how I can be generous!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43039:
{speaker}: This is a gift from me.
There's a chest in a corner on the ground floor.
That's the KEY for it.
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43040:
{speaker}: All right, kid.
Get going!
CIPHER's secret factory is to the north. {speaker}: We'll all be looking forward to
your crushing CIPHER! {speaker}: That's when TEAM SNAGEM will
again be in control!
Gwahahaha!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43041:
{speaker}: You'd better appreciate GONZAP's
generosity.
You repay him by sticking it to CIPHER! {speaker}: We should be the only gang in
ORRE.
There's no room for two!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43043:
{speaker}: You beat GONZAP in a battle?
Yeah, sure, tell me about it.
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43046:
{speaker}: Huh?
What are you doing here? {speaker}: Didn't you meet up with GONZAP
and WAKIN?
They went to help you. {speaker}: ...Are those two lost somewhere?
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43051:
{speaker}: GONZAP and WAKIN helped you?
Is that right? {speaker}: Sheesh.
GONZAP has this weird sense of nobility and
chivalry. {speaker}: I guess you've earned his
admiration, whether it's welcome or not.
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43052:
{speaker}: Heheh!
My ODDISH was useful, hey? {speaker}: If you have trouble sleeping, it'll
have you snoring in no time!
Heheh!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43053:
{speaker}: Ah, it's the kid!
How'd things turn out?
The look on your face tells me it went well,
though. {speaker}: Good work!
If I had underlings like you, TEAM SNAGEM
would be set for life!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43054:
{speaker}: But you wait!
One of these days, I'll rebuild TEAM SNAGEM
to its former glory! {speaker}: When that happens, you'll be our
sworn enemy!
Don't be surprised when it happens!
Gaahaha!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43057:
{speaker}: It's fantastic that GONZAP came
back to us.
But we still can't snag anything. {speaker}: This empty feeling...
You wouldn't understand it!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43058:
{speaker}: Hmm...
What is this stain on the wall...
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43059:
{speaker}: Today might be my lucky day.
GONZAP came back and everything.
We might finally get lucky!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43061:
{speaker}: GONZAP is still out.
Oh...
When are we ever going to snag anything again? {speaker}: This hollow feeling...
You wouldn't understand it!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43062:
{speaker}: GONZAP has gone off somewhere.
I think it was to ORRE COLOSSEUM with some
trusty minions. {speaker}: I want to go out, too!
I'm sick of counting stains on the walls!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43064:
{speaker}: That SNAG MACHINE you say you went and
got, what's up with it?! {speaker}: It's too honking small!
How am I supposed to fit this on my arm?
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43065:
{speaker}: Oh, hey, not bad!
Pretty impressive, if I may say so!
S2_building_2F_2/S2_building_2F_2.43066:
{speaker}: Listen, kid.
Why don't you join us, and we'll smash CIPHER
together.

S2_building_3F_2/S2_building_3F_2.43013:
{speaker}: If you join up right now, you'll
not only get the day's wages, but also a
commuting allowance, and even a box lunch. {speaker}: Depending on your qualifications,
you can even receive up to 20% more paid
holidays!
You won't find terms this good... Huh?
S2_building_3F_2/S2_building_3F_2.43014:
{speaker}: Why, you...
You can't butt into a job interview!
This is what you'll get!
S2_building_3F_2/S2_building_3F_2.43015:
{speaker}: Nope, no way!
I'm not letting anyone tougher than me join
TEAM SNAGEM!
S2_building_3F_2/S2_building_3F_2.43016:
{speaker}: I came out because they promised to pay me
the day's wages and buy my lunch.
What is this place all about, anyway?
S2_building_3F_2/S2_building_3F_2.43017:
{speaker}: TEAM SNAGEM is on a membership
recruiting drive.
We need more people for taking the fight to
CIPHER's HIDEOUT! {speaker}: We'll hire anybody, even kids,
if they're strong.
S2_building_3F_2/S2_building_3F_2.43018:
{speaker}: Excellent!
You've made the grade!
We'll battle no longer!
S2_building_3F_2/S2_building_3F_2.43019:
{speaker}: What?!
You're raiding TEAM SNAGEM's HIDEOUT?!
That takes guts!
S2_building_3F_2/S2_building_3F_2.43020:
{speaker}: Back in the old days, just saying
the TEAM SNAGEM name made even crying kids
shut up instantly.
Now, we can't even beat a kid!
S2_building_3F_2/S2_building_3F_2.43047:
{speaker}: We're not doing job interviews
anymore.
TEAM SNAGEM's going to be run by a small
cadre of elites!
S2_building_3F_2/S2_building_3F_2.43048:
{speaker}: This is a good place.
Whatever happens, they always give me a box
lunch every day.
S2_building_3F_2/S2_building_3F_2.43055:
{speaker}: You know, we haven't snagged
anything in a long time. {speaker}: So, I was thinking, we should get
a new name. {speaker}: What would be a good name for
us, I wonder?
S2_building_3F_2/S2_building_3F_2.43056:
{speaker}: Before, our very name would
scare even crying kids into silence.
Now we're fading into obscurity...
S2_building_3F_2/S2_building_3F_2.43063:
{speaker}: Huh?
Are there fewer members than before?
I must be tired or something.

S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44008:
{speaker}: Anyway, let CHOBIN acquaint you
with just some of DR. KAMINKO's greatest
inventions. {speaker}: Let the VCR roll!
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44010:
{speaker}: Ah, yes!
That's it!
ROBO TRAINERS! {speaker}: No, wait...
There's something wrong with that idea...
Hmm...
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44011:
{speaker}: Hello, CHOBIN needs your help!
Do something about that little girl, please. {speaker}: She keeps taking things from the
manor and hiding them under this floor. {speaker}: Of course, the things she takes
are not needed, so that in itself is not a problem
for CHOBIN. {speaker}: But that space is open to below,
so it could be dangerous if anything were to fall.
CHOBIN asks if you would say something to her.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44012:
{speaker}: However, CHOBIN realizes
perhaps she is not likely to listen to you anyway.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44013:
{speaker}: That is true.
She does not appear to be a girl who will listen
and obey anyone's instructions.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44014:
{speaker}: Oh, yes.
May CHOBIN ask if you would inspect the
CRANE ROOM on occasion from now on?
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44015:
{speaker}: Wow, you're a lifesaver!
CHOBIN is no friend of high places. {speaker}: If you find anything, CHOBIN
won't know if you took it, so take it.
But don't take CHOBIN's treasures! {speaker}: Okay, {player}, CHOBIN is
counting on you.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44016:
{speaker}: Oh, please!
If there is anything there, CHOBIN won't know if
you took it, so take it! {speaker}: CHOBIN is no friend of high
places!
Uh... Does that girl know, maybe?
Is that why she does it?
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44017:
{speaker}: The room downstairs... You went
down there?
CHOBIN's treasure--which is hidden in the chest
in the rear--you didn't touch it? {speaker}: Huh?
Only sheets of white paper were in it?
That cannot be! {speaker}: Those were blueprints for
CHOBIN's inventions over the years. {speaker}: What is CHOBIN to do?
CHOBIN cannot remember all the inventions that
have been attempted! {speaker}: Oh...
That paper must have been it!
DR. KAMINKO's invention--the paper that makes
ink fade over time...
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44025:
{speaker}: The BATTLE CDs in this manor?
What do you gain by asking me that? {speaker}: I don't enjoying admitting it one
bit, but they are quite well made.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44026:
{speaker}: ...I have no interest in such
things!
I acquired them purely for research. {speaker}: They should still be lying around
here and there.
If they are what you desire, you're welcome to
the whole lot.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44028:
{speaker}: MIMI!
Let's go home with big brother!
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44029:
{speaker}: Did you come from the POKéMON
HQ LAB? {speaker}: My name's MAKAN.
I run the PARTS SHOP in GATEON PORT. {6a}{speaker}: How is the LAB's DIRECTOR?
PROF. KRANE, yes?
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44030:
{speaker}: Ah, yes.
If you'd be so kind, please tell the PROFESSOR
that the MACHINE PART he needed is ready,
and that he should come get it anytime.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44032:
{speaker}: Oh, my, even this young lady
came from the POKéMON HQ LAB?
Take care on your way home.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44033:
{6a}{speaker}: You there!
You, child!
That area is off-limits!
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44034:
{6a}{speaker}: Hm?
Incidentally, child, how long have you been
here?
Hmm...?
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44040:
{6a}{speaker}: Fufufu...
When this robo is completed, I shall become
the world's most powerful man! {speaker}: Fufufu...
Waahahaha!
Huh?!
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44041:
{speaker}: Who are you?!
How long have you been there?!
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44042:
{speaker}: I... I...
I'm in the middle of highly important research.
I'm quite busy. Now, if you'll excuse me, I ask
that you refrain from disturbing me.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44044:
{speaker}: Ahaha!
Incredible, is it not?
There is much more than that, too.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44045:
{speaker}: The DOCTOR's inventions, which
are fantastic, can be seen on this monitor. {speaker}: CHOBIN gives you permission to
use this anytime you like.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44047:
{speaker}: Huh?
On close inspection, it's you again.
CHOBIN wishes you spoke up right away.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44048:
{speaker}: The DOCTOR is currently busy.
He is developing a secret robo that is strictly
a secret to everyone.
But CHOBIN is not busy. {speaker}: CHOBIN is, in fact, bored.
Ahahaha.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44050:
{speaker}: Okay!
CHOBIN will now show you the inventions of the
inestimable DR. KAMINKO. {speaker}: DR. KAMINKO's inventions, it
needs to be said, are number one in the world!
CHOBIN is full of admiration! {speaker}: Oh?
Why does CHOBIN know that they are number
one worldwide?
That needs explaining? {speaker}: In the whole wide world, no one
but DR. KAMINKO would invent such inventions!
Therefore, they are number one in the world
without question!
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44051:
{speaker}: Our DR. KAMINKO, who is verily
great, is inventing in that room there.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44052:
{speaker}: Uh-oh!
That girl is at DR. KAMINKO's side again!
CHOBIN hopes she is causing no disturbance.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44053:
{speaker}: Oh, no, mustn't go in there.
That's where corporate secrets are kept.
Entry is very much prohibited. {speaker}: CHOBIN's treasure is secretly
kept there, too.
But that is also a corporate secret.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44085:
{speaker}: Hmm...
Wherein lay the weakness of my ROBO
POKéMON? {speaker}: Ah, eureka!
Next time, I shall make a real POKéMON drive it! {speaker}: No, wait.
Something about that plan sounds extraneous...
Hmm...
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44086:
{speaker}: You, child!
That area is strictly prohibited... {speaker}: Oh, never mind.
The basement R&D ROOM is no longer home to
any secrets. {speaker}: You may come and go as you
wish, but try not to disturb MAKAN inside.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44092:
{speaker}: Hmm...
I have grown weary of tricking others with
peculiar inventions...
The ROBO POKéMON were no good... {speaker}: Sigh...
I need a new purpose in life...
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44105:
{speaker}: Waah!
What are you doing there?!
How long have you been there?!
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44106:
{speaker}: Hmm...
I have grown weary of tricking others with
peculiar inventions...
The ROBO POKéMON were no good... {speaker}: Sigh...
I need a new purpose in life...
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44107:
{speaker}: CHOBIN went off on a battle
quest saying he will demonstrate the power of
ROBO POKéMON to the world. {speaker}: But that's not necessary.
After all, the ROBO POKéMON are the ultimate. {speaker}: After all, one is playing a key
role in bringing CIPHER down.
Fuhahahahah!
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44112:
{speaker}: Hi, big brother!
This is a funny drawing! {speaker}: It's a really detailed drawing of a
really weird machine!
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44113:
{speaker}: ...Huh?
Are you going home already, big brother?
But you just got here! {speaker}: Oh... JOVI gets it!
JOVI has to show you how to go home, right? {speaker}: Okay!
That's what JOVI will do!
JOVI will take you home!
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44115:
{speaker}: JOVI will visit again, DOCTOR!
Bye-bye!
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44116:
{speaker}: We will!
JOVI will come for another visit!
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44117:
{speaker}: That's how DR. KAMINKO is all
the time. {speaker}: CHOBIN said that a genius has
different sensibilities from ordinary people. {speaker}: Does "sensibilities" mean you're
kind of absentminded and in a fog?
Don't people say PROF. KRANE is a genius?
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44118:
{speaker}: JOVI will take big brother home
today, so JOVI has to go, too!
Bye-bye! {speaker}: Next time JOVI comes, please let
JOVI try those googly glasses!
Promise!
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44119:
{speaker}: CHOBIN cannot possibly make
that sort of a promise.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44120:
{speaker}: She is your sister?
Do something about her, please.
She never listens to what CHOBIN says, ever.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44121:
{speaker}: When she is here, CHOBIN's work
goes off-kilter.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44122:
{speaker}: Googly, googly glasses!
If JOVI puts them on, will everything look all
googly?
It sounds exciting!
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44132:
{speaker}: Hello there.
{player}, was it?
You've come calling with your young sister
again?
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44133:
{speaker}: Wrong!
Today, we are going to GATEON PORT on a very
important job.
Big brother is JOVI's assistant!
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44134:
{player} explained what had been happening
to MAKAN.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44135:
{speaker}: What was that?!
The HQ LAB's DIRECTOR was abducted?
That's terrible... {speaker}: Their modus operandi...
It feels similar to that incident five years ago.
It may be CIPHER. {speaker}: But one can't conclusively say
that.
Before we get to thinking, you need your
MACHINE PART. {speaker}: It's waiting for you at my shop in
GATEON PORT.
Have a word with my grandson PERR.
He should know.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44136:
{speaker}: Your MACHINE PART is waiting
for you at my shop in GATEON PORT. {speaker}: Have a word with my grandson
PERR.
He'll fetch it up right away for you.
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44140:
{speaker}: The girl isn't here today? {speaker}: Good!
CHOBIN can't work if CHOBIN is without these
spectacles. {speaker}: The DOCTOR's inventions can be
seen on the monitor.
Do take a look!
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44141:
{speaker}: Hm?
What's that you say?!
The ROBO KYOGRE is proving useful in the fight
against CIPHER? {speaker}: Wa... Wahaha!
Well, of course!
The ROBO KYOGRE's power is mighty! {speaker}: I predicted that this would be the
outcome, so I secretly gave it to MAKAN.
Waha...
Wahahaha!
S3_labo_1F/S3_labo_1F.44142:
{speaker}: Wrong!
Today, we went to GATEON PORT on a very

{speaker}: Well, how about that.
CHOBIN didn't need to send an E-MAIL.
But, that's fine. {speaker}: CHOBIN has successfully
upgraded the ROBO GROUDON. {speaker}: What modification has been
made is a secret, though.
Let's begin!
S3_out/S3_out.44096:
{speaker}: Ahahah!
The upgrade has snatched victory!
CHOBIN is the victor! {speaker}: CHOBIN considers you the loser
from now on!
S3_out/S3_out.44097:
{speaker}: So strange...
CHOBIN had upgraded the driver's seat with
a reclining back... {speaker}: Was that not enough?
Not enough to snatch victory?
CHOBIN is in utter shock!
S3_out/S3_out.44098:
{speaker}: Ah!
{player}!
CHOBIN welcomes your most timely arrival. {speaker}: CHOBIN, this time has fitted the
ROBO GROUDON with a power-up component! {speaker}: Now!
CHOBIN wishes to know if a battle with the newly
powered up ROBO GROUDON is what you desire.
S3_out/S3_out.44099:
{speaker}: Ahahah!
CHOBIN will thoroughly acquaint you with the
greatness that is the ROBO GROUDON!
S3_out/S3_out.44100:
{speaker}: Ahahah!
You were frightened off by the amazingly
powered up ROBO GROUDON? {speaker}: CHOBIN's hypothesis has been
proven!
ROBO POKéMON are absolutely the toughest,
no question. The DOCTOR must be informed!
S3_out/S3_out.44101:
{speaker}: Ahahah!
Amazing, isn't it, my ROBO GROUDON? {speaker}: The latest modification is a
fantastic success!
No more defeats are in CHOBIN's horizon!
S3_out/S3_out.44102:
{speaker}: CHOBIN loses!
Even after adding an air conditioner for the
ultimate in atmospheric comfort!
S3_out/S3_out.44103:
{speaker}: CHOBIN is willing to accept your
every challenge for battle. {speaker}: CHOBIN and the ROBO GROUDON
will grow more powerful by gaining experience!
S3_out/S3_out.44104:
{speaker}: CHOBIN has exhausted personal
funds.
Modifications can no longer be afforded.
CHOBIN will battle on guts alone from now on.
S3_out/S3_out.44108:
{6a}{speaker}: Oh! Big brother!
What are you doing here? {speaker}: Oh! JOVI gets it!
Big brother, you got lost, didn't you?
S3_out/S3_out.44109:
{speaker}: Hehehe, JOVI thought so!
Big brother, you look dependable, but then you
make silly mistakes!
S3_out/S3_out.44110:
{speaker}: Uh-uh-uh!
There's no hiding stuff from JOVI!
Because JOVI knows!
S3_out/S3_out.44111:
{speaker}: This big house is DR. KAMINKO's.
DR. KAMINKO's job is to make incredible
inventions. {speaker}: There's a whole bunch of neat
machines like they have at the POKéMON
HQ LAB.
You should come in too, big brother.
S3_out/S3_out.44123:
{speaker}: Oh, silly CHOBIN!
What are you looking at?
S3_out/S3_out.44124:
{speaker}: Today, JOVI is very busy.
JOVI has a very important job with JOVI's
assistant, big brother.
S3_out/S3_out.44125:
{speaker}: The DOCTOR's inventions, which
are quite fantastic, CHOBIN here has compiled
and edited. {speaker}: The video can be viewed anytime
on the monitor in the entrance.
Stop by and look.
S3_out/S3_out.44126:
{speaker}: Well?
You may say anything, but DR. KAMINKO's
inventions are number one in the whole wide
world!
S3_out/S3_out.44127:
{speaker}: Oh, I don't know.
What JOVI likes best is CHOBIN's googly
glasses.
S3_out/S3_out.44128:
{speaker}: Th-these are strictly off-limits.
CHOBIN cannot function without them.
Extremely, absolutely not.
S3_out/S3_out.44130:
{speaker}: The DOCTOR's inventions, which
are quite fantastic, can be viewed anytime on
the monitor in the entrance.
S3_out/S3_out.44131:
{speaker}: Instead of DR. KAMINKO, what
JOVI likes best are CHOBIN's googly glasses.
S3_out/S3_out.44147:
{speaker}: Oh, yes.
May CHOBIN ask if you would inspect the
CRANE ROOM on occasion from now on.
S3_out/S3_out.44148:
{speaker}: Wow, you're a lifesaver!
CHOBIN is no friend of high places. {speaker}: If you find anything, CHOBIN
won't know if you took it, so take it.
But don't take CHOBIN's treasures! {speaker}: Okay, {player}, CHOBIN is
counting on you.
S3_out/S3_out.44149:
{speaker}: Oh, please!
If there is anything there, CHOBIN won't know if
you took it, so take it! {speaker}: CHOBIN is no friend of high
places!
Uh... Does that girl know, maybe?
Is that why she does it?
S3_out/S3_out.44150:
{speaker}: What is it? What is it?
E-MAIL from the PROFESSOR?
He wants you to come home quickly? {speaker}: JOVI is worried about letting you
go by yourself, big brother.
So JOVI will go home, too!
Let's go right now!
S3_out/S3_out.44155:
{speaker}: Oh, yes!
{player}, CHOBIN would like your P★DA
number, if you will be so kind.

battle_disk/pocket_menu.15392:
KRANE MEMO 1
Re: The SNAG SYSTEM SHADOW POKéMON are victims of criminals who
use them for misdeeds.
They must be taken from their bad masters and
protected. The most effective means of taking such
POKéMON from criminals is the SNAG SYSTEM
developed by CIPHER five years ago. It is an unforgivable act among TRAINERS to
steal another TRAINER's POKéMON, but there is
no other way to save SHADOW POKéMON. The SNAG SYSTEM was originally designed to
steal any POKéMON from TRAINERS. We must immediately develop a system that
snags only SHADOW POKéMON...and nothing
else.
battle_disk/pocket_menu.15393:
KRANE MEMO 2
Re: The AURA READER It is impossible for ordinary people to distinguish
SHADOW POKéMON from regular POKéMON based
on appearance. In developing a new SNAG SYSTEM, our biggest
challenge was devising some means of 
recognizing SHADOW POKéMON immediately. We solved this challenge with a headset device
that senses SHADOW POKéMON. We named this headset the AURA READER.
battle_disk/pocket_menu.15394:
KRANE MEMO 3
Re: The SNAG MACHINE The AURA READER's development made it
possible to create a workable new SNAG
MACHINE. We realized that we could integrate the AURA
READER with the original SNAG MACHINE
developed by CIPHER. The AURA READER can be made to sound
a warning and prevent the SNAG MACHINE from
working if a regular, non-SHADOW POKéMON is
targeted. The likelihood of the SNAG MACHINE being
abused should be diminished.
However, one must always be vigilant.
It must be treated with caution!
battle_disk/pocket_menu.15395:
KRANE MEMO 4
Re: Purification Once captured, SHADOW POKéMON must have
their hearts reopened in a process called
purification so that they may return to their
normal state. The best-known method of purification was to
have the SHADOW POKéMON spend time with
a TRAINER and allow their hearts to gradually
reopen. However, because it required SHADOW POKéMON
to be with the TRAINER, this method placed
a limit on the number of POKéMON that could be
treated. We needed a process for efficiently purifying
many SHADOW POKéMON.
Our studies led us to the idea of the PURIFY
CHAMBER.
battle_disk/pocket_menu.15396:
KRANE MEMO 5
Re: The PURIFY CHAMBER The PURIFY CHAMBER is a radical new concept
that differs from the usual purification method of
having SHADOW POKéMON be with a TRAINER
constantly. It represents a new approach that places
SHADOW POKéMON among regular POKéMON
so that they become purified naturally. Much time is still needed to make this concept
real.
We need to acquire systems, collect data,
and make adjustments. We eagerly look forward to seeing the PURIFY
CHAMBER concept in operation.

esaba_A/esaba_A.45001:
{speaker}: Hello, people!
It's time for POFTY's Fast-Break Report!
We bring you news while it's breaking! {6a}{speaker}: Today, we're visiting DUKING,
the discoverer of POKé SPOTS where wild
POKéMON appear.
esaba_A/esaba_A.45002:
{speaker}: DUKING, so is this the POKé SPOT
that you discovered?
esaba_A/esaba_A.45003:
{6a}{speaker}: Hello, DUKING here!
Yeah, that's absolutely right! {speaker}: For fifteen long and torturous
years I toiled, snatching sleep only grudgingly,
to find this POKé SPOT!
esaba_A/esaba_A.45005:
{speaker}: Yeah, uh...
One shouldn't let details get in the way of the
story, isn't that right, BETTY?
esaba_A/esaba_A.45007:
{speaker}: All right!
Let me explain how one goes about attracting
wild POKéMON to a POKé SPOT.
esaba_A/esaba_A.45008:
{speaker}: Well...
Seeing as you're here, wouldn't it be better if
I got someone to demonstrate?
esaba_A/esaba_A.45009:
{speaker}: Oh! You there!
Yes, you, kid!
You'll be perfect.
Come over here, mate!
esaba_A/esaba_A.45010:
{speaker}: Psst! POFTY, trouble!
Bad trouble!
Your makeup's running from your sweat!
esaba_A/esaba_A.45011:
{speaker}: Oh, you should consider
yourself lucky!
DUKING himself will show you how in person!
esaba_A/esaba_A.45012:
{speaker}: Oh, wait, mate.
Not over there.
I need you over this way, between me and
BETTY, right?
esaba_A/esaba_A.45014:
{speaker}: All right, my friend.
Let me show how you attract wild POKéMON
to a POKé SPOT. {speaker}: First, and above all else, you
need these: DUKING brand POKé SNACKS.
Here, I'll give you some.
esaba_A/esaba_A.45015:
{speaker}: All right, my friend.
Lay those POKé SNACKS out on that plate there.
Go on now.
esaba_A/esaba_A.45016: How many POKé SNACKS will you place?
esaba_A/esaba_A.45017:
{player} placed {2f}
POKé SNACKS on the POKé SPOT.
esaba_A/esaba_A.45018:
{speaker}: Very good, mate.
That's how you do it! {speaker}: When you've laid out the POKé
SNACKS, leave the area.
Eventually, a wild POKéMON will come along, just
you wait. {speaker}: The more POKé SNACKS you lay
out, the longer a POKéMON will stay to eat,
making it that much easier to catch. {speaker}: This is also important.
My specially made SPOT MONITOR.
This, I'm sure you'll agree, is truly something
awesome!
esaba_A/esaba_A.45019:
{speaker}: All right, now you're set!
Now, when a wild POKéMON appears at any POKé
SPOT, your SPOT MONITOR will respond and alert
you. {speaker}: I've found three POKé SPOTS
in all.
There's one to the west of this one here.
esaba_A/esaba_A.45020:
{speaker}: After laying out the POKé
SNACKS, get away from the POKé SPOT and wait
for a wild POKéMON to come along. {speaker}: While you're waiting, it wouldn't
hurt to check other POKé SPOTS.
A wild POKéMON will appear sometime. {speaker}: When one does show up, your
SPOT MONITOR will alert you.
Then, all you have to do is get back to the right
POKé SPOT. {speaker}: Oh, right.
You can also check how many POKé SNACKS are
left on the SPOT MONITOR.
Learn to use it, my friend!
esaba_A/esaba_A.45021:
{speaker}: Oh, you are so lucky! {speaker}: To get a private lesson from
DUKING himself, I mean.
It makes me a little envious!
esaba_A/esaba_A.45022:
{speaker}: Oh! Goodness!
Is the camera still rolling?!
esaba_A/esaba_A.45023:
{speaker}: {speaker}'s Fast-Break
Report!
Our guest today was DUKING.
See you again next time!
esaba_A/esaba_A.45024:
{speaker}: Today's Fast-Break Report will
be sure to get high ratings.
Thank you for helping us out!
esaba_A/esaba_A.45025:
{speaker}: Yeah, now you can catch wild POKéMON right
here in ORRE. {speaker}: When I'm on holidays, I should go exploring,
too.
esaba_A/esaba_A.45027:
{speaker}: DUKING is said to be the driving
force behind the booming popularity of wild
POKéMON in PYRITE.
esaba_A/esaba_A.45062:
{speaker}: All right, my friend.
Lay those POKé SNACKS out on that plate there.
Go on now. {speaker}: ...What did you do with the POKé
SNACKS I gave you, mate? {speaker}: Well, not to worry.
I'll give you some more POKé SNACKS.
This time, lay them out properly like you're
supposed to.
esaba_A/esaba_A.45066:
{speaker}: Use these POKé SPOTS and
catch yourself some wild POKéMON.
Give it a try, mate!
esaba_A/esaba_A.45067:
{speaker}: My goodness!
You developed this device yourself?
esaba_A/esaba_A.45068:
{speaker}: I'm glad you asked me that. {speaker}: My SPOT MONITOR is a dandy!
It lets you know what's happening at any POKé
SPOT wherever you are. {speaker}: Here, my friend!
As my thanks for you hearing me out patiently,
I'll make a gift of this, too! {speaker}: Slot it into your P★DA.
That's all you need to do to make it work.
Simple!
esaba_A/esaba_A.45069:
{speaker}: Whoops, mate.
You don't have the room to carry these. Too
many items, it looks like. {speaker}: Well, that's too bad, but not
to worry.
I'll demonstrate for you. Just watch closely now.
esaba_A/esaba_A.45070:
{speaker}: All right, what you want to do is
put these POKé SNACKS out on this plate here,
like so.
esaba_A/esaba_A.45071:
DUKING placed ten POKé SNACKS on the POKé
SPOT.
esaba_A/esaba_A.45073:
{speaker}: When you've laid out the POKé
SNACKS, leave the area.
Eventually, a wild POKéMON will come along, just
you wait. {speaker}: The more POKé SNACKS you lay
out, the longer a POKéMON will stay to eat,
making it that much easier to catch. {speaker}: This is also important.
My specially made SPOT MONITOR.
This, I'm sure you'll agree, is truly something
awesome!
esaba_A/esaba_A.45074:
{speaker}: It's POFTY! {speaker}: By the way, DUKING.
Can you tell us what a SPOT MONITOR is?
esaba_A/esaba_A.45075:
It's a large tray.
It seems to be for holding something.
esaba_A/esaba_A.55001:
{speaker}: Oh, Boss!
MIROR B., sir!
That uppity brat we met before!
He's over there!
esaba_A/esaba_A.55002:
{speaker}: Well, my boys, isn't that pathetic?
Surely, you two aren't spooked by this little boy?
How very, very bad is that? {speaker}: You're {player}, is that it? {speaker}: I don't want to disappoint you or
anything, but I don't have mercy for anyone in
our way.
Not even little children! {speaker}: Let the music play!
esaba_A/esaba_A.55003:
{speaker}: Oh, I took you for granted!
Just a boy, I thought to myself! {speaker}: You two!
esaba_A/esaba_A.55004:
{speaker}: This is where we all say, "Let's go,
escape!"
esaba_A/esaba_A.55005:
{speaker}: Oh dear, not you again.
Let me guess, you're my fan?
I can understand that, but I really can't abide 
a stalker! {speaker}: But, if you really insist, I would be
happy to give you my autograph in exchange for
all your POKéMON.
esaba_A/esaba_A.55006:
{speaker}: Oh, you!
I'm quite offended that you would beat me.
What kind of a fan are you, anyway? {speaker}: This time, I'll overlook it.
But I won't let you off if it ever happens again! {speaker}: Okay!
Let's go!
Escape!
esaba_A/esaba_A.55007:
{speaker}: What do you think you're doing
here? {speaker}: If our boss comes along, there're
going to be consequences, right?
So you move right along and get lost.
esaba_A/esaba_A.55008:
{speaker}: Who?
Our boss, MIROR B.?
He's not here yet. {speaker}: The boss goes off on his own to do
his own thing without us. {speaker}: And so, we end up sitting around
waiting with sweet nothing to do.

esaba_B/esaba_B.45501:
{speaker}: Oh, it's you!
You're that lad who helped us out on that news
show.

a place like this.

POKéMON. {speaker}: That's marvelous!
This makes it all worthwhile, my teaching you,
I mean. {speaker}: So, you fine, upstanding lad, lover
of wild POKéMON, I have some information
that you'll find to be special. {speaker}: But, my friend, I also have a
favor to ask.
That's a fair deal, right?

{speaker}: Yeahah!
Thank you kindly. {speaker}: You see, there are several
POKéMON that hardly ever show up at POKé
SPOTS. {speaker}: TRAPINCH, SURSKIT, and
WOOPER...
I'm having a rotten time of it, trying to catch
those three. {speaker}: If you were to catch them, I'd
gladly trade you some of my POKéMON, mate. {speaker}: I'm counting on you, mate!
I've got to be on my way now!
esaba_B/esaba_B.45503:
{speaker}: Oh, now, don't be that way.
I need your help on this.
I've got some special information for you
in return.
esaba_B/esaba_B.45504:
{speaker}: Whoops!
Mustn't forget!
I promised to give you some special information,
didn't I?
esaba_B/esaba_B.45505:
{speaker}: That's my favorite POKé SPOT.
You've got to go see it. {speaker}: Well, I guess I should be going
on my way.
Real pleasure chatting with you again, mate. {speaker}: I'll be heading back to PYRITE.
Come visit whenever you'd like! {speaker}: Let's meet again, mate!
Adios!
esaba_B/esaba_B.55009:
{speaker}: Fuhohoho!
We meet yet again!
What perfect timing! {speaker}: Perhaps we're tied by some bond
I don't know about.
But you still cause me so much distress! {speaker}: For me to get all the POKéMON in
the world, you're an impudent impediment! {speaker}: And so...
Let the music start!
esaba_B/esaba_B.55010:
{speaker}: Oh, how dare you!
I say, how dare you!
Don't you dare think that this is where it ends! {speaker}: Next time, I'll put things right
and lay down my elegant steps! {speaker}: Let's go!
Escape!
esaba_B/esaba_B.55011:
{speaker}: Oh, no! You again!
Your timing is terrible as ever!
Why show up now of all times? {speaker}: Our boss MIROR B. is performing
a dance to summon POKéMON. {speaker}: I'm saying this for everyone's
sake, get out of here quietly.

esaba_B/esaba_B.55014:
{speaker}: Sniff, sniff...

I smell the alluring aroma of POKéMON, oh yes,
I do!
esaba_B/esaba_B.55015:
{speaker}: My summoning dance has
brought some POKéMON here!
Fuhohohoh!

cute POKéMON with you.

esaba_B/esaba_B.55018:

that this is where it ends! {speaker}: One of these days, I'll put things
right and lay down my elegant steps! {speaker}: Until then...
Let's go!
Escape!

some POKé SNACKS left over there?

I'm not about to really eat any!

RADAR, it's not been easy keeping tabs on
our boss's whereabouts. {speaker}: This better be the place we're
really supposed to meet him.

is going to do now? {speaker}: I'm tired of this life, man.

{speaker}: Sure...

like...
esaba_C/esaba_C.45704:
{speaker}: Wah! Boss?!

{speaker}: Don't be so jumpy.

{speaker}: The RADAR's got something!
It's the boss!
MIROR B.!
esaba_C/esaba_C.45708:
{6a}{speaker}: Fuhohoho!
Hey, my posse!
Have you rounded up POKéMON like I wanted?
esaba_C/esaba_C.45710:
{speaker}: Sniff...
Oh, oh, oh!
I sense the pleasing scent of POKéMON, oh yes
I do! {speaker}: Maybe you're just a little hood,
but maybe you're also one fine TRAINER with
the goods? {speaker}: How about you get with it and join
my posse? {speaker}: Be one of us, and you'll soon be
owning all the POKéMON around the world.
esaba_C/esaba_C.45711:
{speaker}: Oh!
I hear your mouth say it, but your heart's
not in it.
I can't abide that. {speaker}: It's big-decision time; you need
to think hard before you choose a life of crime.
So, tell me, will you join my posse?
esaba_C/esaba_C.45712:
{speaker}: Fuhohoho!
I thought you'd say that! {speaker}: You always had this smell to me,
you see, that you would be our enemy. {speaker}: How I deal with a threat is to nip
it while it's a bud yet.
Fuhohoho! {speaker}: I'll be showing you my power now.
Try not to be blown away by a sense of wow! {speaker}: Let the music play!
esaba_C/esaba_C.45713:
{speaker}: Fuhohoho!
You're a lot weaker than I thought! {speaker}: But I'm in a sunny spirit today, so
I'll forgive you and let you walk away. {speaker}: Don't think of standing up to me
again.
Have we an understanding, my friend?
esaba_C/esaba_C.45714:
{speaker}: Oh, you, you, you!
You make me so angry, I'm seeing red!
Don't you dare think this is over! {speaker}: Just you wait and see!
One of these days, with my elegant steps, I'll
knock you sideways!
esaba_C/esaba_C.45716:
{speaker}: Ah, that win makes me feel fine!
Bye-bye!
esaba_C/esaba_C.55021:
{speaker}: Oh, my!
Your timing is impeccable!
esaba_C/esaba_C.55022:
{speaker}: You two!
I'll give you a little demonstration on what makes
my steps so elegant. {speaker}: Let the music start!
esaba_C/esaba_C.55023:
{speaker}: Stop the music! {speaker}: You silly boy!
In this situation, you should know that you need
to match rhythms with me! {speaker}: It's all your fault that you've
thrown my timing out of whack!
Oh, you annoying child!
esaba_C/esaba_C.55024:
{speaker}: You two!
Let's go!
Escape!
Don't fall behind!
esaba_C/esaba_C.55025:
{speaker}: Stop the music! {speaker}: Well, well, well!
If it isn't the ultra-uncool boy who always,
always, always messes up my plans!
esaba_C/esaba_C.55026:
{speaker}: Boss!
Use your world's-best dance steps and punish
the pest!
esaba_C/esaba_C.55027:
{speaker}: Oh, what a swell idea!
Let's try that right away!
Let the music start!
esaba_C/esaba_C.55028:
{speaker}: Humph!
My groove was just a little off today. {speaker}: Don't even think that you've
bested me yet, you silly boy!
Fuhohohoh! {speaker}: Okay, you two!
Let's go!
Escape!
esaba_C/esaba_C.55029:
{speaker}: I wish our boss, MIROR B., would 
get here already. {speaker}: I wonder what he has in mind?
I mean, why would he call us out to this dank
and gloomy place anyway?
esaba_C/esaba_C.55030:
{speaker}: Boss!
MIROR B., sir!
If you're here, can you come out of hiding?

fight_common/fight.24534:
{speaker}: Did you know?
Offense is the best defense.
fight_common/fight.24537:
{speaker}: Muscles are what POKéMON
and their TRAINERS should work on!
fight_common/fight.24539:
{speaker}: I should get in some weight
training with my MACHAMP.{6d}
fight_common/fight.24540:
{speaker}: From my speedy arrival,
we'll quickly move to a speedy battle!
fight_common/fight.24543:
{speaker}: To win battles, you need to
overwhelm opponents with willpower!
fight_common/fight.24544:
{speaker}: You're still learning.
You won't win often the way you are.{6d}
fight_common/fight.24545:
{speaker}: You need willpower to stand
after taking a loss, too.{6d}
fight_common/fight.24546:
{speaker}: I'll go to battle with the
POKéMON that sailed the seas with me!
fight_common/fight.24547:
{speaker}: The ties that bind my
POKéMON and I, that's what let us win!{6d}
fight_common/fight.24548:
{speaker}: I think I need to go sail far,
far away...{6d}
fight_common/fight.24549:
{speaker}: Can you feel it?
We're in for an electrifying time!
fight_common/fight.24550:
{speaker}: Did you find my victory
electrifying?{6d}
fight_common/fight.24552:
{speaker}: We'll battle until it consumes
us in its fiery intensity leaving only one!
fight_common/fight.24553:
{speaker}: Wow, that was so hot!
I'm drenched in sweat!{6d}
fight_common/fight.24555:
{speaker}: I got up early today so I
could prepare for this battle.
fight_common/fight.24557:
{speaker}: Urgh!
I'm going to bed early tonight!{6d}
fight_common/fight.24558:
{speaker}: I prefer POKéMON that float
and sway in the air.
But my battle style is solidly grounded!
fight_common/fight.24559:
{speaker}: Humph.
My victory is solid and unshakeable!{6d}
fight_common/fight.24560:
{speaker}: Y-you won?
I feel dizzy and wobbly...{6d}
fight_common/fight.26001:
{speaker}: The tempo's off!
This won't do, won't do at all!{6d}
fight_common/fight.26002:
{speaker}: Dancing and battling,
they're not the same, no, no!{6d}
fight_common/fight.26003:
{speaker}: Okay, now I'm furious!
It's hopeless!{6d}
fight_common/fight.26004:
{speaker}: If it's about cutting dance
steps, I won't lose!{6d}
fight_common/fight.26006:
{speaker}: I can't get into rhythm
with you, not at all!{6d}
fight_common/fight.26007:
{speaker}: I'm ready and set to go!
You can bring it on whenever!
fight_common/fight.26008:
{speaker}: Ooh, I so wanted to
dance some more.
Baby, you need to develop a little more
spine like a good bass line.{6d}
fight_common/fight.26010:
{speaker}: Could you soar above my
elegant dance steps?
fight_common/fight.26012:
{speaker}: My timing slipped!
Oh, how vexing!{6d}
fight_common/fight.26013:
{speaker}: What I call my grooving
style, can you keep up with it?
fight_common/fight.26016:
{speaker}: Hey, baby, it's you
again!
This time, I'm putting you out of the
competition!
fight_common/fight.26018:
{speaker}: If this is about dancing,
you're not in my league, baby.{6d}
fight_common/fight.26019:
{speaker}: Hey, baby, not you
again!
This time, I'm not going to forgive you!
fight_common/fight.26022:
{speaker}: I'm your dance partner
this time.
fight_common/fight.26023:
{speaker}: Oh, you're not quite
what I expected at all, baby.{6d}
fight_common/fight.26024:
{speaker}: The tempo is off!
It won't do at all!{6d}
fight_common/fight.26025:
{speaker}: With my gorgeously
elegant dance steps, I'll send you
packing!
fight_common/fight.26027:
{speaker}: My gorgeously elegant
dance steps aren't easy, you know!{6d}
fight_common/fight.26028:
{speaker}: Oh, you are so unlucky
to have to face me!
Let the music play!

hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53520: What shall I do with this {32}?
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53553:
There is another POKéMON that is ready to open
its heart! Would you like to switch SETS?
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53554:
There is another POKéMON that is ready to open
its heart! ...But the PC Storage System is full.
Please make room in the selected BOX.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53560:
{speaker}: This is the PURIFY CHAMBER edit screen. {speaker}: The upper part of the screen indicates the
statuses of the nine SETS. {speaker}: At the center is the edit screen for the
selected SET.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53561:
{speaker}: A SET is chosen from the nine SETS using
the L or R Button.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53562:
{speaker}: The SET changes like so. {speaker}: When the SET to be edited is selected,
choose the POKéMON to be placed on the SET. {speaker}: Move the cursor to the menu item
"PC/PARTY POKéMON," then press the A Button.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53563:
{speaker}: The familiar PC interface appears. {speaker}: By the way, the POKéMON shown here were
provided by me to serve as examples. {speaker}: In actual use, your POKéMON will be shown
here, {player}.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53564:
{speaker}: This screen works exactly like the standard
PC screen. {speaker}: Please select a POKéMON as shown.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53565:
{speaker}: When you have selected a POKéMON, return
to the PURIFY CHAMBER screen. {speaker}: Move the cursor to "SET 5" at the lower
part of the screen and press the A Button.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53566: {speaker}: The screen switches to the PURIFY CHAMBER.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53567:
{speaker}: I should explain: it is possible to switch SETS
while holding a POKéMON.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53568: {speaker}: It's convenient to keep in mind.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53569:
{speaker}: Let's place the selected POKéMON on this
SET. {speaker}: A mark appears wherever the selected
POKéMON can be placed. {speaker}: Move the cursor to wherever the POKéMON
can be placed.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53570:
{speaker}: Press the A Button to open the menu.
Select "PLACE" to place the POKéMON on the
SET. {speaker}: There is a convenient shortcut for this step. {speaker}: Press the X Button.
That turns the cursor color yellow.
The selected POKéMON can now be placed on
the SET without opening the menu.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53571:
{speaker}: A different POKéMON has been brought from
the PC Storage System. {speaker}: This POKéMON can exchange places with the
POKéMON placed on the SET.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53572:
{speaker}: The newly selected POKéMON can also be
placed on a different spot on the SET. {speaker}: Repeat this process and optimize the SET for
purification.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53573:
{speaker}: Depending on how the POKéMON are placed
on the SET, the TEMPO of purification--indicated
at the left of the screen--changes. {speaker}: The cursor will be moved so that you may see
how much of a difference can be made in the
TEMPO.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53574:
{speaker}: It should be obvious that placing this
POKéMON on the right side provides better
TEMPO for purification than if it were on
the left. {speaker}: In such a way, the type matchups of
POKéMON affect the TEMPO. {speaker}: The levels of matchups are indicated using
the thickness and colors of the lines joining the
POKéMON.
The thicker and lighter a blue, the better. {speaker}: Try placing your POKéMON to find the best
matchups possible.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53575:
{speaker}: On one SET, up to four regular POKéMON may
be placed.
Let's place the fourth POKéMON on this SET.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53576:
{speaker}: It should be obvious that it is best to have as
many regular POKéMON as possible on each SET. {speaker}: As you can see, the TEMPO for this SET is at
the highest level.
This is referred to as a "BEST CIRCLE." {speaker}: Next, let's place a SHADOW POKéMON in this
BEST CIRCLE.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53577:
{speaker}: A SHADOW POKéMON can only be placed in
the center of a SET. {speaker}: Let's place one now.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53578:
{speaker}: When the SHADOW POKéMON is placed, the
purification FLOW is indicated. {speaker}: FLOW indicates the speed of purification.
The higher the FLOW, the faster the purification. {speaker}: FLOW is dependent on the SET's TEMPO and
the direction in which the SHADOW POKéMON is
facing. {speaker}: Try changing the SHADOW
POKéMON's direction.
If its type matches up favorably, the line between
the POKéMON will thicken and change in color.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53579:
{speaker}: To change the SHADOW POKéMON's
direction, choose "ROTATE" on the menu. {speaker}: If the cursor is yellow, however, the menu will
not open.
Press the X Button and make the cursor white to
open the menu.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53580:
{speaker}: When the SHADOW POKéMON's direction is
changed, the matchup line shifts accordingly.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53581:
{speaker}: The key point to remember is that the
POKéMON should be grouped and placed for the
best type matchups.
Please experiment for the best results. {speaker}: Before I finish, I should tell you that you will
be automatically informed if a SHADOW POKéMON
in the PURIFY CHAMBER is ready for the
purification ceremony. {speaker}: When you receive that word,
{player}, please return here and open the
POKéMON's heart for good.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53586: Something's different about the LUGIA! Maybe...
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53595: Continue editing without going to the hologram?
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53597:
This {32} is ready to open its heart.
However, there must be at least one regular
POKéMON on the SET to perform a purification
ceremony.
hologram_menu/relivehall_menu.53598:
The {32} will be transferred to
the PC Storage System.

If you're reading this E-MAIL, then you

Try out its many features.
By the way, ADON was playing hide-and-
seek with JOVI.
Why not have a chat with him?

Dear {player},
You appear to have traveled far in your
search for JOVI.
Please come back to the HQ LAB as soon
as you find her.

Hi, {player}, doing good?
EAGUN called today to inform us that
POKé BALLS are now available at the
AGATE POKé MART.

mailopen_menu/pda_menu.53012:
{player}!
I haven't completed analysis on the DATA
ROM, but I did make a stunning discovery
about CIPHER's plan.
Please come right away--we need to
discuss this in person.

{player}, we've been asked to help

The PRE GYM is finally set to reopen after
the CIPHER takeover bid.
We are all looking forward to the
opportunity of battling you, {player}.
