{player}, I would like to write a novel
featuring you as the main character.
Please let me interview you!
I have a good feeling about this story!
I might be generous with my thanks!
Thank you!
mailopen_menu/pda_menu.53024:
This is SECC of ONBS.
{player}, something's come up.
Your help is urgently needed.
Please come see me at ONBS in PYRITE
TOWN as soon as possible.
mailopen_menu/pda_menu.53027:
We've located TEAM SNAGEM.
They've been operating out of their old
hideout north of the OUTSKIRT STAND.
We don't know the size of the group or
much about the leader, GONZAP.
Be careful if you're going there.
mailopen_menu/pda_menu.53030:
The ROBO GROUDON of yore is no more!
CHOBIN has modified it and upgraded it!
Therefore, a rematch with {player} is
very much desired!
CHOBIN will not lose again!
The new ROBO GROUDON is supreme!
mailopen_menu/pda_menu.53036:
Dear {player}.
Hello, this is my first E-MAIL.
I am sorry that I sent an empty message
by mistake.
I also apologize for the misspellings.
I am embarrassed by these mistakes and w
mailopen_menu/pda_menu.53039:
Dear {player}.
I hope you are well.
I wrote you a haiku poem!
"If TEAM SNAGEM goons,
Cause trouble in the desert,
Go and sandbag'em!"
mailopen_menu/pda_menu.53042:
{player}, I hope you are well.
I've been keeping well, too.
I have a message from my partner, "Bigga
bigga!"
From the both of us, we hope for your
success!
mailopen_menu/pda_menu.53045:
Dear {player},
I have heard that you returned from
CITADARK ISLE.
I send this message as an invitation to
the ORRE COLOSSEUM.
I will be arriving shortly to ask you in per--
mailopen_menu/pda_menu.53048:
{player}, hello.
I'm sorry to be writing you without any
notice in advance.
I obtained your number from EAGUN.
There is something odd happening in
our VILLAGE. If you could visit us when y--
mailopen_menu/pda_menu.53051:
{player}, I trust you've been well.
I am proud to announce the reopening of
the REALGAM COLOSSEUM following
extensive maintenance.
We look forward to your participation
against top-ranked TRAINERS!
mailopen_menu/pda_menu.53054:
I got your number from my brother NETT.
I'm sorry to bother you like this, but my
SHROOMISH has suddenly lost its voice.
{player}, do you know anything about
this condition? I don't know what to do.
Please visit us if you have the time.
mailopen_menu/pda_menu.53057:
Hi, {player}.
It sounds like the battle against CIPHER
is entering a critical stage.
There is something I would like you to
have. Please come see me on the ground
floor of the LAB when you can.

mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31011:
{speaker}: Welcome to MT. BATTLE!
Would you care to take our challenge for 
training?
You battle till you're knocked out! {speaker}: Unfortunately, we're not open to the public
right now.
The facilities are closed for training novice 
TRAINERS. {speaker}: Oh?
You're not here to train?
You came to see VANDER, one of our AREA 
LEADERS? {speaker}: Actually, VANDER is in charge of the rookie
training session.
He's inside right now. {speaker}: If you're in a hurry, you may enter through
here.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31012:
{speaker}: VANDER is inside, past here.
You may enter through here if you like.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31013:
{speaker}: The knockout battles will be resumed once
the rookie training session is over. {speaker}: If you'd like, please take the challenge!
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31015:
{speaker}: You can earn POKé COUPONS even while
you're training.
MT. BATTLE is a cool place!
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31016:
{speaker}: You can earn POKé COUPONS even while
you're training.
MT. BATTLE is a cool place. {speaker}: But they're supposed to be training rookies
right now.
So they won't let you take the challenge as 
usual.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31017:
{speaker}: I'm going to collect POKé COUPONS so I can
get some new moves for my POKéMON. {speaker}: See that man in white sitting on the bench?
He teaches POKéMON moves in exchange for 
POKé COUPONS.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31033:
{speaker}: In the desert south of here, 
there's a CIPHER research facility.
It's been there since the SHADOW POKéMON 
incident. {speaker}: It seemed to be abandoned 
for a long time.
But recently, I've seen groups of shady 
characters going inside.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31034:
{speaker}: Shady characters were seen 
at the lab in the desert in the south.
Are they some how connected to PROF. KRANE's
abduction?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31035:
{speaker}: There are three rookie TRAINERS in
training now.
When they complete their training, MT. BATTLE 
will be reopened.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31044:
{speaker}: Welcome to MT. BATTLE.
Would you care to take the MT. BATTLE
knockout battle challenge?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31048:
{speaker}: Would you like to make a new challenge,
or continue an ongoing challenge?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31051: {speaker}: We look forward to your next visit.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31052:
{speaker}: MT. BATTLE is a place of training.
It is divided into ten AREAS, each with ten
ZONES. {speaker}: In other words, there are one hundred
ZONES in total.
Challengers must battle through these ZONES 
one by one. {speaker}: On completing each AREA, the challenger
is rewarded with POKé COUPONS. {speaker}: Between each AREA is a BREAK ROOM where
you may relax.
You will also find a PC there for your free use. {speaker}: If you want to return to this reception counter,
just approach one of our ABRA for a free
TELEPORT. {speaker}: You are qualified to enter AREAS 1 through 3
right now.
Please do try to complete them all. {speaker}: To enter AREA 4 or higher, you must complete
the first three AREAS. {speaker}: Once you clear AREA 4 or higher, you may
make a challenge in the next AREA or enter any
of the cleared AREAS. {speaker}: If you have any questions concerning POKé
COUPONS, please ask at the counter on your
right.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31053:
{speaker}: {player}, you have cleared up to
AREA {2f}. In which AREA would you like to make your 
challenge?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31065:
{speaker}: I see, you're making a fresh challenge this
time.
I hope you do well in the knockout battles!
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31066:
{speaker}: I see.
You wish to start from AREA {2f}.
This ABRA will show you there.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31067:
{speaker}: Okay, ABRA, do your thing.
I hope you do well in the knockout battles!
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31069:
{speaker}: Thank you for making a challenge.
It's too bad the results weren't the best, but do 
come back to train again.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31070:
{speaker}: Thank you for making a challenge.
Please do return for more training.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31071:
{speaker}: Congratulations on getting through the
knockout battle challenge!
Your performance was marvelous! {speaker}: Please do come back with different POKéMON
for more training!
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31081:
{speaker}: Congratulations on your
100-win streak!
Your battle was absolutely great. {speaker}: This exclusive RIBBON is a
token to commemorate your 100-win streak. 
Please treasure it. {speaker}: You can get RIBBONS every
time you accomplish 100-win-streak battles.
We are waiting for your next challenge. 
Thank you for making a challenge.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31301: {speaker}: I hope you do well in the knockout battles!
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31311:
{speaker}: Hmm...
Is there some sort of a connection between 
those characters and PROF. KRANE's abduction?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31314:
{speaker}: {player}, you have cleared all of AREAS
1 through 3. {speaker}: You are now cleared to make challenges in
AREA 4 and beyond.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.31315:
{speaker}: {player}, you are cleared to make
a challenge in the first three AREAS.
Which AREA would you like to try?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50901:
{speaker}: Be it a move that was never learned,
or a move once learned and forgotten, if moves
are what POKéMON need, I'm the man! {speaker}: All it takes are some POKé COUPONS for
me, the MOVE TEACHER, to teach your POKéMON
those moves you want and a whole lot more! {speaker}: So, are there any POKéMON that want to
learn a new move or two?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50902:
{speaker}: There'll be times like this.
Drop in when you need me.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50904:
{speaker}: Hold on, that's a SHADOW POKéMON!
Even I can't teach it any new moves.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50905:
{speaker}: I hate admitting this, but...
There are no moves that I can teach
your {32}.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50907:
{speaker}: Hold on.
It already knows the move
{39}.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50908:
{speaker}: You don't have enough POKé COUPONS.
I'm sorry, but I can't teach moves to your
POKéMON.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50909:
{speaker}: So, I should teach the move
{39}?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50910:
{speaker}: Say now, youngster!
You mustn't ask for the impossible.
That POKéMON knows all the moves that it
can learn. {speaker}: That is unless I, the MOVE DELETER,
make it forget a move.
Now, which move will be forgotten?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50911:
{speaker}: If I don't do this, your POKéMON won't be
able to learn {39}.
Is that fine with you?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50913:
{speaker}: Oh, so {39} shouldn't be
forgotten.
Then which move should be forgotten?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50914:
{speaker}: There! A clean sweep!
Your {32} has completely
forgotten how to use {39}.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50915:
{speaker}: ...Done!
Your {32} has learned
{39}. {speaker}: Are there any other POKéMON that need
the help of me, the MOVE TEACHER?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50931:
{speaker}: There are rare POKéMON out there, you
know that.
There's a POKéMON that's considered to be
a mirage, it's so rare. {speaker}: They say it can learn all sorts of moves.
If I ever meet one, there's something I'm
desperate to try. {speaker}: Have you seen it?
If you ever get it, think of me!
You've got to tell me, please!
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50932:
{speaker}: I've been searching for a POKéMON that's
considered a mirage.
It's supposed to be able to learn all kinds of
moves. {speaker}: But all my searching has so far turned up
absolutely nothing.
I may have to start searching in more faraway
places.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50933:
{speaker}: I've been searching for a POKéMON that's
considered a mirage.
It's supposed to be able to learn all kinds
of moves.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50934:
{speaker}: Oh, wow!
That POKéMON you're with!
It's the one they said was a mirage!
It's MEW! {speaker}: Where did you find it?
That MEW is the POKéMON I've been searching
for all this time. {speaker}: Why?
Because MEW is the only POKéMON that can
learn every single move I teach.
Yup, every one of the 100 I teach! {speaker}: If you'd like, I could teach your MEW
some moves right now. {speaker}: Since it is your MEW I'll be teaching,
I should pick moves that suit your style.
I'll need your help just a little. {speaker}: I'll ask you five questions.
I want you to pick an answer that suits you best
for each question.
That's all it takes! {speaker}: If you like the four moves I pick out
based on your answers, I can teach them to your
MEW for 5,000 POKé COUPONS. {speaker}: What do you think?
Want to give it a try?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50935:
{speaker}: Okay... That's disappointing.
You can always find me here, so feel free
to visit anytime.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50936:
{speaker}: Oh, wow!
You came for another visit! {speaker}: If you'll answer five questions, I'll pick
out a set of moves for your MEW from the 100
moves I know.
Of course, I can teach the moves, too. {speaker}: How about it?
Want to give it a try?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50937:
{speaker}: Oh, no...
You don't have enough POKé COUPONS. {speaker}: You need 5,000 POKé COUPONS if you
want me to teach your MEW a full set of
moves. {speaker}: Come back another time, okay?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50938:
{speaker}: Okay.
Let's get with it right away.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50943: {speaker}: How would you like your MEW to be?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50948: {speaker}: What kind of TRAINER are you?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50951: No giving up to the end
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50953:
{speaker}: Where would you rather live, PYRITE
TOWN or PHENAC CITY?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50956:
{speaker}: PROF. KRANE or DR. KAMINKO.
Which one is greater?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50959:
{speaker}: Which one is bad?
CIPHER or TEAM SNAGEM?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50962:
{speaker}: Okay, final question.
ROBO GROUDON and ROBO KYOGRE.
Which one would you want?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50965:
{speaker}: Okay, final question.
CIPHER ADMINS ARDOS or ELDES.
Which one is cool?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50968:
{speaker}: Okay, final question.
MT. BATTLE's VANDER or PRE GYM's JUSTY.
Which one is stronger?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50971:
{speaker}: Okay, final question.
SNATTLE or GORIGAN.
Which is the smart one?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50974:
{speaker}: Okay, final question.
MIROR B.'s underlings FOLLY or TRUDLY.
Who do you like more?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50977:
{speaker}: Hm, hm, hm... {speaker}: Okay!
The moves I chose are...
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50979:
{speaker}: How about choosing the POKéMON
I should teach?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50980:
{speaker}: That's how it goes sometimes.
Want to try it one more time?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50981:
{speaker}: MEW will forget all the moves it knows now.
Are you sure that's okay?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50982:
{speaker}: Huh?
Where has your MEW gone to?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50993: This POKéMON cannot be taught any moves.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50994:
{speaker}: ...Done!
Your MEW has learned a complete set of four
moves. {speaker}: There we go!
We're all done here.
If you need me for anything else, I'll be right
here.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.50995:
{speaker}: There! A clean sweep!
Your MEW has forgotten all the moves it knew.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.51101:
{speaker}: My name is the MOVE DELETER. {speaker}: Like my name suggests, I can make
POKéMON forget their moves. {speaker}: Well, lad?
Should I make your POKéMON forget any moves?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.51102:
{speaker}: Come see me if you would like any of
your POKéMON to unlearn moves.
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.51103:
{speaker}: Which POKéMON should I make forget one
or more moves?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.51104:
{speaker}: Fine.
Now, which move should be deleted?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.51105:
{speaker}: Hmm...
I'm sorry, lad, but that POKéMON is too much for
me to handle. {speaker}: Should I make a different POKéMON
unlearn its moves?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.51106:
{speaker}: Hmm...
Your {32} seems to know only
one move.
I can't make it unlearn that. {speaker}: Should I make a different POKéMON
unlearn its moves?
mewwaza/D2_pc_1F.51108:
{speaker}: There! A clean sweep!
Your {32} has completely
forgotten how to use {39}. {speaker}: Would you like it to forget any other
move?

orre_menu/pocket_menu.15392:
KRANE MEMO 1
Re: The SNAG SYSTEM SHADOW POKéMON are victims of criminals who
use them for misdeeds.
They must be taken from their bad masters and
protected. The most effective means of taking such
POKéMON from criminals is the SNAG SYSTEM
developed by CIPHER five years ago. It is an unforgivable act among TRAINERS to
steal another TRAINER's POKéMON, but there is
no other way to save SHADOW POKéMON. The SNAG SYSTEM was originally designed to
steal any POKéMON from TRAINERS. We must immediately develop a system that
snags only SHADOW POKéMON...and nothing
else.
orre_menu/pocket_menu.15393:
KRANE MEMO 2
Re: The AURA READER It is impossible for ordinary people to distinguish
SHADOW POKéMON from regular POKéMON based
on appearance. In developing a new SNAG SYSTEM, our biggest
challenge was devising some means of 
recognizing SHADOW POKéMON immediately. We solved this challenge with a headset device
that senses SHADOW POKéMON. We named this headset the AURA READER.
orre_menu/pocket_menu.15394:
KRANE MEMO 3
Re: The SNAG MACHINE The AURA READER's development made it
possible to create a workable new SNAG
SYSTEM. We realized that we could integrate the AURA
READER with the original SNAG SYSTEM
developed by CIPHER. The AURA READER can be made to sound
a warning and prevent the SNAG SYSTEM from
working if a regular, non-SHADOW POKéMON is
targeted. The likelihood of the SNAG SYSTEM being
abused should be diminished.
However, one must always be vigilant.
It must be treated with caution!
orre_menu/pocket_menu.15395:
KRANE MEMO 4
Re: Purification Once captured, SHADOW POKéMON must have
their hearts reopened in a process called
purification so that they may return to their
normal state. The best-known method of purification was to
have the SHADOW POKéMON spend time with
a TRAINER and allow their hearts to gradually
reopen. However, because it required SHADOW POKéMON
to be with the TRAINER, this method placed
a limit on the number of POKéMON that could be
treated. We needed a process for efficiently purifying
many SHADOW POKéMON.
Our studies led us to the idea of the PURIFY
CHAMBER.
orre_menu/pocket_menu.15396:
KRANE MEMO 5
Re: The PURIFY CHAMBER The PURIFY CHAMBER is a radical new concept
that differs from the usual purification method of
having SHADOW POKéMON be with a TRAINER
constantly. It represents a new approach that places
SHADOW POKéMON among regular POKéMON
so that they become purified naturally. Much time is still needed to make this concept
real.
We need to acquire systems, collect data,
and make adjustments. We eagerly look forward to seeing the PURIFY
CHAMBER concept in operation.

waza_menu/pocket_menu.15392:
KRANE MEMO 1
Re: The SNAG SYSTEM SHADOW POKéMON are victims of
criminals who use them for misdeeds.
They must be taken from their bad
masters and protected. The most effective means of taking
such POKéMON from criminals is the
SNAG SYSTEM developed by CIPHER
five years ago. It is an unforgivable act among
TRAINERS to steal another TRAINER's
POKéMON, but there is no other way
to save SHADOW POKéMON. The SNAG SYSTEM was originally
designed to steal any POKéMON from
TRAINERS. We must immediately develop a system
that snags only SHADOW POKéMON...
and nothing else.
waza_menu/pocket_menu.15393:
KRANE MEMO 2
Re: The AURA READER It is impossible for ordinary people to
distinguish SHADOW POKéMON from
regular POKéMON based on appearance. In developing a new SNAG SYSTEM,
our biggest challenge was devising
some means of recognizing SHADOW
POKéMON immediately. We solved this challenge with a headset
device that senses SHADOW POKéMON. We named this headset the AURA
READER.
waza_menu/pocket_menu.15394:
KRANE MEMO 3
Re: The SNAG MACHINE The AURA READER's development made
it possible to create a workable
new SNAG SYSTEM. We realized that we could integrate
the AURA READER with the original
SNAG SYSTEM developed by CIPHER. The AURA READER can be made to
sound a warning and prevent the SNAG
SYSTEM from working if a regular,
non-SHADOW POKéMON is targeted. The likelihood of the SNAG SYSTEM
being abused should be diminished.
However, one must always be vigilant.
It must be treated with caution!
waza_menu/pocket_menu.15395:
KRANE MEMO 4
Re: Purification Once captured, SHADOW POKéMON must
have their hearts reopened in a
process called purification so that they
may return to their normal state. The best-known method of purification
was to have the SHADOW POKéMON spend
time with a TRAINER and allow their
hearts to gradually reopen. However, because it required SHADOW
POKéMON to be with the TRAINER, this
method placed a limit on the number
of POKéMON that could be treated. We needed a process for efficiently
purifying many SHADOW POKéMON.
Our studies led us to the idea of
the PURIFY CHAMBER.
waza_menu/pocket_menu.15396:
KRANE MEMO 5
Re: The PURIFY CHAMBER The PURIFY CHAMBER is a radical new
concept that differs from the usual
purification method of having SHADOW
POKéMON be with a TRAINER constantly. It represents a new approach that places
SHADOW POKéMON among regular
POKéMON so that they become purified
naturally. Much time is still needed to make
this concept real.
We need to acquire systems, collect
data, and make adjustments. We eagerly look forward to seeing
the PURIFY CHAMBER concept in
operation.
